The Opportunity

Adobe is transforming the enterprise content supply chain with intelligent brand solutions that redefine how large organizations create, govern, and scale content. At the core of this transformation is Brand Brain, a first-of-its-kind AI system that captures an enterprise’s business context and brand identity, enabling teams to create and validate content that is consistently on-brand across tools, workflows, and channels.

We are looking for a Senior Developer to build of Brand Brain’s core services and infrastructure. This role is ideal for a senior full stack engineer who can design and build these key AI-powered content workflows that will help organizations create on-brand assets at scale. You will work across backend, AI orchestration layers, creative tooling, agentic workflows etc. This role sits at the intersection of creativity, engineering craftsmanship, and applied AI.

Impact You’ll Make

You will have an opportunity to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and can take a feature from concept to production. You will help architect build technology that helps enterprises create on-brand content at scale by building robust backend services, APIs and platforms that integrate Brand Brain into Adobe ecosystem and third-party enterprise apps.

The Opportunity

Adobe leads in creating world-class software solutions, and we are excited to welcome a new Software Development Engineer 5 to our vibrant team in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. This is an outstanding chance to join a cooperative and driven environment where your work directly influences the success of innovative projects.

Responsibilities

Architect and deliver foundational systems that enable enterprises to build on-brand content at a global scale.

Develop strong backend services, APIs, and integration layers that embed Brand Brain deeply within the Adobe ecosystem and third-party enterprise platforms.

Drive engineering excellence across performance, reliability, observability, and secure-by-default building.

Contribute to crafting long-term platform architecture in a fast-paced, highly visible product area.

What You’ll Do

Define and evolve foundational architecture, including service boundaries, domain models, APIs, and internal platform capabilities supporting high-throughput, low-latency workloads.

Build and implement scalable microservices and AI orchestration layers powering intelligent content workflows and agentic systems.

Build strong APIs and connectors that connect Brand Brain with Adobe products and third-party enterprise software.

Ensure platform compliance with strict SLAs for availability, scalability, latency, and data governance.

Establish guidelines for observability, incident management, prioritization, and cost efficiency.

Rapidly prototype and iterate on AI-powered features to validate new product experiences.

Improve engineering quality through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing, and technical mentorship.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of experience building high-quality backend systems and microservices with strong emphasis on scalability, resilience, and performance.

Deep proficiency in backend development using Python or Java (both preferred).

Strong experience designing, building, and operating RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs at scale.

Hands-on experience with cloud-native architectures, containers, CI/CD pipelines, and distributed systems.

Strong foundation in system build, modern architecture patterns, and engineering guidelines.

Demonstrated ability to take features from concept to production in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally across Product, Build, and AI/ML teams.

Nice to Have

Experience in AdTech, MarTech, Content Management Systems (CMS), or enterprise SaaS platforms.

Familiarity with large-scale data platforms, indexing, or search systems.

Experience integrating platforms across complex product ecosystems.

Exposure to Adobe or third-party creative ecosystems (e.g., Photoshop, Express, InDesign, Figma).

Experience shipping AI-powered features or working with agentic workflows.

The Opportunity

Adobe purchases products and services from thousands of suppliers each year. We aim to accelerate Adobe's continued commercial success through outstanding strategic sourcing. You will have the chance to lead sourcing projects while you partner with internal teams and suppliers to optimize spend across Adobe's indirect categories.

What you'll do

Lead end-to-end commercial strategy for global cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including complex enterprise agreements, consumption optimization, and long-term capacity planning.

Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and Finance to translate cloud usage patterns into actionable sourcing strategies that reduce total cost of ownership while maintaining performance and resilience.

Develop and execute negotiation strategies for multi-year cloud commitments, marketplace agreements, and emerging cloud-native services.

Utilize governance mechanisms that improve visibility into cloud spend, usage forecasting, and risk management.

Monitor market trends across hyperscalers and cloud ecosystem vendors to inform build vs. buy decisions and long-term platform strategy.

Proactively seek value-creating opportunities across spend categories

Oversee the process of disseminating and following contract obligations, and instituting a complete strategy to approach renewal.

Develop, issue, and coordinate RFx activity and lead commercial negotiations to find the best sourcing solution for Adobe.

Ensure proper risk mitigation through liaising and contributing with Legal. Help internal partners obtain robust Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to ensure reliable performance.

Report progress on a weekly basis, indicating work planning and work in progress. Add agreements, service details and payment forecasts into procurement systems in a complete and timely manner.

Drive continuous improvement and organizational change initiatives.

What You’ll Need

Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or similar (preference: MBA, or JD).

Strategic Sourcing/Procurement-related industry certification(s) a plus.

Preference: 6-10 years’ experience in Strategic Sourcing with an emphasis in cloud software or software as a service.

Deep market knowledge software contracting trends, licensing models, and business models.

Experience leading teams, formal people leadership preferred. 

Familiarity with fiscal planning cycles and ad hoc financial analysis.

Excellent emotional intelligence (EQ) & influence with various partners, and improving business dynamics both within Global Procurement and broadly across Adobe; evidence of continuous positive customer feedback.

Growth mentality: aware of personal strengths and weaknesses; skilled in receiving, applying, and giving useful feedback.

Mastery of MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Familiarity with BI reporting and spend analysis.

High attention to detail and the exercise of sound judgment and decision-making.

Exceptional written and verbal communication, time management and interpersonal skills.

Able to synthesize and present complex matters and data analysis in executive presentation views with insightful commentary.

Willing to train users in new processes, policies, and procedures or technologies.

Effective ownership of competing priorities. Flexible working times based on company requirements and should be expected at various times through the business year and quarter.

The Adobe Digital Imaging Data Science Team is looking for a Data Scientist passionate about data and delivering an outstanding product experience. We use extensive product usage data and work closely with product managers, marketing managers, and software engineers to derive insights and build a foundation for reliable data-driven decision-making. You will focus on initiatives like product analytics, dashboards, data engineering, GTM analytics, growth and more. Your main role is to develop and maintain a strong data architecture that enhances reporting, analytics, and experimentation. Over time, you will apply predictive modeling and machine learning to help the organization improve customer experiences. Join us and drive meaningful change in Adobe’s most exciting areas!

Responsibilities:

Partner with product and engineering teams to understand existing product instrumentation and help bridge gaps in data streams to assist data science initiatives.

Analyze product usage patterns to better understand customer behavior including acquisition, engagement, conversion, and retention.

Proactively identify user trends and communicate relevant insights to assist product decision-making.

Automate and optimize data pipelines using SQL and/or Python-based ETL Frameworks.

Build and maintain various dashboards to inform the team about the state of the business, as well as to alert business partners when issues occur.

Architect and implement models to recommend personalized in-app content.

Drive A/B and multivariate tests and build feature-level experiments to validate hypotheses and influence product development decisions.

Requirements:

MS or Ph.D. in data science, computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, engineering, or economics, or equivalent experience.

3 - 5+ years of relevant data science experience.

Experience translating business questions into data analytics approaches.

Strong proficiency in querying and manipulating large datasets using SQL-like languages (Hive, Spark, etc.).

Experience developing and operationalizing consistent approaches to experimentation, using appropriate statistical techniques to reduce bias and interpret statistical significance.

Proficiency with descriptive and inferential statistics (i.e., t-test, chi-square, ANOVA, correlation, regression, etc.) to understand customer engagement and generate hypotheses.

Experience crafting data visualizations and storytelling to efficiently communicate analysis results to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Knowledge of relevant tools in this field such as Hadoop, Hive, Splunk, Spark, Tableau, Excel (Charting and Pivot-Tables), and Power BI.

Experience in product instrumentation is a plus.

Possess natural curiosity and technical competence, being capable of asking critical questions and always ready to address any challenges.

Experience addressing an executive level audience.

Excellent communication, relationship skills, and a strong teammate.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Director of Product Marketing, Growth & Platforms to drive user and revenue expansion for Adobe's Creator portfolio. In this role, you will coordinate the growth strategy for Firefly, Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere across both web and mobile platforms.

You will be responsible for shaping the expansion approach for this ecosystem and lead a cross functional team passionate about driving impact across two key areas:

Cross-Application Growth: Scale our products within Adobe’s creative ecosystem by integrating workflows and optimizing acquisition funnels across internal and external touchpoints.

Portfolio Lifecycle Management (LCM): Develop our LCM system and omnichannel methods (email, push, in-app messaging, SMS or comparable experience) aimed at improving user engagement and retention.

What You Will Do

Drive Cross-Application Growth Strategies

Workflow Integration: Build cross-application workflows and incorporate Firefly's Generative AI tools into Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere.

Journey Optimization: Manage end-to-end user journeys.

Scale branded entry points across the product ecosystem. Support the development of a cross-app platform. Build viral loops and develop our trends and sharing roadmap to drive organic growth.

External Partnerships: Build strategic partnerships to define new entry points and workflows (e.g., LLM providers, hardware, and software partners).

Architect Portfolio Lifecycle Oversight (LCM)

Omnichannel Activation: Manage LCM channels across the Creator portfolio, including push, in-app, email, SMS, App Store Optimization (ASO), and Google Play.

Evergreen Engagement: Direct the evergreen LCM strategy with Outbound Product Marketing to sustain user engagement between major product releases.

Infrastructure Acceleration: Partner with Product and Engineering to advance infrastructure.

Platform modernization: Explore new ways to bring to bear Gen AI technologies to engage users and drive operational excellence.

Orchestrate Cross-Functional Execution & Growth Operations

Growth Operations: Lead high-velocity multivariate testing frameworks to optimize acquisition funnels, monetization models, and user flows.

Product-Led Growth (PLG): Operationalize PLG loops - such as sharing, referrals, and asset remixing to improve user acquisition.

Executive Alignment: Align Engineering, Build, Product, and Marketing around unified growth objectives. Translate growth analytics into clear executive reporting.

What You Need to Succeed

Growth Leadership: 12+ years of leadership experience in growth marketing, product marketing, or product management. A proven record of scaling products to mass-market adoption within a multi-product ecosystem.

Mobile & Web Expertise: Deep experience driving user acquisition, retention, and monetization strategies for applications.

Lifecycle & Ecosystem Experience: Proficiency in managing complex LCM channels and growth loops. Hands-on experience with enterprise marketing automation infrastructure (e.g., Adobe Journey Optimizer) is highly preferred.

Quantitative Rigor: Strong analytical skills. Demonstrated capability in cohort analysis, funnel optimization, user profiling, and A/B/multivariate experiment development.

Technical & Creative Proficiency: Ability to translate GenAI capabilities (e.g., LLMs, diffusion models) into intuitive value propositions for creative professionals in building, video, and imaging.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to influence executive collaborators, product managers, and engineering teams in a matrixed organization.

Job Description

We need a skilled Product Manager to join our team, specializing in Sales and Support technology. The perfect candidate should excel in using AI to improve customer experience and boost business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Vision: Craft, communicate, and advocate a distinct product vision and strategy for Sales and Support technologies, integrating AI to enhance customer engagement.

Market Research and Analysis: Undertake meticulous market research to uncover customer needs, market trends, and competitive landscape. Employ these observations to guide product development and positioning.

Roadmap Development: Build and maintain a detailed 4-quarterly product roadmap that aligns with business goals and customer needs. Prioritize features and improvements based on impact and feasibility. Present roadmap progress and insights to senior leadership and cross-functional collaborators.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with engineering, UX designers, sales, legal, and support teams to ensure successful product development and launch. Facilitate communication, alignment and collaboration across distributed teams and geographies.

Customer Engagement: Work with customers & key team members to gather feedback, grasp problems, and validate product concepts. Apply this feedback to propel continuous improvement and innovation.

Performance Metrics: Define and track critical metrics to measure product success and identify areas for improvement and innovation. Use data-driven insights to make informed decisions.

AI Thought Leadership: Recognize opportunities where AI can significantly change the transactional digital-human exchanges. Define creative solutions that improve the transactional sales and support processes. Keep abreast of the most recent AI advancements and integrate them into product development. Work together with business, engineering, and data science teams to prototype, validate, and launch AI-powered features that boost automation, personalization, and efficiency.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree or relevant experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a similar field. An MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

Experience: At least 5 years of experience in product management, specializing in transactional Sales and Support technologies. Demonstrated success in launching and overseeing products.

Technical Skills: Proficient knowledge and proven history of integrating AI technologies and their utilization in transactional Sales and Support field. Having familiarity with AI/ML frameworks and tools is greatly valued.

Experience with Leading AI Platforms: Having worked with industry-leading AI ecosystems like Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service, Amazon Bedrock, or AWS SageMaker is highly desirable. Being familiar with integrating these platforms into enterprise-scale sales and support systems is a strong advantage. Demonstrated success in employing these technologies to build scalable, intelligent solutions that improve user efficiency, automate workflows, and drive measurable business outcomes will set you apart.

Analytical Abilities: Demonstrates excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities. Ability to interpret complex data and make data-driven decisions.

Communication Skills: Demonstrates strong verbal and written communication abilities. Capable of effectively engaging with technical and non-technical collaborators.

Encouragement: Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to influence and encourage cross-functional teams. Strong project management skills and attention to detail.

Why Join Us

Modern Environment: Join a forward-thinking company that values innovation and creativity. Work on modern technologies and make a significant impact on the industry.

Collaborative Culture: Join a collaborative and inclusive team that values diverse perspectives and fosters a culture of continuous learning and growth.

Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. We invest in our employees' growth and provide an encouraging environment for career progression.

If you are enthusiastic about product management, possess a solid Sales and Support tech background, and see the possibilities of Generative AI, we invite you to apply. Join us in influencing the future of customer experience!

The Opportunity

The ATS Creativity & Productivity (C&P) Business Capability, Design & Delivery (BCDD) team is looking for an experienced Senior Manager to lead the CRM and Omnichannel product pillar within the Integrated Customer Experience (ICX) RTM organization.

This role is responsible for defining and driving the AI first product strategy and delivery for:

CRM platforms supporting transactional Sales and Support teams

High velocity sales experience including tooling

Omnichannel communication platforms (chat, phone, messaging, contact center capabilities)

Advisor-facing workflow automation and intelligent routing

AI-enabled Advisor productivity capabilities

You will build trusted relationships across ICX leadership and drive a disciplined product perspective within your team. You will simplify and optimize complex end to end workflows in a highly matrixed environment.

You will articulate and influence at the VP and Senior Director level to drive transformation, particularly in areas of AI/GenAI enablement, platform modernization, and service reliability.

You will collaborate closely with Architecture, Engineering, UX, Analytics, and Vendor partners to prototype, validate, and scale solutions that improve advisor productivity, operational efficiency, and customer experience.

What You’ll Do

Rapidly understand the ICX operating model and find opportunities to streamline critical workflows to drive measurable business value.

Own and evolve the product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for CRM and internal sales transactional platforms.

Present quarterly roadmap progress, platform health, and business impact to VP/Sr. Directors.

Drive AI-first innovation across platforms, including intelligent case routing, automation, agent assist, and workflow optimization.

Strengthen vendor engagement (e.g., CRM and CCaaS platforms, strategic cloud vendors) to ensure roadmap alignment and platform value realization.

Improve service reliability and operational excellence by embedding SLAs, root-cause accountability, and technical debt reduction into product ownership.

Make thoughtful trade-offs that balance quality, business value, scalability, and delivery timelines.

Mentor and grow a high-performing team across global locations.

Needed to Succeed

10+ years of experience in software product management, including leadership of Product Managers in enterprise environments.

Proven track record delivering complex enterprise platforms such as CRM systems, internal sales tools, case management systems, or omnichannel contact center platforms.

Experience modernizing legacy systems into scalable, AI-enabled platforms.

Practical knowledge of enterprise applications and integrations across CRM, service platforms, workflow automation, and cloud ecosystems.

Proven ability to lead distributed teams across geographies.

Intense curiosity in emerging AI/GenAI technologies and their application to advisor productivity and customer interaction platforms.

MBA or Masters degree preferred.

Interest in mentoring and growing product managers while fostering a focused product approach in everything we do.

Attention to detail with a proactive attitude and the ability to work as part of a distributed team across North America and India.

Intense curiosity and a sincere interest in learning new technologies, platforms, business processes.

Adobe Firefly’s Applied Science & Machine Learning (ASML) group is seeking research scientists and engineers passionate about conditional generation and editing of large-scale generative AI models. They will concentrate on images and videos. Our aim is to advance generative AI and ensure models have high quality and controllability.

We are especially seeking candidates experienced in large-scale, industry-grade pre-training and mid-training of multi-modality generative models. This role directly influences the quality of Adobe’s image and video generation models, supporting next-generation creative workflows for millions of users.

As an Applied Scientist at Adobe, you will join a world-class team of applied researchers and engineers building the future of digital experiences. You will have the opportunity to innovate across the full training stack, collaborate across data, modeling, and product, and see your work ship to customers worldwide.

Job Responsibilities

Conduct innovative research and development in training large-scale generative AI models for image and video synthesis.

Develop, carry out, and carefully evaluate sophisticated techniques for conditional generation and editing. This work emphasizes improving instruction adherence, controllability, and the visual quality of pre-trained image and video models.

Collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, engineers, and product teams to translate multimodal innovations into scalable downstream applications coordinated within Adobe products.

Define and build comprehensive evaluation frameworks and benchmarking pipelines to assess generative models across quality, efficiency, safety, and reliability, establishing guidelines and standards for the organization.

Translate research concepts and published work into production-ready implementations using Python and modern machine learning frameworks.

Collaborate with technical leads to build long-term technical strategy and roadmap, while mentoring and guiding junior engineers and researchers to elevate team capability and impact.

What you'll need to succeed

Hold a Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a closely related area.

Extensive practical experience in large-scale generative AI training emphasizing the creation and modification of images and videos.

Familiarity with diffusion models, transformers, or other brand new generative architectures.

Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.

Strong coding and prototyping ability in Python, PyTorch, and ML infrastructure tools.

Working with product teams on technology transfers

Strong history of publications in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related areas

Adobe empowers individuals and organizations to create exceptional content effortlessly. The AI for Engineering team builds a scalable, production-grade AI platform that powers creativity across design, imaging, motion, and personalization.

We are seeking a Staff Engineer - AI for Engineering to design and build the next-generation AI systems that bring intelligent, adaptive, and agentic experiences to Adobe Express.

This role is ideal for an engineer who deeply understands how modern LLMs and generative models behave in real-world systems — including reasoning patterns, tool use, prompt dynamics, failure modes, and orchestration strategies — and can translate that understanding into scalable, production-ready platforms.

You will define and build the end-to-end architecture that enables Agentic AI solutions solving real engineering problems— spanning model orchestration, tool integration, memory systems, inference services, data flows, evaluation loops, and real-time decision systems.

This is a systems-first AI role focused on building intelligent platforms.

What You’ll Do

A core part of this role is building scalable Agentic AI platforms that empower developers, significantly boost engineering productivity, and accelerate AI adoption across the organization.

Architect and evolve the AI platform powering Adobe Engineering — with a strong emphasis on Agentic AI systems and LLM-native architectures.

Design and implement scalable orchestration layers that coordinate LLMs, tools, APIs, memory stores, and multi-step reasoning workflows.

Build production-grade agent frameworks that support planning, task decomposition, tool invocation, multi-agent collaboration, and persistent memory.

Develop high-performance inference and runtime systems with strong guarantees around latency, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency.

Design evaluation and feedback systems that measure reasoning quality, task success, hallucination rates, and agent behavior — enabling rapid iteration and continuous improvement.

Integrate first-party and third-party foundation models into cohesive, adaptive systems using routing, model selection, guardrails, and fallback strategies.

Design data flows, session-level intelligence, and contextual memory systems that allow agents to operate coherently across interactions.

Partner with applied research, product, and platform teams to bring intelligent agentic capabilities into real developer-facing experiences.

Drive architectural strategy for AI for Engineering — connecting models, reasoning engines, tools, and data streams into adaptive AI systems.

Mentor senior engineers in modern AI system design, LLM orchestration patterns, and agent platform architecture.

What You’ll Bring

10+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems, AI platforms, or intelligent service architectures.

Deep understanding of how LLMs behave in production environments — including prompting strategies, reasoning chains, tool usage, grounding techniques, hallucination mitigation, guardrails, and evaluation patterns.

Strong experience building AI-powered systems using LLM orchestration frameworks, model routing strategies, and multi-model pipelines.

Hands-on experience designing agentic systems — including reasoning loops, memory persistence, tool integration, state management, and multi-agent coordination.

Proven expertise in building scalable, cloud-native, microservices-based architectures with strong observability and reliability.

Experience designing evaluation systems for generative AI quality, task completion, and behavioral robustness.

Proficiency in TypeScript, Python and at least one systems language (Java, Go, C++), with experience building production AI services.

Strong systems thinking — ability to connect model capabilities, runtime constraints, and product requirements into coherent architectures.

Excellent multi-functional communication skills, with experience influencing architectural direction across research and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience architecting AI assistants, copilots, or agent platforms in production environments.

Experience working with multimodal generative systems (text, image, video, motion).

Familiarity with tool-augmented LLM systems, RAG architectures, vector databases, and contextual memory systems.

Exposure to evaluation frameworks for generative AI quality and safety.

Experience contributing to open-source AI frameworks or publishing technical thought leadership.

Join the Adobe Cyber Defense Center as a Senior Incident Response Commander. Lead Incident Response: Direct end-to-end response activities, ensuring alignment with partners and timely resolution. 

Investigate & Analyze: Examine data from active and historical cases to uncover attack vectors, root causes, and emerging threats. Lead investigations to drive actionable findings and inform response strategies. 

Report & Communicate: Deliver clear, actionable reports and updates to leadership and technical teams. 

Provide Technical Expertise: Guide team members, fix complex issues, and produce technical documentation. 

Drive Continuous Improvement: Conduct post-incident reviews and implement lessons learned.

Investigative Skills: Demonstrable ability in resolving complex cases; law enforcement or government experience is a bonus. 

Analytical & Communication Skills: Comfortable analyzing large datasets under pressure and presenting findings clearly. 

Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with frameworks like FedRAMP, ISO 27001, SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI-DSS. 

Collaborative Approach: Thrive in multi-functional environments and foster team growth.

Experienced Professional with a bachelor’s degree, minimum of 10 years of relevant experience, demonstrated success in Global M&A and large-scale integrations, proven ability to lead and collaborate with diverse cross-functional teams

Background in GTM, Lead to Quote, and enterprise systems (e.g., ERP, CRM, HRIS)

Focused leader with a consultative approach to problem-solving, expert at bridging technical-business gaps and leading through uncertainty with a hands-on approach

Machine Learning Engineer

Focus: From Research to Product | Digital Video & Audio

Location: Noida / Bengaluru

The Opportunity

Adobe’s Digital Video & Audio group develops some of the most innovative and popular creative tools worldwide. These include Premiere, After Effects, and Audition, available on desktop, mobile, web, and cloud.

AI is fundamentally transforming how creators imagine, produce, and share content. We’re looking for a passionate Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about turning innovative research into intuitive, reliable product experiences used by millions of creators worldwide.

In this position, you will work closely with senior engineers, applied researchers, and diverse collaborators to turn experimental ML prototypes into scalable, production-ready systems. If you enjoy tackling complex machine learning problems in video, audio, and multimodal media — and feel driven by having your innovations incorporated into real products — this is an outstanding chance to create meaningful impact.

You will gain hands-on exposure to production-scale ML systems while directly crafting how AI powers Adobe’s creative ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

Drive the development of ML-powered features from early-stage research prototypes to robust production deployments.

Compose, build, and optimize scalable ML pipelines for video understanding, multimodal intelligence, and generative AI applications.

Implement, experiment with, and fine-tune brand new deep learning models across Computer Vision, Video AI, and Generative AI domains.

Solve real-world creator challenges involving spatial, temporal, and multimodal data.

Lead model evaluation, benchmarking, validation, and performance optimization to ensure high quality and reliability.

Optimize and deploy models across heterogeneous environments (CPU/GPU/NPU), including ONNX and CoreML workflows.

Improve model efficiency through quantization, pruning, distillation, and inference acceleration techniques.

Write clean, modular, maintainable, and well-tested production-quality ML code.

Collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, product managers, designers, and platform engineers to deliver impactful roadmap-aligned features.

Remain updated on emerging ML techniques and actively integrate innovations into video and media workflows.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

5+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or related domains.

Proven experience building, scaling, and deploying ML models in production environments with measurable impact.

Strong proficiency in PyTorch (preferred) or TensorFlow, and Python-based ML development.

Solid foundations in mathematical modeling, including Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, and optimization theory.

Deep understanding of core ML principles: model training, validation, generalization, and performance trade-offs.

Strong grasp of deep learning architectures including CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, and multimodal models. Clear understanding of when and why to apply each architecture for spatial, temporal, or cross-modal tasks.

Practical experience in computer vision tasks such as object detection, segmentation, tracking, video understanding, or temporal modeling.

Familiarity with model optimization and deployment techniques including pre/post training quantization, ONNX, CoreML, and edge deployment.

Understanding of software engineering guidelines including version control (Git), testing frameworks, CI/CD, and code review processes.

Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and curiosity to learn in a fast-evolving AI landscape.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within diverse, high-performing teams.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Develop AI systems that support millions of creators around the world.

See your ideas move from research to real-world impact.

Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers.

Address significant, large-scale ML challenges in video and media.

Grow in an environment that values innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.

Adobe is seeking a visionary Director of Global Enterprise Events Narrative to redefine how we tell our AI story across global events, where strategic, high-impact conversations happen with global brands, C-suite decision makers, and industry thought leaders. This is a high-profile, strategic role that plays a critical part in advancing Adobe’s enterprise narrative and strengthening executive relationships across industries.

In this role, you will craft and steward the overarching story that connects Adobe’s innovation, vision, and technology at key events globally. You’ll collaborate closely with global and regional stakeholders to bring Adobe’s innovation and impact to life through compelling, customer-centric keynotes, breakouts, and event presence.

The ideal candidate combines strategic storytelling expertise with a strong executive presence, thrives in high-visibility environments, and brings a track record of building and scaling events with professionalism, clarity, and impact.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Define, own, and evolve the global enterprise events narrative. Define a clear, compelling overarching event narrative that elevates Adobe’s presence across all global enterprise events, ensuring consistency, clarity, and strategic alignment, while enabling flexibility for regional, industry, and audience-specific relevance.

Translate enterprise strategy into event storytelling. Partner with enterprise marketing, product marketing, sales, and executive leadership to translate Adobe’s enterprise vision, AI innovation, and customer value into powerful event moments (keynotes, sessions, panels, exec engagements, booth experiences, and more) for key customer groups

Lead keynote development and narrative strategy across the enterprise events ecosystem. Help write and shape high-impact keynote narratives and speaker briefs, ensuring narrative cohesion across the full event ecosystem (flagship events, industry trade shows, regional forums, executive roundtables, speaking opportunities to name a few), ensuring every moment ladders back to the same story.

Partner closely with regional and industry teams. Collaborate with regional marketing, industry marketing, and field teams to adapt the global narrative for local markets, balancing global consistency with cultural, industry, and audience nuance.

Scale storytelling excellence globally. Create repeatable narrative frameworks, templates, and enablement tools that empower teams worldwide to execute consistently and with high quality at scale 

Measure and refine narrative impact. Partner with analytics and marketing teams to assess narrative performance and audience engagement, using insights and feedback to continuously evolve the story.

QUALIFICATIONS

12+ years of experience in enterprise storytelling, event strategy, brand narrative, or executive communications, with a strong focus on global and large-scale events

Proven experience owning and scaling event narratives globally, including adapting a core story across regions, industries and audience types

Demonstrated expertise in writing executive keynotes and shaping key speaking moments for senior leaders

Deep familiarity with the full event ecosystem: flagship conferences, industry trade shows, executive forums, panels, speaking engagements, and more

Exceptional storytelling, writing, and presentation skills, with proven ability to simplify complex technology and business value into compelling narratives that resonate with key customer groups

Strong executive presence and comfort with working in highly visible, fast-paced, ambiguous environments

Proven experience working closely with cross-functional teams across regions and industries

A key leader within Adobe’s Technology Governance, Risk, and Compliance organization. This role partners closely with Security, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and business stakeholders to ensure Adobe’s technology platforms meet global security, regulatory, and customer trust expectations. You will lead enterprise-wide security assurance and compliance programs while building scalable, automated, and continuous assurance

What you will do

Join the Tech GRC leadership team under the leadership of the Sr. Director, Tech GRC, to drive technology compliance activities across Adobe.

Drive APAC security compliance certifications including regional specific compliance programs such as ISMAP, IRAP, etc. and other industry standard audit efforts (SOC2, ISO, PCI, FedRAMP, etc.), while designing AI-enabled approaches to improve audit readiness, evidence collection, and control validation.

Act as an AI-first visionary security compliance leader by finding ways to use AI to transform security assurance, compliance monitoring, and audit reporting. Do this through intelligent automation and predictive insights.

Supervise the development, introduction, and carrying out of internal controls and processes guaranteeing ongoing conformity and risk management.

Plan, outline, and review the design and performance of security controls during GRC reviews.

Coordinate security assurance reviews across Adobe business units, third-party service providers, and cloud environments.

Partner with the Security Automation Engineering team to build AI-enabled, automated GRC workflows that enable continuous control monitoring, real-time risk visibility, and proactive compliance management.

Collaborate with various functions across security domains such as Vulnerability Management, Penetration Testing etc, building a unified working model for continuous assurance.

Establish and apply standards and criteria based on recognized security compliance frameworks for cloud security and governance.

Coordinate security assurance reviews involving fields like User Access Management, Network Operations, Encryption, among others.

Assess business requirements to prioritize the implementation of internal controls according to relevant security frameworks.

Help the team develop and communicate policies, procedures, guidelines, and plans to internal customers.

Build a team of global security experts dedicated to developing and supporting company-wide security compliance capabilities.

Collaborate with partners across multiple geographies for driving cross-functional projects related to security assurance.

Develop goals aligned with business strategy and present status reports with value-based metrics to senior leadership for prioritization and decision-making.

What You Need to Succeed

Bachelor's or advanced degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

Minimum 10-12 years of experience in driving enterprise-level cybersecurity audits and security compliance efforts, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.

Deep expertise in security compliance frameworks and privacy rules relevant to the APAC region (e.g., IRAP, ISMAP, KFSI, SOC 2, ISO 42001 etc.). Insight into how these affect cloud-native and AI-based systems.

Experience In Managing And Leading A Team In A Fast-Paced And Dynamic Environment.

Proficiency in essential organizational processes including SDLC, Identity/User Access Management, Backup and Disaster Recovery procedures, Vulnerability Management, System Monitoring, End Point Security, and Network Operations.

Outstanding interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both business and IT collaborators, including executive leadership.

Demonstrable ability to build and lead high-performing teams, drive central initiatives, and manage multi-functional collaborations.

Role Summary 

The Customer Journeys Technical Consultant leads complex marketing technology implementations across B2C and B2B customers, with a strong focus on Adobe Customer Journey solutions (AJO, Campaign, Marketo, Target). This role combines technical delivery leadership, marketing automation expertise, and consulting capabilities to drive value for our customers and support the growth of our product offerings. 

 

What You’ll Do 

Lead and implement marketing automation and customer journey solutions across B2C and B2B customers, leveraging hands‑on experience with marketing technologies to deliver Adobe Customer Journeys technology—including Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Marketo, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Target, and broader Adobe Experience Cloud. 

Drive marketing personalization, experimentation, and optimization strategies that improve customer engagement, increase conversion, and enhance overall marketing performance. 

Act as a strong partner to Product and Engineering, by providing structured platform feedback, advocating for customer needs, and supporting ongoing product development and roadmap evolution. 

Bring deep industry knowledge and consulting expertise to guide clients through best practices, challenge assumptions, and deliver proactive, prescriptive recommendations that shape their marketing and customer experience strategies. 

Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, ensuring alignment across strategy, design, data, and platform execution. 

Partner closely with project and engagement leadership on executive readouts, escalation management, and proactive risk identification and mitigation. 

Support the creation of delivery frameworks, accelerators, and repeatable processes that improve efficiency, consistency, and customer outcomes. 

Utilize proprietary Adobe AI technologies to deliver an improved and high-quality customer experience. 

Translate customer needs into technical solutions based on a balance of architecture standards and plans, total cost of ownership and feasibility. 

Collaborate with Adobe’s sales and internal teams to grow accounts, ideate solutions and address evolving customer needs. 

Provide mentorship and technical leadership to team members, fostering knowledge sharing and capability growth across the team. 

Produce high‑quality, unit‑tested deliverables and participate in peer testing, including analyzing functional and technical documentation to create test plans, test cases, and test scripts. 

 

Technical & Professional Skills 

Hands-on expertise with B2C and B2B marketing technologies such as: Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Marketo, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Target, 
Responsys, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Cheetah Mail, Braze, HubSpot, and other enterprise marketing platforms; Adobe solutions preferred but not required. 

Strong understanding of marketing personalization, segmentation, experimentation frameworks (A/B, multivariate), and data‑driven optimization strategies. 

Knowledge of the digital marketing ecosystem and the tools, technologies and strategies that support it including CDP, DMP, Paid Media, identity management, marketing automation, data collection & privacy laws. 

Proficiency in HTML, SQL, scripting, data modeling concepts, campaign logic, and workflow orchestration. 

Experience working with and setting up API connections and comfortable using Postman, PostBuster or similar tools. 

Ability to translate business goals and requirements into scalable marketing architectures, data structures, and measurable KPIs. 

Produce clear, well-communicated, complete designs for product features or sub-systems 

Strong consulting skillset, including the ability to deliver industry insights, apply a proactive and prescriptive approach, and confidently engage with executive‑level stakeholders. 

Excellent communication, problem‑solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clear outcomes. 

Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to inform roadmap planning, identify enhancements, and support go‑to‑market strategy. 

Ability to learn on the fly and stay on top of a rapidly changing technology landscape that is heavily influenced by advancements in AI. 

 

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience leading multi‑workstream marketing technology or customer experience programs. 

Background in customer journey design, lifecycle marketing, or marketing analytics. 

Certifications in Adobe Experience Cloud applications or similar platforms.

Our Gen AI Experience Engineering team is at the forefront of integrating AI capabilities across the Adobe Experience Cloud. We operate with a startup mentality, focusing on rapid delivery of value while building scalable solutions through an iterative approach.

The Opportunity

Are you passionate about building engaging experiences that help users understand and interact with data? We are looking for a UI Engineer with deep expertise in data visualization creation to help build next‑generation AI Assistant experiences built upon the Adobe Experience Platform. Working with product managers, architects, and designers, you will develop innovative visualization experiences that bring our AI insights to life.

Impact you’ll make

You thrive when delivering visual experiences that make complex information clear, intuitive, and actionable. You understand the why behind visualization choices—not just how to build them—and can push beyond mundane chart types to craft meaningful, creative, and accessible visualizations. In this role, you will shape how our AI Assistant communicates insights, helping thousands of developers create visualization experiences across Adobe Experience Cloud. Our aim is high: we will change how customers understand their data and reveal insights they never thought were possible.

Main responsibilities

Deliver best‑in‑class, responsive, and scalable visualization experiences for mass audiences

Architect and implement visualizations using React, SVG, and modern data‑viz frameworks

Grow and extend our React Spectrum Charts ecosystem by creating new visualization components and patterns

Apply core principles of visual encoding, data semantics, and perceptual design to ensure clarity and meaning

Integrate UI and visualization layers with REST APIs; parse and transform JSON to shape data for visual consumption

Use D3, SVG, and (optionally) Canvas to build custom charts and graphical representations beyond standard forms

Design, develop, test, deploy, and monitor visualization features with a focus on performance and accessibility

Ensure accessibility of visualization experiences—including ARIA patterns for charts, keyboard navigation, and color‑safe design

Drive efforts to improve technical quality through code reviews, architecture reviews, and testing strategy

Collaborate closely with designers and data partners to ensure visualizations are purposeful, accurate, and expressive

Qualifications

4+ years of professional experience building highly performant and sophisticated web applications with data visualizations

Expert‑level proficiency in JavaScript, React, and front‑end engineering principles

Strong experience with SVG and visualization‑driven engineering (D3 required; Canvas nice to have)

Deep understanding of data‑visualization concepts such as visual encoding, data types, and choosing the right chart for the data

Experience with React Spectrum Charts or comparable visualization frameworks

Practical understanding of light statistics, including distributions, trends, correlation, and outlier detection

Strong experience with preparing and transforming data for visualization

Expertise in responsive web design and front‑end performance optimization

Experience with testing frameworks such as Jest and Cypress

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with English proficiency

Passion for building meaningful user experiences; crafting thoughtful visual communication is second nature

Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and how they inform or generate visualization content

Nice to Have

Experience designing or extending charting libraries or visualization systems

Experience with GraphQL, or writing RESTful APIs

Knowledge of load optimization, cloud deployment strategies, and CI/CD pipelines

Full‑stack engineering experience

Experience with real‑time visualization or interactive data exploration interfaces

Job Description

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Director, Sales Process Owner to lead and deliver global Sales process and systems transformation at scale. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role designed for an individual with deep expertise in Sales process transformation across multiple SaaS companies, who is excited to own outcomes as part of Sales at Adobe!

The Process Owner brings a strong external perspective on what "great" looks like in modern SaaS Sales, paired with the ability to pragmatically apply that expertise in a complex, real-world environment. This role is accountable for understanding the Sales business end to end, translating strategy and seller needs into future-state process and capability designs, and ensuring those designs are delivered through systems, data, and enablement.

This role serves as the voice of Sales to IT, representing seller requirements and business priorities while partnering closely with technology leaders to deliver scalable capabilities. The Process Owner manages the capability roadmap within their Sales process domain. This includes process, systems, data, and personas. They lead a team responsible for completing that roadmap!

Key Responsibilities

Sales Process Transformation & Ownership

Own and transform end-to-end Sales processes within a process domain (such as opportunity management & forecasting or renewals and customer base expansion)

Develop a deep understanding of Sales strategy, operating models, seller workflows, and business requirements.

Be accountable for process outcomes including seller productivity, speed, data quality, compliance, and customer experience.

Future-State Design & Roadmap Management

Design the future-state Sales processes and capabilities aligned to company growth strategy and go-to-market motions.

Own and manage the capability roadmap for assigned Sales process areas, inclusive of process, systems, data, and personas.

Identify gaps between current state and future state and sequence initiatives to drive meaningful transformation.

Balance standardization, scalability, and flexibility across regions, segments, and routes to market.

Business Requirements & Technology Partnership

Represent the voice of Sales with IT, Product, and Engineering teams.

Translate Sales business needs and future-state designs into clear, prioritized business requirements and success criteria.

Partner with IT to deliver capabilities that enable Sales processes through CRM, automation, analytics, and AI.

Ensure delivered solutions meet Sales needs and drive adoption and measurable impact.

Cross-Functional & Executive Leadership

Partner with Sales Leadership to align process transformation priorities to revenue goals.

Collaborate with Sales Ops / RevOps, Legal, Finance, Product, and IT to ensure processes are executable, compliant, and scalable.

Act as a senior leader and decision-maker when tradeoffs arise between speed, control, and scale.

People Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop a team of process architects and business analysts

Set clear goals, accountability, and development plans for the team.

Establish consistent standards, methodologies, and ways of working for Sales process design and delivery.

Governance, Adoption & Measurement

Establish and lead governance forums to review roadmap progress, prioritize investments, and manage risk.

Define benchmarks and success metrics to evaluate Sales process efficiency and transformation progress.

Inspire change management, enablement, and communication to ensure strong adoption by sellers and managers.

Qualifications

10–12+ years of progressive experience leading Sales process and systems transformation within SaaS companies and/or management consulting.

Demonstrated experience delivering multiple, large-scale Sales process transformations, preferably as a management consultant serving SaaS or technology clients, or as a process architect or owner across multiple SaaS companies.

Deep expertise in end-to-end SaaS Sales processes and operating models, including enterprise, mid-market, SMB, and partner-led motions.

Proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear future-state process designs and executable roadmaps.

Strong experience defining business requirements and partnering with IT, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver CRM and Sales technology capabilities.

Hands-on expertise with CRM platforms (Salesforce and/or Microsoft Dynamics) and adjacent Sales technologies.

Experience influencing and aligning senior Sales leaders and executives without direct authority.

Prior people management experience, including leading teams through complex change.

Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to represent Sales credibly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics CRM

Prior experience at a leading management consulting firm dedicated to Sales, Revenue Operations, or commercial transformation.

Experience transitioning from consulting into an internal transformation or process owner role.

Experience leading global Sales process standardization across regions.

Familiarity with business architecture frameworks, value streams, and capability modeling.

Experience using AI, automation, and analytics to transform Sales execution.

Lean, Six Sigma, or similar process excellence certification.

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience; MBA preferred.

Who This Role Is Perfect For

This role is ideal for a former or current management consultant who has led multiple Sales or commercial transformations for SaaS or technology clients and is now looking to:

Move from advisory work into a role with direct ownership and accountability for outcomes

Apply proven transformation frameworks while adapting them pragmatically inside one organization

Act as a senior thought partner to Sales leaders, not just a process executor

Shape how Sales operates at scale, rather than optimizing around the edges

The Opportunity

From the moment you wake up in the morning until you go to bed at night consider the media you consume, the adverts you see, the apps you use, the websites you browse and almost all of the shopping you do online throughout the day. Chances are that every single one of those interactions, every single one of those experiences, was touched by an Adobe product.

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Senior Enterprise Account Executive as part of the Digital Experience sales team to be based in Amsterdam.

The role blends the daily activities associated with corporate strategic selling with specific customers, as well as driving new business in existing client organizations and those where Adobe has little or no footprint. In addition, you can expect to be working very closely with the respective Marketing, Consulting and Presales specialists supporting your vertical to develop new value propositions, build awareness and reveal new sales opportunities.

What you’ll do

You will be in charge of developing business on named accounts by positioning and selling the entire Digital Experience portfolio.

Develop a sales plan to reach sales quota and executes for current customers.

Builds and maintains a sales forecast.

Follows best practices in sales processes/procedures.

Assists with the development of new sales tools and presentations.

Reviews market to determine customer needs and reports back changing market conditions to management.

Presents special programs to partners.

Develops and maintains senior-level relationships within target accounts. 

What you'll need to succeed

Proven enterprise sales track record (10-15 years) in a Software Vendor, ideally in Digital Marketing Software or CRM.

Experience achieving a sales quota of at least $2M.

Experience in acquiring key customer contacts & customer-oriented profile.

Ability to operate at C-Level within our customers (CMO's & CTO's).

Strategic understanding of Multichannel and Digital Marketing.

Sophisticated selling capabilities.

Creativity, Integrity, Phenomenal teammate.

IT backend knowledge (CMS, WCM, SOA..).

Exceptional organizational, presentation, and communication skills.

Fluency in Dutch and English is required.

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Principal Enterprise Architect Professional Services to join our team based in Madrid.

As a Principal Enterprise Architect Professional Services, you will guide architecture through the transformation lifecycle. You will build executive confidence, govern design decisions, lead architecture build, and make sure technology choices support long-term value.

What you’ll do

You will bridge business goals and technical delivery by designing target architectures, planning transitions, and creating decommissioning strategies. Using change management frameworks such as ADKAR, you'll support adoption and sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

Assess and advance the architectural intent crafted during pre-sales.

Provide architectural leadership across the full transformation lifecycle and guide platform adoption and evolution.

Convert the success roadmap created during pre-sales into a comprehensive, managed transition plan featuring clear sequencing, decision points, and risk controls.

Formulate robust, industry-specific architectural perspectives and translate them into target-state architecture, reference models, and phased implementation plans.

Foster and maintain executive trust in architectural direction, serving as a strategic advisor to senior business and technology collaborators.

Collaborate with licensing and services sales teams to improve major sales initiatives.

Coordinate architectural efforts among delivery teams, subject matter experts, and partners to ensure build integrity and alignment during execution.

Establish and lead architecture governance and assurance forums.

Partner closely with pre‑sales teams to ensure lessons learned, build patterns, and reference architectures continually improve future pursuits and delivery outcomes.

What you’ll need to succeed

Proven experience providing enterprise architecture leadership across large-scale transformation programmes, from early visioning and pre-sales through delivery, adoption, and platform evolution.

Strong grounding in TOGAF principles and lifecycle-based architecture governance, applied pragmatically in complex enterprise environments.

Broad understanding of digital marketing, data, and activation ecosystems.

The ability to craft compelling narratives that translate architectural choices into business-relevant results and messages suitable for executives.

Experience operating as a trusted architectural advisor to senior executives.

Strong understanding of AI, automation, and emerging agentic models, and their implications for enterprise platforms.

Experience working closely with delivery teams, partners, and vendors to maintain build integrity.

Ability to apply structured change and adoption approaches (including ADKAR) to support the human and organisational aspects of architectural evolution.

A collaborative, outcome-focused leadership style, with a relentless focus on value and adoption.

Fluency in English and Spanish is required. Any other european language would be a plus.

The Opportunity

Adobe Cloud Platform & Collaboration (ACPC) builds the cloud infrastructure behind Photoshop, Firefly, Express, and other creative tools used by millions every day. We're looking for a Cloud Software Engineer who wants to take ownership of services that creative professionals around the world rely on.

You'll join a team of four to nine engineers that designs, builds, and operates microservices at scale across multiple cloud regions. We follow a "You build it, you own it" philosophy, meaning you'll have real responsibility from architecture through production. You'll collaborate with teams in Hamburg, the US, and India, working on problems where reliability, security, and performance matter every day.

What you'll Do

Develop and operate Java microservices that power Adobe’s cloud platform, supporting a large global audience

Improve the performance, reliability, and security of services your team owns end-to-end

Apply modern engineering practices and AI-assisted tooling to make development faster and more productive

Raise the quality bar through code reviews, testing strategies, and thoughtful system design

Work closely with your team and collaborate across engineering and product organizations

Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, shared ownership, and open collaboration across teams

What you need to succeed

5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, ideally in cloud-native environments

Strong programming skills in Java; additionally, Go or C++ would be a plus

Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservice architectures, and cloud platforms such as AWS

Hands-on experience with Spring, RESTful APIs, and NoSQL databases like MongoDB, Cassandra, or DynamoDB

Familiarity with observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or Splunk

Clear communication skills in German and English

Curious about modern development practices, including AI-assisted development and automation

What We Offer You

Real impact at scale: your work directly enables millions of users to create and collaborate

Ownership and autonomy over the services you build, from design through production

A global, diverse team that brings different perspectives to hard problems

2–3 on-site team days per week at our Hamburg office at the Fish Market, with flexibility to work from home

Growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding team, where you can take on more responsibility over time

Not sure if you meet every point? Apply anyway. We care about what you can contribute, not a perfect checklist.

The Adobe Content Platform & Collaboration (ACPC) is the cloud foundation that enables millions of people to create, store, and collaborate on creative content every day. 

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep experience building cloud‑native systems to help evolve this globally distributed foundation. In this role, you’ll work on backend services operating at massive scale, with high expectations for reliability, security, and performance.

Design, build, and operate Java‑based cloud services, owning them from design through production 

Evolve scalable, secure, and reliable capabilities using modern cloud and distributed systems practices 

Improve system performance, resilience, and operability across multiple cloud regions

Work closely with partner teams that build on our services

8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend or platform focus 

Strong Java programming skills and a solid understanding of distributed systems 

Hands‑on experience with cloud‑native services (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

Build cloud platform software that empowers everyone to create, trusted by customers around the world and designed to work reliably at global scale

Job Title: Principal Value Consultant

Job Summary

We are seeking a strategic Value Consultant dedicated to advancing the development of our Value Consulting organization at Adobe. This role emphasizes building compelling arguments to demonstrate the value of Adobe Firefly Services and solutions to prospective clients while driving sales and customer adoption. The ideal candidate will possess a solid grasp of software sales processes, value-based selling, and have experience translating technical features into business benefits. They will also have a solid understanding of go-to-market and business skills to help customers understand how to use Adobe software to drive business outcomes and present to influencers as well as executive decision makers.

Key Responsibilities

Develop Business Cases: Work with sales teams, including Account Executives, Solution Consultants, and Solution Architects. Build detailed arguments to demonstrate the return on investment and value of our software solutions. 

Design Value Frameworks: Refine frameworks for value consulting that can be consistently applied across different products and client scenarios.

Client Engagement: Work directly with clients to understand their needs and challenges, in order to articulate how Adobe solutions can create measurable value for their business.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product management, marketing, and leadership to ensure alignment on value messaging and capability. Gather insights that inform argument development.

Training and Enablement: Create and deliver training sessions for sales teams to enhance their understanding of Value Consulting methodologies and to equip them with tools for effective client engagement.

Metrics and Reporting: Help develop and support objective and key results to measure the effectiveness of value consulting initiatives and provide data for regular reports to senior management on progress and outcomes.

Market Research: Stay updated on industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs to continuously refine value propositions and argument strategies.

What you need to succeed:

Masters in Business Administration (MBA), Marketing, or a related experience.

5+ years of experience in a consulting, sales, or product management role within the software industry.

Strong understanding of case development and value-based selling principles.

Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information in a clear and compelling manner.

Proven track record of collaborating with cross-functional teams and getting results in a fast-paced environment.

Analytical approach with the ability to interpret data and insights to inform strategic decisions.

Familiarity with financial modeling and analysis.

Experience in customer engagement and relationship management.

Knowledge of software solutions and technology trends relevant to our industry.

The Opportunity

The Adobe Customer Solutions Engagement Manager leads substantial, innovative engagements for critical Adobe accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor and strategic guide, you help Sales and Delivery teams align projects with customers’ objectives. Recognized as a business contributor and delivery specialist, you are the primary customer contact in a billable capacity. You drive the delivery of desired results while preserving strong executive connections.

This position merges excellent delivery and client relationship supervision, concentrating on client and partner communication, cross-functional teamwork, and technical skills to advance business transformation. Success requires collaborating across people, process, and technology with an industry or customer practitioner perspective to produce measurable customer value.

What You'll Do

Customer Engagement & Delivery Leadership

The role manages the success of a defined set of strategic Services customers in the region. It ensures customer requirements are met and that engagements deliver measurable business value aligned to customer priorities. It acts as the primary contact for customer executives and coordinates with partners across the customer’s broader ecosystem. After contract booking, it ensures a smooth and efficient transition from Sales to Delivery. It works closely with Sales, Delivery, and Product teams to align on customer success plans and find opportunities to drive value across Adobe solutions. It serves as the main point of contact at senior management level, resolving customer issues quickly and keeping engagements on track.

Operational Excellence

You are responsible for driving accurate and effective revenue management, including growth and margin execution, revenue acceleration, backlog burn, contract expiration and extension management, and close alignment with Adobe Finance and Operations.

You manage the Services team by coordinating team staffing, onboarding, and transitions within the assigned account(s).

Services Expansion & Opportunity Development

You will partner closely with Adobe Sales to build new services opportunities and support contract extensions, change requests, and addendum. You contribute strategic feedback to account planning in collaboration with the wider account teams, and lead efforts to renew and expand Customer Solutions relationships with existing clients by demonstrating a deep understanding of customer objectives and the scope, activities, and resources required to achieve them.

What you'll need to succeed

8+ years of hands-on experience in professional services, consulting or customer delivery experience of large programs, preferably in SaaS or enterprise software.

Experience with enterprise level project or program management.

Proven track record of building positive relationships, managing complex customer engagements and leading transformation.

Passion for operational rigor and customer value, with a proven ability to collaborate, lead and influence in a matrixed organization.

Strong business insight and industry expertise with ability to speak to value drivers and use cases in customer's context via experience-based story telling.

Ability to effectively navigate complex client situations and act as a change agent for our clients and within Adobe Services.

Strong written and verbal communication skills in both German and English, executive level presence and experience in working in a client advisory role.

Able to travel to support client engagements.

Bachelor’s degree, with an MBA or equivalent experience preferred.

Digital marketing experience is preferred.

About the Role

Join us at Adobe as a Data Science Engineer 2, where you will play a pivotal role in our Experience Insights team, located in Noida. This is an outstanding opportunity to work with world-class technologies and contribute to meaningful projects that impact millions of users globally. Your work will be integral to our mission of delivering outstanding digital experiences.

Key Responsibilities

Compose, build, and operationalize LLM-based models and pipelines to analyze user chat, conversation logs, and other unstructured text data.

Apply advanced text analytics techniques, including classification, clustering, sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and summarization.

Work hands-on with large datasets using SQL and data querying tools, integrating data from multiple sources such as chat logs, transaction data, clickstream, and customer attributes.

Translate analytical outputs into clear, compelling stories and insights tailored for business and senior leadership audiences.

Partner with the data engineering team to build and improve the data/insights infrastructure. Craft vital reports and dashboards to communicate insights visually. These tools enable self-service and scalability.

Required Skills and Experience

5 to 6 years of experience in data and text analytics, data science.

Expertise in LLM-based modeling, data science, SQL, and web analytics.

Proven ability to handle large datasets and derive actionable insights.

Strong communication skills to present technical information to non-technical audiences.

We are looking for someone who is ambitious and determined to make a significant impact by successfully implementing analytics solutions that compete on a global scale. Join us and be part of a team dedicated to outstanding innovation and flawless execution!

The Opportunity 

Frame.io is transforming how creative work happens by supporting over 1 million creative professionals to collaborate effortlessly from across the globe. As Frame.io continues to scale and integrate more deeply across Creative Cloud, strong execution and operational clarity are essential. 

We are hiring a Director of Program Management and Operations to lead the execution of Frame.io’s most important initiatives and to own the operating foundation of the business. You will manage a team, partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership, and help ensure the organization is focused on the right priorities. Frame.io is a meaningful growth and integration priority for Adobe. This role has real ownership and impact, shaping not just what gets delivered, but how the organization operates and scales over time! You’ll work on problems that matter and help define the next chapter of a product used by creatives around the world. 

What you’ll do 

Lead and scale technical program management 

You will own execution across Frame.io’s highest‑priority, cross‑functional initiatives. This includes complex technical programs that span product, engineering, design, platform integration, and go‑to‑market partners. 

 

You’ll work with leaders to translate strategy into clear plans, align teams around outcomes, surface risks early, and drive decisions when tradeoffs are required. Your role is to bring clarity and momentum to work that would otherwise be slowed by ambiguity, competing priorities, or organizational complexity. 

 

Build and lead a high performing team 

You will manage and develop a team of senior and principal technical program managers. This includes setting expectations for impact and ownership, coaching individuals through complex challenges, and creating clear growth paths for people at different stages of their careers. 

You will play a key role in hiring and onboarding new talent, with an emphasis on developing internal candidates and building a strong leadership bench. Creating a culture of accountability, trust, and continuous improvement is a core part of this role. 

Business Operations 

In addition to program execution, you will own the operating rhythm of the Frame.io business. This includes planning and tracking work across quarters, partnering with Finance on headcount and investment decisions, and ensuring leadership has clear insight into progress, risks, and dependencies. 

You’ll help design and maintain operating mechanisms such as planning cycles, reviews, and execution tracking that are effective without being heavy. 

Be a trusted partner to leadership 

You will act as a trusted partner to Product, Engineering, Design, and Business leaders. This means helping leaders see around corners, connecting dots across teams, and raising issues early when alignment or execution is at risk. 

You will also help prepare clear, concise materials for leadership forums and decision reviews, and ensure decisions are translated into action across the organization. 

What we’re looking for 

We’re looking for a strong operator and people leader who brings judgment, empathy, and a bias for action. 

You likely have: 

10 plus years of experience leading technical programs, business operations, or both within a product organization 

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, or comparable practical experience. 

Proven people management experience, ideally leading senior program managers or cross‑functional teams 

Comfort working closely with engineering teams on complex systems and platforms 

Experience operating in a matrixed environment with multiple senior collaborators 

A track record of delivering meaningful outcomes through influence and collaboration 

You bring clarity to ambiguous situations, communicate directly and thoughtfully, and help teams focus on what matters most. You care about building strong teams and creating an environment where people can do their best work. 

Experience in creative tools, collaboration platforms, or enterprise SaaS is helpful, but not required.

The Adobe Document Cloud organization is looking for a talented and highly motivated Software Engineer to help build and deliver our next-generation Adobe Acrobat Sign service.

Adobe Acrobat Sign is the fastest, easiest way to get contracts signed, tracked, and filed. Adobe Acrobat Sign revolutionizes the way the world signs documents. We are looking for an engineer with a real passion for innovation and learning to join the Adobe Acrobat Sign team.

Work hand-in-hand with, engineers, user experience designers and product managers to prototype and build a next-generation web application

Provide technical leadership to solve ambitious design problems to deliver best-in-class user experience

Design & develop key user-facing features, collaborating with the product and the design teams to work on the most optimized and delightful user experience.

Work with other Adobe teams to explore diverse technologies and embrace cross-team standards
