B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent

0-3 years of professional experience developing interactive web applications

Ability to work independently and strong communication skills within and across teams

High proficiency in developing software solutions using web application client-tier technologies, including HTML and typescript/JavaScript, ReactJS,/Web components and React Native

The Opportunity

Firefly Foundry enables organizations to build proprietary, IP-protected generative AI models trained on their own brand and creative assets. As a Manager in Adobe’s Foundry COE Enterprise Sales organization, you will lead a team of sellers responsible for early customer engagement, opportunity development, and driving adoption of Foundry within enterprise accounts.

In this role, you will set team-level strategy, define execution priorities, and shape how your sellers engage with customers in this emerging market. You’ll take the broader direction established by the Director (SLM) and translate it into clear operating plans, territory approaches, and repeatable motions for your team.

You are both a strategic leader and a hands-on coach — driving clarity, sharpening deal strategy, and guiding your team through complex enterprise engagements. You’ll partner closely with cross-functional leaders to ensure field insights directly inform product evolution, positioning, and GTM iteration.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, brings strong sales and product intuition, and is eager to help build a new motion from the ground up.

What You’ll Do

Team Leadership & Direction Setting

Lead, develop, and mentor a team of Foundry sellers focused on strategic enterprise opportunities.

Set direction for your team — defining quarterly focus areas, customer engagement strategies, and early-market plays aligned to Foundry’s broader GTM.

Establish the operating rhythms, goals, and performance expectations that drive a culture of accountability and execution excellence.

Act as a player-coach, supporting key deals while empowering sellers to lead with confidence.

Strategic Sales Execution

Shape the team’s approach to segmentation, account prioritization, and early-market validation.

Guide sellers in articulating value, identifying high-impact use cases, and developing multi-threaded enterprise relationships.

Partner with regional and enterprise leadership to ensure alignment in account coverage and customer strategy.

Lead deal reviews, sharpen deal strategy, and ensure consistent execution across the sales cycle.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate deeply with Product, Engineering, and Strategy to share structured customer insights from your team’s engagements.

Influence product fit, roadmap considerations, and solution positioning based on early patterns observed in the field.

Support rollout and adoption of new product capabilities, messaging, and GTM plays.

Serve as a trusted partner to cross-functional leaders, ensuring your team’s customer learnings meaningfully shape Foundry’s evolution.

Operational Excellence

Drive forecasting accuracy, pipeline discipline, and strong data hygiene across your team.

Identify trends, competitive shifts, and early adoption patterns to inform team strategy and GTM adjustments.

Develop lightweight, repeatable practices and playbooks your sellers can adopt as Foundry scales.

Ensure your team operates with clarity, predictability, and high trust across internal stakeholders.

What You Need to Succeed

Required Qualifications

8+ years of enterprise software sales experience with 1–3 years in people leadership.

Proven success coaching and developing high-performing sellers.

Demonstrated ability to set direction, establish structure, and bring clarity to ambiguous environments.

Strong collaboration skills and comfort working with Product, Engineering, and Strategy partners.

Excellent communication, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.

Understanding of content workflows, digital asset management, or creative operations.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with generative AI or creative automation platforms.

Familiarity with the Adobe ecosystem (Creative Cloud, Experience Cloud, Firefly).

History supporting or scaling early-stage product sales motions.

Background in content-heavy or transformation-focused industries.

What’s In It for You

Lead and develop a team operating at the cutting edge of enterprise generative AI.

Drive foundational customer engagements that shape the future of how organizations use AI for creativity.

Collaborate closely with world-class cross-functional partners.

Grow your leadership career within a high-visibility, high-impact organization.

The Sr. Executive Assistant provides strategic and high-level administrative support to executive leadership in Employee Experience (HR), enabling operational excellence and efficient business execution. Strategic & Operational Support 

Anticipate executive needs and proactively align schedules, priorities, and resources to meet organizational goals.

Prepare and synthesize materials for executive reviews, leadership meetings, and presentations. 

Collaborate with finance, communications, and HR business partners on planning, budgeting, and organizational communications. 

Executive Partnership

10+ years of administrative experience, including 4+ years supporting executive leadership (VP level or equivalent).

Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with proven diplomacy and professionalism across all levels of an organization. 

Demonstrated ability to influence culture and contribute to organizational success beyond administrative duties. 

You think strategically while delivering flawlessly. 

You operate with grace under pressure and navigate ambiguity with sound judgment. 

You are a trusted partner who amplifies leadership impact and strengthens team connectivity. 

You bring curiosity, innovation, and continuous improvement to every aspect of administrative operations.

The Project Graph team is looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of our Graph platform, a core, highly technical product used to design, visualize, execute, and share complex workflows through graph-based systems. Project Graph powers both an advanced node-based editor and downstream, simplified experiences built on top of those graphs.

This role sits at the intersection of UX, systems design, AI-enabled workflows, and platform thinking, and requires deep empathy for advanced users such as developers, technical artists, ML practitioners, and designers.

As a principal-level PM, you will define long-term direction, tackle ambiguous problems, and work closely with engineering, design, and leadership to scale a powerful, performant, and extensible graph authoring and execution platform.

What you’ll do

Define the long-term vision and roadmap for the Graph platform, including the editor, execution model, plugins, APIs, extensibility, and interoperability across products and surfaces.

Define what “great” looks like for graph-based authoring across beginner, advanced, and expert users, including transitions between power-user tooling and simplified downstream experiences.

Lead discovery efforts to deeply understand user workflows, pain points, and mental models in graph-based and automation-driven systems.

Translate complex user needs into clear product requirements, PRDs, and success metrics across both authoring and execution.

Collaborate with design to shape interaction patterns for node creation, connections, layouts, debugging, inspection, and working at scale.

Partner closely with engineering to break down large, ambiguous problems into shippable increments without losing architectural coherence.

Work with engineers on architecture-level decisions affecting performance, data models, rendering, and execution to ensure the system performs well with large graphs and real-world workloads.

Understand and influence systems such as graph execution models, state management, serialization, versioning, and reproducibility.

Define platform primitives that enable reuse, sharing, and distribution of graph-based workflows in different contexts.

Act as a bridge between user needs and technical realities, setting clear outcomes while avoiding prescriptive implementation decisions.

What you need to succeed

8–12+ years of product management experience, with significant ownership of complex, technical, or platform products.

Prior experience with node-based editors, visual programming tools, workflow builders, automation systems, or graph-based products, direct or adjacent.

Proven track record of shipping and iterating on sophisticated user interfaces used by expert or technical users.

Strong systems thinking with the ability to reason about interconnected components, constraints, and emergent behavior.

Deep empathy for power users and creators who rely on precision, speed, debuggability, and flexibility.

Comfort working closely with highly technical engineering teams on performance-critical, architecture-heavy systems.

Ability to operate independently at a principal level while influencing cross-functional partners.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially for complex and abstract concepts.

Bonus points

Background in developer tools, creative tools, game engines, VFX pipelines, ML tooling, data platforms, or automation systems.

Familiarity with graph concepts such as DAGs, execution graphs, dependency graphs, and scheduling.

Experience with extensible platforms, plugin systems, SDKs, or scripting environments.

Experience shipping products that combine authoring tools with runtime or execution environments.

Exposure to AI-driven workflows, generative systems, or model orchestration tools.

The Opportunity

We are the market leader in software products and services for the creative & marketing ecosystem with Creative Cloud, Document Cloud, Express, Firefly and Experience Cloud.

Adobe has made industry-leading progress in addressing the enterprise need for new, scalable ways to create ideas and assets with GenAI-infused workflows and products. We are looking for an outstanding Applied ML Research Engineer to research, design, develop and deliver high-profile products that span GenAI features and customization of GenAI Firefly models to empower the next generation of enterprise creators and marketers everywhere by turning creative intent into creative success. · Research, train, and deploy SOTA ML models for enterprise use-cases

· Leverage LLMs to analyze complex data and build advanced knowledge-extraction and insight-generation systems

· Build and optimize agentic AI workflows that enable users to dynamically interact and refine outputs from ML systems

· Develop scalable frameworks to evaluate the accuracy, robustness and usability of complex AI agents

· Partner closely with product, UX, business development and strategic partners to translate AI innovations into enterprise-grade production features

· Collaborate with AI Research team to constantly explore and evaluate emerging AI technologies and transform research ideas into interactive prototypes

What you need to succeed

· B.S. or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field

· 4+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying ML models in production

· Demonstrated expertise in training, finetuning, optimizing LLMs / large-scale models

· Proficiency in Python and deep knowledge of leading ML frameworks and libraries

· Strong passion for AI-driven innovation and a track record of delivering impactful, production-grade AI solutions

· Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment

Real passion for building new tools and technologies, continuous improvement is the goal.

Role Description

The Technical Pre-Sales Enterprise Architect (EA) serves as the primary technical driver for closing strategic sales opportunities and enabling customer success through marketing technology value realization. For Adobe’s Top 50 customers, the EA partners with technology, promotional, and executive-level contacts. They assess current-state technology and business objectives. They deliver future-state marketing architectures, manage digital engagement roadmaps, and showcase “Art of the Possible” experiences.

Minimum Qualifications

Past experience in a lead consultative role supporting large-scale enterprise digital marketing ecosystems as an Architect, Principal Consultant or Marketing/Technical leader.

Working knowledge of end-to-end digital marketing MarTech, such as CDPs, Marketing Automation, omni-channel personalization, Journey Orchestration, Measurement and Optimization, Content Management, Content Generation, Digital Asset Management (DAM), Tag Management and Data Collection, Identity and Consent Management, CRM, Media Execution, Social Media Management, Reporting/Insights, and multi-channel activation.

Demonstrated ability aligning diverse stakeholders, managing dependencies, and driving schedule adherence to achieve strategic deal closure.

Significant hands-on experience using enterprise platforms (Adobe, Salesforce, Oracle, Microsoft, etc.) with an emphasis on REST APIs, Cloud Storage, Structured/Unstructured Data, Security and Data Ingress/Egress.

Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, value-focused narratives for technical, marketing, and executive audiences.

Skilled at diagnosing business and technical gaps and crafting forward-looking architectures aligned to strategic outcomes and measurable business value

Strong written and verbal communications skills with particular expertise in PowerPoint and Lucid Chart/Visio

Ability to travel up to 30% of the time within the United States

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (CS), Digital Marketing or MBA or equivalent experience

Skills that Set You Apart 

One or more current Adobe Certified Expert certifications in Adobe (RTCDP, AJO, Analytics/CJA, AEM, Target or Workfront)

Recent experience building enterprise level ROI-focused Business Cases for technology transformations

Hands-on experience architecting and/or delivering native, Flutter or React-Native mobile applications

Deep understanding of B2B marketing strategies, buying journeys, and account-based engagement models.

Experience managing a Book of Business, including overseeing the ecosystem to drive deal closure, performing scope and contract reviews, and tracking value realization.

Experience with AI technologies and ability to support AI adoption in marketing use cases, accelerating onboarding to Adobe solutions and driving measurable customer success.

Proficiency with bringing to bear Generative and/or Agentic AI solutions.

The Opportunity

The Global Integrated Marketing team drives Adobe’s enterprise B2B marketing strategy by crafting cohesive, cross-channel campaigns that connect with audiences worldwide and ensure every touchpoint reflects business objectives, on-brand messaging, and customer needs.

We’re seeking a Principal to lead a set of global B2B marketing campaigns and own the end-to-end strategy—from planning and orchestration to performance analysis! This role will partner closely across the marketing ecosystem on execution, messaging, and content development to drive measurable results. Do you enjoy working cross-functionally and seeing your campaign vision come to life? We'd love for you to join our team.

Responsibilities

Campaign Strategy: Lead the development of marketing strategies that span regions and channels and align marketing goals with overall business objectives and target audience needs.

Channel coordination and consistency: Streamline efforts across cross-functional teams to implement campaigns effectively and ensure a unified strategy across marketing channels.

Market & customer knowledge: Stay on top of innovation and industry trends, competitive landscape, marketing capabilities, customer behavior, and new technologies to inform campaign strategy. Have an in-depth knowledge of common business challenges our customers face and how Adobe products help solve those challenges.

Reporting and optimization: Monitor and report on marketing campaigns, using metrics to assess performance and optimizations needed. Develop and communicate insights, optimizations, and/or pivots needed through run-the-business and quarterly business reviews.

Cross-functional influence & accountability: Extensively collaborate and influence key team members, working closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Digital and Events centers of excellence, BDRs, and senior leadership. Communicate effectively at various levels regarding marketing objectives and outcomes.

Deliverables and Outcomes

Development and communication of end-to-end campaigns planned and in market

Facilitate a degree of coordination across centers-of-excellence and for the execution of campaigns across channel, content, and related teams

Ensure consistent messaging and alignment across all channels

End-to-end campaign performance analysis and insights, including finding opportunities for optimization that elevate the impact of our B2B marketing

What’s Needed to Succeed:

Significant experience in B2B marketing planning, including managing a range of marketing programs and tactics.

Proven ability to design and implement global, multi-channel campaigns that align with business priorities and drive measurable outcomes.

Strong background in analysis and performance optimization, including reporting and insights to inform pivots and improve return on investment.

Outstanding communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.

Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments—anticipating challenges and proactively solving them.

Skilled at influencing and steering large-scale initiatives without direct authority, with a positive attitude that encourages collaboration and momentum!

Clear, informed perspective on what 'good' looks like across all facets of campaign marketing.

The Opportunity

Firefly Foundry is seeking a strategic, results-oriented leader to serve as Head of Product Strategy & Business Operations. This role sits at the center of our product organization, ensuring operational excellence at scale, shaping long-term strategy, and driving portfolio performance. 

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to translate vision into measurable outcomes. This is a highly visible role requiring structural thinking, strong financial acumen, and the ability to influence at the executive level. 

 

What you'll do

Translate Strategy into measurable outcomes 

Convert long-term strategy into actionable operating plans, investment priorities, and performance targets. 

Lead annual planning, quarterly prioritization, and long-range strategic planning processes. 

Ensure every major initiative has clear business cases, defined ROI, and measurable success criteria. 

Drive disciplined tradeoff decisions across the portfolio based on impact, capacity, and financial return. 

Own Portfolio Performance & Capital Allocation 

Oversee portfolio-level margin, cost structure, ROI, and investment efficiency. 

Partner with Finance to manage budgeting, forecasting, and resource planning. 

Implement capital allocation frameworks that optimize return on product investments. 

Establish leading and lagging indicators that connect execution to financial outcomes. 

Lead quarterly business reviews with clear performance narratives and corrective actions. 

Design and implement the Operating Model 

Build and continuously improve the Firefly Foundry operating rhythm (OKRs, governance forums, intake processes, roadmap reviews). 

Define decision rights, escalation paths, and accountability mechanisms. 

Standardize planning artifacts, KPI dashboards, and reporting structures. 

Increase transparency and predictability across product development cycles. 

Identify operational inefficiencies and implement process improvements to improve velocity and output quality. 

Drive Cross-Functional Execution Excellence 

Align Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM around shared objectives and measurable outcomes. 

Ensure roadmap commitments are realistic, capacity-aligned, and financially justified. 

Improve cross-functional handoffs and reduce execution friction. 

Establish performance management mechanisms that surface risks early and enable course correction. 

Lead with Accountability 

Build and lead a high-performing product strategy and business operations team. 

Set clear performance expectations and measurable objectives for the team. 

Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making, ownership, and continuous improvement. 

 

 

What you'll need to succeed

12+ years of experience across product strategy, business operations, product management, finance, or consulting. 

5+ years in Director/Sr. Director-level leadership roles with enterprise impact. 

Demonstrated experience owning portfolio-level business performance and operational governance. 

Track record of leading annual planning, resource allocation, and budgeting processes at scale. 

Experience operating in complex, multi-product organizations. 

Operational & Financial Discipline 

Expertise in P&L management, forecasting, cost modeling, and ROI analysis. 

Experience building KPI frameworks and performance dashboards that drive executive decisions. 

Strong understanding of capacity planning, investment tradeoffs, and capital efficiency. 

Ability to create structure in ambiguous environments and improve organizational predictability. 

Leadership & Influence 

Executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders. 

Structured, analytical thinker with strong judgment and decisiveness. 

Proven ability to hold teams accountable while maintaining trust and alignment. 

Skilled at driving change across matrixed organizations without direct authority. 

Education 

Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent operational experience strongly preferred.

Role Summary: 

The Professional Development Enablement Creator will play a critical role within the Customer Solutions & Innovation Team and focuses on designing, developing, and curating educational content, training materials, and resources to improve employee performance and professional growth. This role typically acts as a bridge between subject matter experts (SMEs) and the workforce, turning complex information into engaging, actionable, and scalable learning experiences, often using tools like Learning Management Systems (LMS), video, and interactive modules. The Professional Development Enablement Creator must be a proactive problem-solver with strong customer-first thinking, attention to detail, understanding program management and an eye for user experience. 

What You’ll Do: 

Content Creation & Development: Design, write, and produce training materials, including e-learning modules, videos, job aids, playbooks, and self-service resources. 

Strategy Execution: Collaborate with business leaders, SMEs and individual contributors to execute leadership vision & strategy and create role-specific learning paths. 

Content Management & Design: Owning the content management for enablement resources and design for easy navigation for end user. 

Curriculum & Asset Management: Maintain a centralized repository of training materials (LMS), ensuring content is accurate, up-to-date, and easily searchable. 

Impact Analysis: Monitor the adoption and effectiveness of training initiatives through data, analytics, and feedback to ensure continuous improvement. 

Onboarding & Development: Develop and maintain structured onboarding programs to accelerate time-to-productivity for new hires. 
 

What You’ll Need to Succeed: 

Bachelor's degree required in Change Management, Organizational Design, Communications, Marketing, Education, or similar field. 

5+ years of proven experience in video editing or content creation, particularly in a corporate or educational setting and preferably in a SaaS or technology company. 

Proficiency in e-learning software, learning management systems and video creation tools. 

A portfolio demonstrating excellence in diverse content creation, editing styles and, ideally, education content. 

Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain continuity, pacing, and visual storytelling standards. 

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional, agile team environment. 

Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. 

Experience in a customer-centric or customer solutions environment is highly preferred. 

Experience with technical delivery of the Adobe Digital Experience product suite is a plus. 

 

Performance Measurement: 

This role will be measured against a predefined Business-Driven Objective (BDO) that aligns with Adobe Consulting’s strategic goals. The BDO will focus on: 

Increased Time to Value 

Consistent usage of Role-based operating rhythms, included delivery role definitions and rationalization 

Increased automations in delivery processes 

Increased asset reusability 

Defined framework for cross training strategy 

 

Progress toward the BDO will be reviewed quarterly and used to guide performance feedback, team alignment, and strategic prioritization.

The Opportunity

Adobe is looking for a high-energy, driven, and self-motivated individual to join Adobe's Customer Experience Orchestration team as an Associate Business Development Representative supporting our Business Development, Marketing and Sales teams.

This is a net new early in career business development role, and as such, you will be given the opportunity to learn, grow and be successful in understanding the Adobe solutions for the Digital Experience business.

In this role, you will be our first line of contact with prospects. You will excel in establishing meaningful conversations with a variety of IT and C-level decision makers in a variety of industries, and you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop target accounts to generate sales-ready meetings and opportunities.
 

Through account-based sales development, you will identify and build sales pipeline that leads to revenue growth. As a starter role in Adobe, you will have the opportunity to work across a number of different industries, business personas and teams. This role is ideal for a highly motivated early-in-career professional who is resilient and keen to learn new skills in building and executing business development prospecting.

Measurement

As a SDR, you will be asked to sit in differing Business Development roles. Your day to day activities will be at times across differing segments within the organisation. In the future, as your success continues, you will be moved to a dedicated account patch, once your area of specialisation is uncovered and developed. The compensation is 70:30, with ramp sales targets initially.

What You’ll Do:

Generate sales pipeline through inbound/outbound prospecting activities via telephone, video, and email

Build awareness into the account base through regular email campaigns, drive attendance to live and online webinars and assist with event/webinar follow ups.

Research accounts, identify key players, generate interest and develop accounts to uncover and develop opportunities for Adobe’s products.

Handle and overcome prospect objections with confidence.

Become a trusted resource and develop positive relationships with your sales ecosystem and peers.

Update CRM, Outreach, and other tools as necessary to ensure the capture of key activity history & ensure a smooth hand-off to the Account Executive as necessary.

Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Adobe's competitive positioning in the marketplace.

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline generating targets to ensure territory revenue objectives and pipeline linearity.

What You Will Need to Succeed

1–3 years of relevant experience.

A track record of achieving measurable sales goals, in IT, or any other sales-focused environment.

Attention to detail to support accurate entry and management of lead data in a CRM system as required.

Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing and presentation skills

An interest in sales prospecting tactics and technologies.

An interest in marketing technologies.

An interest in developing and learning new skills.

Motivated by individual and team achievement.

Highly organised with the ability to work in fast-paced environment.

Resilience.

Sales Management:

Analyze customer and agent data, business goals, and reports to find opportunities for continuous improvement.

Develop dashboards and performance metrics that highlight key drivers of sales and support performance.

Qualifications:

Postgraduate with over 10 years of experience in Field Sales, Digital Sales, or Service Management.

Expertise in building and maintaining strategic vendor relationships.

Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable strategies.

Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams across shifts, with a focus on achieving high levels of customer satisfaction and service excellence.

In the Enterprise Analytics team, we are tasked with optimizing the performance of the Digital Demand Generation activities through proactive analysis, enablement, and measurement innovation. We are passionate about diving deep into data, building reporting solutions and driving insights to help our partners scale efficiently.
 

The Digital Marketing Analyst will serve as a strategic partner to the Digital Demand Generation organization. This role will drive regular inspection and proactive insights to optimize our owned channel performance and support the efficient expansion of our digital marketing motion.
 

What You'll Do 

Monitor and analyze performance for owned digital channels (e.g., email, webinars) and provide actionable insights to improve engagement and conversion

Support analysis of website traffic and conversion trends to inform optimization strategies

Contribute to regular performance inspection reviews, investigating strategic shifts and providing recommendations

Build and maintain dashboards and reports to track key performance metrics for marketing campaigns and channels.

Collaborate with marketing teams to understand business objectives and deliver data-driven recommendations.

Support A/B testing and additional optimization experiments to improve campaign effectiveness.

Stay informed on digital marketing trends and analytics best practices to continuously improve reporting and insights.
 

What You Need to Succeed 

Degree in Marketing, Statistics, Business Administration or other relevant fields

3+ years of experience in a digital marketing analytics role in a B2B environment

Deep understanding of digital marketing channels, funnel metrics, A/B testing and other campaign measurement frameworks

Familiarity with web analytics tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics), SQL, and data visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

Ability to communicate insights clearly and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

Live SQL assessment with an analyst required as part of the interview process.

The Opportunity 

At Adobe, we're committed to helping our customers deliver unparalleled digital experiences and are looking for a passionate individual to accelerate the effectiveness of our digital marketing motion through data, insights, and innovative measurement methods! In the Enterprise Analytics team, we are tasked with optimizing the performance of the Digital Demand Generation activities through proactive analysis, enablement, and measurement innovation. We are passionate about diving deep into data, building reporting solutions and driving insights to help our partners scale efficiently.
 

The Digital Marketing Analytics Lead will serve as a strategic partner to the Digital Demand Generation organization. This role will drive regular inspection and proactive insights to optimize our marketing performance on the web as well as mentor junior analysts. This role will report, in person regularly to our San Jose, CA Headquarters.
 

What you'll Do 

Drive strategic analytics initiatives to improve the efficiency and impact of our global digital marketing spend with a focus on our paid and owned channels

Lead biweekly performance inspection reviews investigating strategic shifts and providing recommendations

Build out a testing and optimization roadmap for our digital media, with regular readouts on test performance

Combine qualitative and quantitative insights to drive channel and customer-segment level insights that inform targeting, creative optimization and budget allocation strategies

Own the relationship with the Digital Media and Demand Journey leaders, influencing marketing strategy and roadmap priorities

Mentor and guide junior analysts to provide impactful insights and improve the overall quality of analysis.
 

What You Need to Succeed 

Degree in Marketing, Statistics, Business Administration or other relevant fields

7+ years of experience in a marketing science/analytics role in a B2B environment, including with Account-Based Marketing, or as part of a media agency

Experience with SQL and Data Visualization Tools (Tableau, PowerBI etc.)

Deep understanding of digital and offline marketing strategies, funnel optimization, engagement metrics and customer lifetime value optimization

Familiarity with marketing measurement frameworks like MTA, MMM, incrementality testing, A/B and multivariate testing and brand lift studies

Proficient in paid media tracking technologies like UTM frameworks, Adobe Launch, Adobe Analytics, pixels, and conversion APIs across platforms including Meta, LinkedIn, and Google Ads.

Demonstrated experience supporting digital demand generation functions to drive strategic insights and performance improvement

Strong communicator with a strategic attitude - comfortable working cross-functionally and presenting to senior leadership.

Experience with mentoring or managing junior analysts

Highly entrepreneurial and able to operate independently with minimal direction

(Preferred but not required) Experience in driving or optimizing your own digital marketing campaigns. We love former marketeers who can bring their analytics chops as well as speak the marketing language.

Ability to work in person out of the San Jose, CA headquarters 2-3 times weekly required.

About the role

Join the AIF India Foundation team as an AIML Applied Engineer. In this role, you will develop and grow the AI Assistant and agentic core for Adobe Express. These components support Assistant experiences across multiple products. The job centers on server-side tasks. You will build and deploy AI/ML models and microservices, integrate external AI/ML providers, and keep AI features for Express users dependable and scalable.

What we offer

Contribute to Adobe Express and AI Assistant that serve millions of creators.

Build agentic and cross-product AI experiences with a strong engineering and research team.

Exposure to brand new AI/ML and cloud-native systems at scale.

Encouraging and unified setting at AIF India Foundation and Adobe.

What you'll do

AI Assistant development: Build, implement, and maintain server-side components of the Adobe Express AI Assistant (APIs, orchestration, state, tool use).

Agentic core: Contribute to the agentic core that enables cross-Assistant interaction and multi-product workflows (routing, context, handoffs).

Microservices: Develop and improve microservices that deliver AI Assistant and agentic functionalities to clients and other services.

Third-party AI/ML integration: Deploy and manage AI/ML models and APIs (e.g., LLMs, embeddings, specialised models); oversee authentication, retry mechanisms, fallback strategies, and balance cost versus latency.

Cloud & platform: Manage services within cloud environments (e.g., AWS/GCP/Azure); use containers, orchestration, and platform tools for deployment and monitoring.

Collaboration: Work with product, build, and other engineering teams to ship features and improve AI quality and user experience.

Qualifications

Required

4–6 years of software engineering experience, including significant participation in applied AI/ML (model integration, deployment, or ML systems).

BS/BTech (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.

Strong background in server-side development with one or more of the following: JavaScript, Typescript, Python, Node.js; knowledge of REST/gRPC and asynchronous patterns.

Hands-on cloud experience (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure): compute, storage, networking, and managed services.

Solid data structures, algorithms, and system building; comfort with concurrency, scaling, and fault tolerance.

Experience with microservices: build, APIs, service boundaries, and deployment (e.g., containers, Kubernetes or similar).

Preferred

Experience with agentic systems: agents, tool use, planning, or multi-step reasoning in production.

Experience with LLM APIs (e.g., chat, completions, embeddings) and timely response handling at scale.

Familiarity with MLOps practices: model versioning, A/B testing, canary releases, or feature stores.

Experience with observability (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry) and on-call for production services.

Experience in creative or build tools (e.g., Express, Creative Cloud) or conversational AI products.

Experience with AI/ML in production: incorporating or launching models (e.g., LLMs, embeddings, classifiers); understanding of latency, efficiency, and failure modes.

Experience integrating third-party AI/ML APIs or models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, or internal model services).

This is a high-visibility role with real influence on how Adobe shows up in front of customers!

The Art of Sales is changing:

The concept of selling has been around for decades, but businesses are digital now. The way sales are conducted must modernize too.

In most companies, sales teams are somewhere on the journey below:

(1) Sales scratch out their own leads by prospecting their networks, sending one-off or batch emails.

(2) Marketing turns over long lists of leads, which typically contacts in your target audience

On the other hand, we at Adobe – ICX sales are a Modern Sales Team of 400+ Digital sellers, supported by analytics and data science teams. We are integrated with Adobe.com digital marketing & engagement funnel and are developing capabilities on picking cues from the customers demographic (who) & behavioral (what) data that they leave on their journey with our business to predict next ‘sales action’ that will lead to revenue conversions (Future state).

The Challenge: 

We are building a team of Account Managers who will work with a focused cohort of the reseller transacted book of business.

This role is crucial in driving revenue growth through strategic cross-sell and upsell initiatives. 

The incumbent would be responsible for helping the customers adopt the solution with ease, optimizing their product experience and guiding them to internal support teams if need be.

This role entails the entire gambit of account management like Strategic Account planning, Client Need assessment, building connect strategies with multiple stakeholders, conducting extensive account reviews, driving growth through cross selling / upselling and building long term relationships. KPIs for this role will be maximizing Net ARR by growing Gross and mitigating Cancels.

What you’ll do as an Account Manager

Plays a critical role in developing and managing relationships with large customers from ICX book of business.

Build and nurture strong relationships with managers and decision-makers in these large accounts. Expand business relationships beyond IT and Procurement into the C-Suite. You will need to map target org at departmental level to succeed in this role.

Drive revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities. You would be responsible for driving Net ARR from the allocated customers for the various Digital Media solutions.

Account manager’s primary goal will be to understand Customer’s business needs / pain points on document workflows & creative content creation, offer solutions, and foster long-term partnerships that drive business growth.

Identify growth opportunities and revenue potential within the accounts.

Research customer contracts and purchasing history in Adobe's various customer management systems & external sources such as LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, etc. to figure out the expansion opportunity in an account.

Devise customized connect strategy based on the account plan.

Identify the segments that have a high propensity for Adobe’s solutions and then plan customer outreach and meetings.

Sell into multiple levels of an organization, performing outbound prospecting to existing customers to identify new business relationships.

Engage customers daily via Teams / Video calls to conducting extensive account reviews.

During the account review understand clients' strategic goals, challenges, and pain points, and propose tailored solutions to address them. Develop and execute strategic account plans that align with clients' business objectives.

Lead negotiations and pricing discussions to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.

You will serve as a trusted advisor ensuring the successful deployment of products.

Address any issues or concerns promptly to maintain positive client relationships.

Stay informed about industry trends, regulatory changes, and the competitive landscape of Document / Creative domain. Provide clients with valuable insights and thought leadership on industry best practices.

Collaborate with Solution Specialists to maximize footprint of growing Adobe Solution streams like Adobe Acrobat & Sign, Creative Cloud, Substance, Stock etc.

Managing the opportunity pipeline from week to week, providing accurate and timely updates to management on progress and outlook.

Act as the voice of the client within the organization, representing their interests and needs.

MM/SMB Segment exposure and proven ability to manage a large customer set.

4 + Years’ experience in a similar role, with experience in selling SAAS solutions preferred.

Proven track record leading a matrixed organization to sell SAAS solutions and the ability to expand influence to multiple stakeholders in the customer environment

Ability to forge and maintain strong business relationships from IT to the C-Suite.

Excellent communication and presentation skills and capable of presenting with any person, at any level within a customer.

Proven experience of using quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify new sales opportunities.

Should have skills that clearly demonstrate the ability to manage accounts and sell solutions.

Flair for technology and ability to lead a customer conversation with value-selling rather than product features pitch.

EMEA Sales Experience preferably.

Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent

The Opportunity
Adobe is seeking a Staff Machine Learning Engineer/Architect to lead the development of next-generation personalization models and intelligent AI agents within Adobe Experience Platform (AEP).
Our team is building intelligent agent systems that can autonomously design, generate, optimize, and evaluate personalization models at scale. These agents reason over customer data, business objectives, and experimentation signals to create adaptive models that continuously improve digital experiences.
As a senior member of the AI team, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of personalization AI systems, from research and modeling to production deployment, monitoring, and MLOps automation. You will work at the intersection of personalization modeling, multimodal LLMs, agentic reasoning, real-time decisioning, and enterprise-scale ML infrastructure.
This role is ideal for engineers and applied scientists who want to build production-grade AI systems that autonomously power personalization, targeting, ranking, and next-best-action strategies across billions of interactions.
You’ll collaborate closely with Adobe Research, Product Management, and Platform Engineering to ensure AI-driven personalization is not an add-on—but a foundational capability embedded across Adobe’s Digital Experience products.

What You’ll Do

Design and build advanced personalization models including propensity models, recommendation models and systems, uplift models, reinforcement learning, and generative personalization systems.

Develop LLM-powered intelligent agents that can generate and tune personalization models, automate experimentation and model optimization and recommend next-best-actions and targeting strategies

Architect and implement end-to-end ML systems, including:

Feature engineering pipelines (batch and streaming)

Model training and evaluation frameworks

Low-latency inference systems

Build and scale real-time decisioning systems that operate across high-throughput enterprise environments.

Lead MLOps initiatives, including CI/CD for ML, model versioning, monitoring, drift detection, automated retraining, and performance governance.

Drive system reliability, scalability, and observability across distributed ML services.

Partner with product leaders to translate personalization strategy into measurable business impact.

Mentor engineers on modern ML practices, agentic AI design, and production grade ML architecture.

Champion responsible AI and personalization practices, focusing on interpretability, fairness, safety, and user trust.

What You Need to Succeed

Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of experience, or PhD with 5+ years building and deploying ML systems at scale.

Deep expertise in personalization systems, recommendation models, or real-time decisioning architectures.

Some experience with LLMs, agentic systems, prompt engineering, RAG, or context engineering, especially in production environments.

Proven success building and shipping end-to-end ML systems, from research to deployment and ongoing optimization.

Hands-on experience with MLOps best practices, including model lifecycle management, monitoring, automated retraining, CI/CD for ML, and large-scale inference systems.

Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace, LangChain, or equivalent.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to connect modeling decisions to business metrics such as lift, engagement, and customer lifetime value.

Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and demonstrated technical leadership.

Experience bridging research and production in enterprise scale AI applications.

Role Summary:

The Professional Development Specialist will play a critical role within the Customer Solutions & Innovation Team and is responsible for designing, implementing, and evaluating training programs to enhance employee skills and organizational performance. They assess training needs, create educational materials, facilitate workshops, and measure program effectiveness to drive continuous learning, productivity, career growth, and high-quality customer delivery. The Professional Development Strategist must be a proactive problem-solver with strong customer-first thinking, attention to detail, and an eye for user experience.

What You’ll Do:

Develop Professional Enablement Strategy: Develop and implement professional enablement strategy that aligns with business objectives and addresses both internal and external customer needs.

Needs Assessment: Identify skill gaps and training needs through surveys, interviews, meeting with managers, and leveraging the voice of the customer. 

Curriculum Development: Create and update enablement content, including online courses and training documentation. 

Instruction & Facilitation: Design workshops, onboarding sessions, and select & facilitate instructional sessions of outside professional enablement courses. 

Evaluation & Analysis: Analyze training effectiveness, adjusting programs for performance.

Operational management: Develop intake, design and creation processes. Maintain schedules and status reporting of enablement creation progress. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Delivery, Solution Customer Engagement, Strategy & Readiness, and Global Operations to gain alignment or inputs on enablement when needed.

Voice of the Customer (VoC): Use customer feedback and insights, in addition to research on industry trends and audience behavior, and customer feedback to inform enablement planning and prioritization that directly enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.

What You’ll Need to Succeed:

Bachelor's degree in Education, Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related field.

10+ years of proven experience in instructional design, or designing programs at scale, preferably in a SaaS or technology company.

A portfolio demonstrating excellence in professional development strategy, enablement design and creation. Understanding Program Management a plus.

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional, agile team environment.

Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the organization.

Experience in a customer-centric or customer solutions environment is highly preferred.

Proficiency in document development tools including PowerPoint, InDesign, Adobe Express.

Experience with technical delivery of the Adobe Digital Experience product suite is a plus.

Performance Measurement:

This role will be measured against a predefined Business-Driven Objective (BDO) that aligns with Adobe Consulting’s strategic goals. The BDO will focus on:

Increased Time to Value

Consistent usage of Role-based operating rhythms, included delivery role definitions and rationalization

Increased automations in delivery processes

Increased asset reusability

Defined framework for cross training strategy

Progress toward the BDO will be reviewed quarterly and used to guide performance feedback, team alignment, and strategic prioritization.

The Opportunity 

Adobe is seeking a bold, strategic leader to define and scale our global strategy for the Technology sector. This role spans software, hardware, semiconductor, electronics, cloud and platform companies, Professional Services, and Agency Networks, often with complex B2B, B2C and B2B2C value chains. 

As the Global Industry Strategy Lead, Technology, you will define Adobe’s industry point-of-view (POV) and translate it into a globally aligned, cross-cloud (Adobe Digital Experience + Adobe Digital Media) go-to-market (GTM) strategy. You will partner deeply across Sales, Product Management, Product Marketing, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, and Marketing to unify Adobe’s narrative, accelerate pipeline, and drive repeatable impact across regions. 

 

This role sits within the Digital Strategy Group (DSG) and plays a critical part in Adobe’s Global Industry Strategy team—responsible for shaping Adobe’s industry vision, value propositions, and high-impact strategic motions at scale. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Develop Adobe’s POV for the Future of Technology 

Lead the creation of a differentiated, forward-looking POV that demonstrates how Adobe enables transformation across the entire Technology customer and partner ecosystem. 
This includes: 

· Demonstrating value across product-led growth motions, partner ecosystems, B2B commerce models, cloud & platform engagement, and customer lifecycle experiences 

· Shaping strategic use cases across data, personalization, content supply chain modernization, global marketing operations, and unified measurement 

· Developing reusable global assets: frameworks, POVs, use-case libraries, playbooks, industry demos, and Bill of Materials (BOM) content for sales, DSG, and partners 

You will collaborate closely with strategists, technologists, data scientists, partner organizations, and field teams to define what “great” looks like—and how Adobe helps Technology companies get there. 

 

2. Sharpen and Coordinate a Global GTM Strategy 

Translate the industry POV into a globally aligned, high-impact GTM motion. 
You will: 

· Align strategy across sales plays, product requirements, partner motions, and regional needs 

· Ensure GTM motions scale globally—not tied to a single region, account list, or narrow set of priorities 

· Provide input to product and engineering teams around emerging trends, customer patterns, and required capabilities 

· Collaborate with partner teams to define joint assets, accelerators, and co-sell strategies 

This role ensures Adobe shows up to the Technology industry with one coordinated voice and one unified strategy. 

 

3. Drive Influence Through High-Leverage Thought Leadership 

Focus on fewer, more strategic deliverables that scale across the business. 
This includes: 

· Authoring frameworks, POVs, and industry narratives used across Adobe’s global ecosystem 

· Identifying where Adobe has a differentiated “right to win” in Technology 

· Codifying insights from customer work into reusable global assets, such as customer success stories 

· Monitoring industry trends to ensure Adobe stays ahead of market shifts, emerging business models, and new experience expectations 

The impact of your work will be measured by clarity, adoption, and influence—not volume. 

 

4. Engage Executives Strategically (primarily 1:many, and 1:1 for top priority accounts) 

Represent Adobe as a trusted advisor in Technology executive settings. 
You will: 

· Lead Adobe’s involvement in industry events, executive forums, and roundtables 

· Present compelling, strategic thought leadership to C-suite audiences 

· Support high-value pursuits, Customer Experience Center (CEC) briefings, and strategic account engagements 

· Sponsor and cultivate key customers, enabling case studies, customer keynotes, and repeatable stories of impact 

Your goal is to maximize industry influence at scale while supporting the strategic deals that matter most. 

 

5. Amplify Global Marketing and Upskill the Ecosystem 

Partner with global marketing and field teams to amplify Adobe’s Technology leadership. 

 
You will: 

· Shape global campaigns, messaging, and event strategies 

· Guide positioning for AI-driven innovation in Technology 

· Enable DSG, field teams, SCs, BDRs, and partners with reusable training, demos, and toolkits 

· Build a consistent global drumbeat of Adobe-led thought leadership 

This role turns Adobe’s Technology capabilities into a cohesive, globally recognized story. 

 

What You Need to Succeed 

Success is defined by the clarity you create, the global alignment you drive, and the measurable impact on Adobe’s Technology business. 

Ideal candidates bring: 

· 10+ years of experience in the Technology sector (software, hardware, cloud, semiconductor, electronics, strategy consulting, or platform provider) 

· Deep understanding of digital transformation within Technology: customer data, AI/ML, personalization, content supply chain, omnichannel experiences, B2B engagement, product-led growth, and measurement 

· Proven success building and executing strategic transformation programs 

· Experience aligning GTM strategies across sales, product, and partner teams, ideally with global scope 

· Ability to distill complex topics into clear, scalable frameworks and POVs 

· Outstanding executive presence with extensive experience presenting to C-suite audiences 

· Excellent storytelling, narrative development, and written communication skills 

· Highly collaborative mindset with the ability to influence in matrixed environments 

· Comfort navigating ambiguity with an entrepreneurial, opportunity-driven mindset 

· Willingness to travel up to 40%

· Open to candidates in PST, MST and PST time zones, with a strong preference for PST

 

Why This Role Matters 

Technology is one of the most rapidly evolving industries in the world—shaped by AI, cloud-driven engagement, platform ecosystems, new monetization models, and a global focus on speed, scale, and customer-centricity. Adobe’s customers need a trusted guide who can help them reimagine digital experiences across this landscape. 

This role ensures Adobe shows up with clarity, leadership, and conviction—helping define the future of Technology digital experience and enabling both established leaders and emerging innovators.

From the moment you wake up in the morning, until you go to bed at night, consider the media you consume, the adverts you see, the apps you use, the websites you browse, and almost all of the shopping you do online throughout the day. Chances are that every single one of those interactions or experiences was touched by an Adobe product. We have a phenomenal opportunity for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our Digital Experience teams in Munich, Germany! 

What you’ll do

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), we will work together to help our prospects re-imagine their customer experiences using Adobe solutions. You’ll play a key role in building strong relationships with potential customers and creating meaningful sales opportunities for our Account Executives.

We’ll rely on you to engage with high-value prospects, understand their business goals and challenges, and take a truly consultative approach to every conversation. Together, we’ll identify, qualify, and develop opportunities that add real value to our customers and create a healthy, balanced sales pipeline.

You’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Solution Consulting, and Marketing teams as one Adobe team, running inbound and outbound activities across your territory. From researching accounts and identifying decision-makers to leading first-level qualification meetings and handing over well-qualified opportunities, you’ll be involved across the entire early sales journey.

We’ll also count on you to keep our systems up to date and share feedback that helps us continuously improve how we work and grow — because we believe great ideas can come from anywhere!

What you’ll need to succeed

We’re looking for someone who is fluent in German and English and excited about starting or growing a career in Sales or Business Development within a SaaS environment, ideally working with enterprise customers.

You enjoy engaging with people, asking the right questions, and building relationships across different levels of an organization. You’re comfortable managing inbound and outbound activities, handling objections, and qualifying opportunities, while staying curious about our customers’ businesses and challenges.

We value people who take ownership, work independently, and collaborate naturally with others. If you’re motivated, resilient, and eager to learn, you’ll feel right at home here! Maintain deep product knowledge and customer guidelines across our Cloud suite.

Location: Noida

About Us
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands— everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.
We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours.

About Adobe Firefly

Adobe Firefly is the industry's premier generative AI media model, designed to be safe for commercial use. It is now expanding beyond static imagery into high-fidelity Video and deep ecosystem Extensibility, empowering enterprises to generate on-brand content at scale wherever they work.

The Opportunity

Join Adobe’s boldest investment in generative AI as the Director of Product Management for Firefly Enterprise.

This is a dual-mandate role for a seasoned product leader. You will define the product strategy for two critical growth engines:

Firefly Video: Bringing our innovative Generative Video models to enterprise workflows, enabling marketers and creatives to generate, edit, and localize video assets at scale. Extensibility: Shaping how Firefly integrates into the broader enterprise ecosystem—driving our strategy for Plugins (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Figma) and APIs that allow businesses to build custom apps on top of our models.

This opportunity is ideal for a leader who thrives at the intersection of media technology (specifically video), platform strategy, and enterprise SaaS.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Leadership (Video & Extensibility): Define the long-term product vision and strategy for Firefly’s Enterprise Video offerings and our Extensibility platform. You will identify high-value enterprise use cases for generative video and prioritize the APIs/SDKs needed to win the ecosystem war.

Leadership & Coaching: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Product Managers, fostering their development into world-class product leaders who can navigate complex technical domains.

Collaborator Collaboration: Partner closely with Engineering Directors, Compose leaders, and fellow Product Directors in the US and Europe to ensure seamless alignment. You will be the bridge between the "Core Model" teams and the "Enterprise Workflow" teams.

Ecosystem & Partnership Model: Define the product requirements for key third-party integrations (e.g., Microsoft, Google, Slack) and internal Adobe integrations (Express, Premiere Pro, AEM), ensuring Firefly is "everywhere work happens."

Org Impact & Scale: Champion the India product team’s capabilities, working to expand their ownership of critical business lines like Video and Developer Platforms within the global organization.

Strategic Contribution: Serve as a thought partner influencing the broader Digital Media strategy, particularly on how multimodal AI (Video + Audio) changes the enterprise content supply chain.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

18+ years of professional experience, with at least 12+ years in Product Management leadership roles.

Video / Media Domain Expertise: Proven experience building products in the video, animation, or multimedia space. You understand the complexities of video workflows (codecs, rendering, timeline editing) and the needs of enterprise video producers.

Platform & Extensibility Experience: Track record of building API-first products, Developer Platforms, or Ecosystem integrations. You understand how to build products that other developers build upon.

Enterprise SaaS Success: Proven success building and scaling Enterprise products across global markets, with a deep understanding of security, governance, and brand control requirements.

Exceptional Leadership: Ability to inspire trust and alignment across senior leaders, engineering, design, and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams. Strong executive presence is a requirement.

A passion for innovation: A drive to craft the future of work, specifically how Generative AI will transform video production and software interoperability.

The Art of Sales is changing: The concept of selling has been around for decades, but businesses are digital now. The way sales are conducted must modernize too. In most companies, sales teams are somewhere on the journey below:

(1) Sales scratches out their own leads by prospecting their networks, sending one-off or batch emails.

(2) Marketing turns over long lists of leads, which are typically contacts in your target audience On the other hand, we at Adobe – ICX sales are a Modern Sales Team of 400+ Digital sellers, supported by analytics and data science teams. We are integrated with Adobe.com digital marketing & engagement funnel and are developing capabilities on picking cues from the customers demographic (who) & behavioral (what) data that they leave on their journey with our business to predict next ‘sales action’ that will lead to revenue conversions (Future state).

The Challenge: We are expanding a team of Account Managers who will work with a focused cohort of the reseller transacted book of business to expand and grow Adobe’s footprint. This role is crucial in driving revenue growth through strategic cross-sell and upsell initiatives. The incumbent would be responsible for helping the customers adopt the solution with ease, optimizing their product experience and guiding them to internal support teams if need be. This role entails nurturing and co-selling with partners where a rep. will be responsible for the entire gambit of account management like Strategic Account planning, Client Need assessment, building connects strategies with multiple stakeholders, conducting extensive account reviews, driving growth through cross-selling / upselling, and building long-term relationships. KPIs for this role will be maximizing Net ARR by growing Gross and mitigating Cancels.

What you’ll do as an Account Manager

• Plays a critical role in developing and managing relationships with large customers from the ICX-Reseller book of business.

• Build Connects and nurture strong relationships with managers and decision-makers in these large accounts. Expand business relationships beyond IT and Procurement into the C-Suite. You will need to map target org at departmental level to succeed in this role.

• Drive revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities. You would be responsible for driving Net ARR from the allocated customers for the various Digital Media solutions.

• One of the key measurement metrics will be how well a rep can reach out to the large book of business, building connections and engagements.

• Account manager’s primary goal will be to understand Customer’s business needs / pain points on document workflows & creative content creation, offer solutions, and foster long-term partnerships that drive business growth.

• Managing the opportunity pipeline from week to week, providing accurate and timely updates to management on progress and outlook. As an Account manager, you will be responsible and measured on how well you are executing on the key products such as Acrobat, Acrobat AI, Express, Acrobat Sign

• Research customer contracts and purchasing history in Adobe's various customer management systems & external sources such as LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, etc. to figure out the expansion opportunity in an account.

•Devise customized connect strategy based on the account plan.

•Identify the segments that have a high propensity for Adobe’s solutions and then plan customer outreach and meetings.

•Sell into multiple levels of an organization, performing outbound prospecting to existing customers to identify new business relationships.

•Engage customers daily via Teams / Video calls to conducting extensive account reviews.

•During the account review understand clients' strategic goals, challenges, and pain points, and propose tailored solutions to address them. Develop and execute strategic account plans that align with clients' business objectives.

•Lead negotiations and pricing discussions to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes.

•You will serve as a trusted advisor ensuring the successful deployment of products.

•Address any issues or concerns promptly to maintain positive client relationships.

•Stay informed about industry trends, regulatory changes, and the competitive landscape of Document / Creative domain. Provide clients with valuable insights and thought leadership on industry best practices.

•Collaborate with Solution Specialists to maximize footprint of growing Adobe Solution streams like Adobe Acrobat & Sign, Creative Cloud, Substance, Stock etc.

•Act as the voice of the client within the organization, representing their interests and needs.

What you need to succeed

•MM/Enterprise Segment exposure and proven ability to manage a large customer set.

•3 + Years’ experience in a similar role, with experience in selling SAAS solutions preferred.

•Proven track record leading a matrixed organization to sell SAAS solutions and the ability to expand influence on multiple stakeholders in the customer environment

•Ability to forge and maintain strong business relationships from IT to the C-Suite.

•Excellent communication and presentation skills and capable of presenting with any person, at any level within a customer.

•Proven experience of using quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify new sales opportunities.

•Should have skills that clearly demonstrate the ability to manage accounts and sell solutions.

•Flair for technology and ability to lead a customer conversation with value-selling rather than product features pitch.

•Ability to independently give basic product demos to customers.

•International Sales Experience with exposure to NA markets preferably. •Working hours will coincide with the US Time Zones

•Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent

The Digital Strategy & Solutions Group works with Adobe customers across all levels ranging from C-level executives, with a focus on the CIO/CTO, to operational teams to advise on strategies and technology solutions to support customer-experience transformation and digital innovation, diving deep into architecture and identifying prioritized path forward for customers. Our engagements assess a customer’s current state experience ecosystem architecture, define the future-state technical vision Northstar Architecture, assess the gaps between the two, and then provide technical leadership to a sales cycle where we must overcome technical blockers and communicate the business value of a combined solution of Adobe products to customer team members.

The Director of Enterprise Architects, will be managing a team of hard workers who blend technical and business skills to architect solutions for Adobe customers. Helping brands to fully capitalize on the era of digital transformation, so they can deliver personalized and impactful experiences across all devices and channels for their customers through architecture and aligning that to Adobe's solutions. The ability to see, measure, and analyze critical factors such as resources, outcomes, and priorities keeps everyone on the same page, and team members know why their work matters.

Reporting to the head of Enterprise Architecture, this customer-facing leadership role offers a rich opportunity to lead senior and principal architects. This leader will be the primary technical partner for a Sales VP/Industry head and be accountable for technical leadership for that vertical.

What you'll Do 

Act in a sponsorship capacity for deals within assigned patch of business to ensure application of team standard methodologies and procedures while also driving revenue outcomes.

Identify, recruit, hire, onboard, empower, grow, enable, and retain top architect talent.

Prioritize technical workstreams against capacity while driving technical pipeline progression to meet and exceed bookings targets

Maintain operational cadence for reporting and updates that effectively communicates deal status to collaborators on and off the architecture team. Interact directly with individual contributors and leaders in presales, sales, product management, delivery (both Adobe and partner) and engineering.

Live on the cutting edge on Adobe products, industry trends, and competition. Align with Adobe DX processes and standards to ensure uniformity across DX product pre-sales.

What you need to succeed 

10+ Years of architecture experience working with one of the following: enterprise architecture, data architecture, or content architecture.

10+ years of people management experience. Software presales or sales experience. Strong executive presence, presentation skills, and documentation skills.

Ability to operate in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment. Where processes and procedures often need to be adjusted along the way.

Familiarity with Adobe products, especially the Adobe Marketing Cloud and Adobe Experience platform.

Ability to partner effectively with customer IT and marketing leaders. Build rapport with salespeople, sales managers, and other presales staff.

Build relationships with Adobe & partner consultants and delivery leaders.

Solid understanding of current technical and architectural trends and concepts across key Adobe Experience functional areas of Data, Content, and Journeys.

Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills. Including conducting research, developing hypotheses, and synthesizing recommendations.

Good interpersonal skills. Ability to work successfully with people at all levels in an organization. Ability to communicate complex ideas efficiently both verbally and in writing.

Proven track record of multi-functionally in a team environment

Passion for new knowledge, resourceful and able to absorb concepts quickly. Enjoy challenges and learning about industry and technology trends

High level of energy, personal drive, and positivity

Open to remote candidates within US who are willing to travel (as required)

About the Role

We are seeking a Principal Scientist (P60) to define and lead the data and semantic architecture that enables Adobe Firefly’s next‑generation unified foundation models—models that natively combine understanding, reasoning, and generation within a single system.
This role sits within the Applied Science and Machine Learning (ASML) organization and operates at the highest level of technical leadership. You will shape how meaning, intent, and abstraction are represented and learned at foundation‑model scale, influencing multiple generations of models and products. This is a highly strategic individual contributor role with broad organizational impact.

What You’ll Do

Foundation Model Data Vision

Define the multi‑year vision for understanding‑centric data that enables unified comprehension and generation.

Establish core principles for semantic representation, supervision, and curriculum at foundation‑model scale.

Identify limitations in existing data paradigms and drive the invention of new approaches.

Semantic Architecture & Alignment

Design canonical semantic abstractions that bridge perception‑level signals with high‑level concepts such as intent, reasoning, and compositional structure.

Lead the evolution of supervision schemas toward rich, model‑interpretable semantic signals.

Guide the use of multimodal and vision‑language models to bootstrap scalable understanding data.

Data Curriculum & Model Behavior

Define understanding‑focused data curricula across model scale and training phases.

Lead ablations to quantify how semantic data choices affect generalization, controllability, and robustness.

Balance organic, synthetic, and model‑generated data to optimize learning efficiency.

Organizational Leadership

Serve as the technical authority for foundation‑model understanding data across Adobe.

Influence research, infrastructure, and product roadmaps through principled, data‑driven guidance.

Mentor senior scientists and architects; set standards for rigor and reproducibility.

What You Need to Succeed

10+ years of experience in ML, data systems, or AI research, including leadership on large‑scale or foundation models.

Demonstrated impact shaping data, learning paradigms, or representations for LLMs or multimodal models.

Deep expertise in semantic representation, reasoning, and abstraction.

Strong intuition for interactions between data, model architecture, and training dynamics.

Ability to influence senior technical and business leaders through clear technical judgment.

Education

Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field strongly preferred.
