Introduction
The Metrology and Machine Control (MX) cluster develops supervisory control, modeling, and optimization algorithms for the Twinscan platforms. The internship includes exposure to our Metrology Leveling domain, where we measure and model wafer height with nanometer precision to enable high‑quality lithography. You will collaborate with Leveling engineers to understand the necessary domain knowledge. Throughout the assignment, you will contribute to improvements where the ASML and customer will benefit from. This gives you a hands‑on opportunity to experience how Leveling teams work on supporting customer value.
 

Your assignment

Our current patching approach requires stopping most software processes before applying updates. In contrast, MX software is not tightly coupled to real‑time hardware, which opens opportunities to patch software without interrupting hardware activity. A previous internship delivered an initial version of a fast patching tool to support this workflow.
In this internship you will continue developing this tool to make it more robust, scalable, and ready for production. Your work will contribute directly to reduced downtime and more efficient software maintenance. 

Your main responsibilities will be:

Expand the tool to support a wider range of software updates.

Improve the tool to handle lower‑level software changes.

Add checks to validate the contents and safety of each patch.

Increase the reliability and robustness of patch execution.

Improve code quality and prepare components for production use.

Collaborate with engineering experts to gather user needs and test results.

This is a bachelor/master regular internship for a minimum of 3 months but preferably 6 months , 5 days per week (3 days on‑site). The start date of this internship is as September 2026 (but earlier is possible).

To be suitable for the internship, you:

Are a bachelor’s or master’s degree student in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.

Have hands-on Python programming skills.

Preferably bring experience working in a Linux environment.

Communicate clearly and collaborate well with experts from different domains.

Bring some experience with C++; this is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

Introduction

In Fab Logistics Planner is responsible for ensuring stable inventory availability within the customer fab by managing and controlling all material movements between the customer dock and the laydown area in compliance with customer safety and security regulations. Additionally, the IFL Planner leads the planning and execution of FRU move-in activities to enable machine installation to begin.

Job description

The role oversees end‑to‑end material handling operations within the customer fab, focusing on the safe, security and efficient move‑in and move‑out of large and heavy materials. Daily material demands are monitored through internal systems, validated for safety and accuracy, and coordinated with customers and internal stakeholders to ensure that all movements are conducted within approved timelines and pathways.

Material return operations are managed through both standard and emergency processes. Standard return requests submitted through the MHR system are reviewed, validated, prepared for move‑out, and scheduled based on available Milkrun times. When emergency return needs arise from CS or the Material Handler Return system, material readiness is quickly verified and trucking is arranged immediately through the ticketing tool to prevent operational delays.

Rigging activities are planned and executed in collaboration with riggers and customers, securing all necessary equipment, workforce, and safe movement paths in advance. Consolidation opportunities are identified when multiple rigging tasks occur within the same site, enabling more efficient volume handling and reduced operational overhead. The role also leads full‑scope FRU move‑in operations, including worklist creation, unloading scenario planning, equipment allocation, truck scheduling, and path preparation.

Maintaining accurate inventory is a critical part of the responsibility. The Material Flow Tracker is updated continuously to ensure full transparency and correctness, while BCP procedures are executed promptly during network disruptions. Inventory aging is maintained below 14 days on average, and return lead time is kept under 5 days, with ongoing collaboration across teams to minimize non‑SAP items.

Close communication with the customer ensures that laydown areas and material movement paths inside the fab remain safe, available, and properly managed. The role also oversees the collection and return of materials designated as Return for Reuse, ensuring compliance with process requirements.

To support stable and consistent operations, established processes and ways of working are maintained and improved in alignment with stakeholders. The role takes a leading position in managing and utilizing 3PL partners, ensuring that their resources are effectively leveraged to enhance overall material handling performance.

Introduction to the job

ASML manufactures and services complex lithography systems critical to the production of microchips. In this role you will work for Customer Supply Chain management (CSCM), a growing Team responsible for all customer supply chain activities (machines deliveries, upgrades at customer sites, spare parts management).

Introduction to the job

ASML US brings together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Chandler, Arizona, San Jose and San Diego, California, Wilton, Connecticut, and Hillsboro, Oregon.

Within ASML, the Customer Support (CS) sector is responsible for the maintenance and continuous improvement of ASML systems at customer locations. One of the departments in this sector is DUV Upgrades, Installs, and Relocations (UIR) which is responsible for the planning and execution of these projects and provide support to customers and service engineers within the Customer Support organization. The DUV UIR Coordinator is an exciting and challenging position that is a natural development path to Project Leader. Opportunities to build an extensive resource and collaboration network within ASML worldwide and play a key role in daily operations of DUV UIR projects make this position a great foundation to launch a career in Project Management or in many others.

Act as single point of contact for project daily operations.

Prepare and maintain project manpower schedules.

Responsible for ordering all parts and tooling; coordinating material move in and move out of customer facilities.

Deliver consistent daily reporting of upgrade progress and issues to all relevant stakeholders.

Transfer knowledge of the completed system to the local CS regional office and obtain sign off to indicate transfer of the machine back to local office responsibility.

Create post-project evaluation reports detailing all issues encountered including resolutions, lessons learned during the project and post-project machine performance data.

Identify and propose implementation of safety and efficiency improvements that will enhance our predictability in project execution timing.

Drive personal development in Project Management Methodology principles and leadership skills towards becoming a Project Leader.

Introduction to the job

ASML US brings together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers-the world’s leading chipmakers-to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Chandler, Arizona, San Jose and San Diego, California, Wilton, Connecticut, and Hillsboro, Oregon.

As our Upgrade Install and Relocation Engineer, you will be part of a team of engineers who help our Customer Support (CS) organization install, repair and maintain ASML systems at customer sites. You ensure that our chipmaking systems work as they should – and be part of the technology innovation that’s moving the world forward.

Roles and responsibilities

In this role, you’ll be a technical specialist who is expected to calibrate and qualify the machine on site, according to a pre-defined test-sequence similar to the tests that have previously been performed in Veldhoven. You will work with co-workers, and the customer in isolating and solving problems, as well as acting as a resource for users on routine malfunctions. You’ll be responsible for performing administrative and coordination duties, including pass-downs, work orders, field service reports, system problem reports, and monthly reports, as well as preparing written technical reports on an independent basis.

You’ll report to the Senior Team Lead, but you’ll also be part of the larger Customer Solutions & Support sector – where the in-fab installation and optimization of ASML products happens.

As an Upgrade Install and Relocation Engineer, you’ll:

Assemble and qualify the machine on site, according to procedure in a pre-defined sequence.

Build, install and align components to a complete machine.

Install ASML equipment at customer locations, including equipment with new features, pilot and proto systems.

Analyze applicability, accuracy and adherence to design specifications.

Recommend design changes or substitution of materials when appropriate.

Evaluate and diagnose problems and make appropriate repairs.

Work with co-workers and the customer in isolating and solving problems.

Answer customer questions and assist customers in a professional manner.

Provide if appropriate support and assistance to less experienced ASML or local personnel as necessary.

Perform complex adjustments, perform upgrades, diagnose and solve problems with limited support.

Prepare written technical reports if required.

Introduction

The Mains & Safety team within Development & Engineering plays a key role in designing safety‑critical handling systems for ASML’s lithography machines. These systems must perform reliably under a wide range of conditions to support system uptime and product quality. This internship supports that mission by improving how we validate the reliability of I/O modules returned from the field. You will help the team strengthen diagnostic capability while contributing to lower environmental impact and reduced Cost of Goods. This is a chance to gain hands‑on experience in a highly innovative and international environment.

Your assignment

You will design and implement a complete testbench that combines hardware and software to verify the safety, performance, and functional integrity of PLC‑based I/O modules. Your work will help ensure consistent, repeatable, and traceable testing that supports automated decision‑making on module reuse or replacement. You will also deliver clear documentation and present your findings to the team.

Your main responsibilities will be:

Design and build a hardware setup that supports safe and repeatable I/O module testing.

Develop software that measures key electrical and communication parameters.

Create automated pass/fail classification and reporting tools.

Validate the testbench under different operating conditions.

Analyze test results and support root‑cause investigations.

Document the full methodology and write a clear technical report.

Present your approach, results, and recommendations to the team.

This is a bachelor/master thesis internship for 3-6 months, 5 days per week (min. 3 days on‑site). The start date of this internship is as of September 2026, however starting earlier is possible.

Your profile

To be suitable for the internship, you:

Are a bachelor’s or master’s student in electrical engineering or a related degree.

Have practical experience with PLC hardware and TIA‑Portal.

Are analytical and comfortable working with measurement and verification methods.

Enjoy building structured solutions and automating manual processes.

Work collaboratively and take a proactive approach to problem‑solving.

Other requirements you need to meet:

You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship;

Attach your cover letter with a clear motivation why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular;

You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your CV/motivation letter includes the willingness to relocate.

If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement).

As Security incident response team lead, you will take a leadership role within the Security Incident Response Team (SIRT). Your primary focus will be on leading a team of security analysts and play a key role in shaping ASML’s security posture.

Role and Responsibilities

The Security Incident Response Team (SIRT) operates within the Security Operations Center (SOC) to detect and mitigate security threats in real time. As a SIRT Team Lead, you will be responsible for people management, operational security monitoring and security improvements.

You will manage team(s) performance during daily operations and provide process and technical guidance to team members across the board. You coordinate staffing and resource allocation of team members across end-to-end SIRT operations and collaborate with Service Delivery Management for specialist track capacity management and empower end- to-end process execution.

The team of security analysts consists of diverse areas of expertise security incident response (Cyber, IT, OT, DLP, Physical), threat hunting, and driving strategic security improvements. You will play a key role in mentoring security analysts and shaping the organization’s security posture. The main focus points of the role of SIRT team lead:

Develop & grow your team members to support wider ranges of security incidents and become more valuable and well-rounded security analysts.

Identify and implement process level improvements in the team and strengthen the collaboration across ASML together with the rest of the leadership team.

Ensure high quality analysis, documentation and resolution on all security incidents managed in your team aligned with a common documentation way of working across the ASML Security incident management workflow.

Education and experience

This position requires deep tactical, people management expertise, with a balanced technical knowledge, strong analytical skills, and the ability to understand complex security investigations and lead security improvements. The ideal candidate will have:

Strong team development & coaching focus.

Strong stakeholder management and build solid relationships of trust at different levels.

8+ years of management experience, preferably in a multinational corporate security environment.

Proven experience with security monitoring & incident response activities.

The First Line Support Production Engineer is responsible for providing first-line troubleshooting support to ensure uninterrupted production output. Escalate issues to senior FLS when resolution cannot be achieved independently. 

Capture learnings from troubleshooting efforts and use them to write & enhance OCAPs (Out of Control Action Plans).

Create and manage E-Scraps for scrap parts to ensure traceability and accountability. 

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and projects.

A Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics engineering with 2+ years of experience in a production engineering environment

Masters Degree in Mechanical, electrical or Mechatronics engineering and prior internship experience within a production environment

Familiarity with quality processes

Introduction

The Image Alignment EUV group is a collaborative team of metrology specialists who work together to achieve highly accurate alignment of patterns from reticle to wafer. We study machine behavior in detail and translate our insights into models and measurement sequences that run in the scanner software. Our work spans all EUV systems operating in the field today as well as the next‑generation platforms, creating a dynamic and forward‑looking environment.

Our team develops and maintains several calibration actions that keep the scanner performing at its best. These actions complement each other to position the reticle in the optimal object plane and the wafer in the optimal image plane, ensuring every pattern is projected precisely onto the correct location on the silicon wafer. We derive corrections to stage and lens positions from sequences of sensor measurements and model the misalignments detected, accounting for effects such as thermal drift and system behavior over time.

Your assignment
You will explore population data from EUV systems to reveal how multiple calibration actions relate to one another. You will help extend existing dashboards and analytical tools so the team can better understand scanner behavior and improve image alignment performance. You will also contribute to recommendations that support higher accuracy and stability.
Your main responsibilities will be:

Analyze population-level data to uncover calibration dependencies.

Design and implement dashboard extensions that highlight interactions between actions.

Develop or improve scripts that generate data for visualization.

Validate your analytical approach with clear, structured testing.

Summarize findings and propose improvements to scanner behavior.

Document your methods and results for knowledge transfer.

This is a master’s internship for a minimum of 6 months, 4-5 days per week (2 days on‑site). The internship is scheduled to start in September 2026, but an earlier start date is possible.

Your profile
To be suitable for the internship, you:

Are enrolled in a master’s degree in statistics, data science, applied physics, engineering, or applied mathematics.

Have experience programming in MATLAB or Python.

Understand object‑oriented programming principles.

Can analyze and visualize data using platforms such as Spotfire.

Are analytical, collaborative, proactive, and comfortable communicating in English.

Other requirements you need to meet:

Introduction to the job

ASML’s Production Engineer Team in Linkou supports the mature product portfolio—including PAS5500, YieldStar (YS), Reticle Handler (RH), and XT—with over 450 engineers across electrical, software, mechanical, mechatronics and system specialties. 

The team combines the strengths of Development & Engineering (D&E), Manufacturing, and Customer Support to ensure stable factory output, rapid issue resolution, and structural improvements across mature system generations. 

As a Production Engineer (Optics), you will focus on optical module preparation, alignment, calibration, troubleshooting, and system-level optical behavior that impacts factory output. This role emphasizes hands-on optical module diagnostics, problem-solving, production support, and close collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams to drive structural improvements and prevent repeat failures. 

Role and responsibilities

Optical Module Troubleshooting & Analysis 

Diagnose optical issues across PAS5500/YS/RH/XT modules, including illumination paths, imaging modules, optical sensors, interferometric components, and alignment/calibration fixtures. 

Perform optical alignment checks, optical path inspection, contamination evaluation, and basic interferometric or reflective diagnostics. 

Investigate light source stability issues, optical throughput variations, imaging behavior deviations, sensor accuracy concerns, and calibration failures. 

Optics-Related Production Support 

Support factory integration activities involving optical modules, lens assemblies, optical stages, scanning/measurement submodules, and sensor-based calibration processes. 

Execute optical calibration sequences and assess calibration result quality. 

Provide clear containment actions to minimize machine downtime and secure stable production output. 

3rd-Line Engineering & Structural Fixes 

Collaborate with D&E (Optics/Mechatronics/S&C) on deep-dive investigations into optical behavior deviations or sensing inconsistencies. 

Define accurate technical problem statements and support structured root cause analysis (RCA). 

Contribute to ECN implementation and ensure solutions resolve structural optical issues. 

Documentation & Diagnostic Improvements 

Maintain and enhance optical diagnostic procedures, calibration workflows, and troubleshooting guides. 

Identify diagnostic gaps and propose improvements in test steps, alignment checks, or optical evaluation criteria. 

Improve documentation clarity to support both Manufacturing and Customer Support. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

Collaborate with Mechanical, Electrical, Software & Control, Mechatronics, and D&E optical teams to verify findings and drive issue resolution.

Communicate effectively with global stakeholders and ensure proper escalation paths are followed.

Required Qualifications 

Education 

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in: 

Optics / Optical Engineering 

Applied Physics (with optical specialization) 

Photonics 

Electro-Optical Engineering 

Optical Science / Optical Technology 

Or other optics-related disciplines. 

Technical Background 

3-5 years of experience in one or more of the following: 

Optical module assembly, integration, alignment, or calibration 

Optical testing/measurement (laser alignment, imaging, interferometry basics, illumination systems, optical sensors) 

Troubleshooting optical modules or sensing components in precision equipment.

Hands-on experience with optical benches, alignment tools, microscopes, or optical inspection equipment.

Understanding of fundamental optics principles: reflection/refraction, imaging basics, tolerancing, alignment sensitivity, contamination effects.

Additional expectations: 

Ability to interpret optical measurements and identify abnormal system behavior.

Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills for optical/system‑level issues.

Experience supporting production, manufacturing engineering, or equipment troubleshooting.

Familiarity with optical calibration methods, optical inspection tools, or sensor characterization.

Understanding of mechanical–optical interactions and tolerance stack‑up behavior.

Exposure to engineering change processes, structured RCA, or reliability improvement initiatives. 

Basic scripting (MATLAB/Python) for optical data analysis is a plus, but not required.

Introduction to the job

As our Upgrade Install and Relocation Engineer, you will be part of a team of engineers who help our Customer Support (CS) organization install, repair and maintain ASML systems at customer sites. You ensure that our chipmaking systems work as they should – and be part of the technology innovation that’s moving the world forward.

Roles and responsibilities

In this role, you’ll be a technical specialist who is expected to calibrate and qualify the machine on site, according to a pre-defined test-sequence similar to the tests that have previously been performed in Veldhoven. You will work with co-workers, and the customer in isolating and solving problems, as well as acting as a resource for users on routine malfunctions. You’ll be responsible for performing administrative and coordination duties, including pass-downs, work orders, field service reports, system problem reports, and monthly reports, as well as preparing written technical reports on an independent basis.

You’ll report to the Senior Team Lead, but you’ll also be part of the larger Customer Solutions & Support sector – where the in-fab installation and optimization of ASML products happens.

As an Upgrade Install and Relocation Engineer, you’ll:

Assemble and qualify the machine on site, according to procedure in a pre-defined sequence.

Build, install and align components to a complete machine.

Install ASML equipment at customer locations, including equipment with new features, pilot and proto systems.

Analyze applicability, accuracy and adherence to design specifications.

Recommend design changes or substitution of materials when appropriate.

Evaluate and diagnose problems and make appropriate repairs.

Work with co-workers and the customer in isolating and solving problems.

Answer customer questions and assist customers in a professional manner.

Provide if appropriate support and assistance to less experienced ASML or local personnel as necessary.

Perform complex adjustments, perform upgrades, diagnose and solve problems with limited support.

Prepare written technical reports if required.

Education and experience

Bachelor's degree in an Engineering field or equivalent combination of education, skills and experience.

Minimum 4+ years' experience in semiconductor industry preferred. 

Minimum 4+ years' Field Service Engineer work experience preferred.

Minimum 4+ years' experience in using computer applications, including data analysis tools, word processing, spreadsheet, and presentation software preferred.

Knowledge of the semiconductor industry, vacuum system, or plasma is preferred.

Skills

To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:

Can observe and respond to people and situations and interact with others encountered in the course of work. 

Can learn and apply new information or skills. 

Demonstrate open, clear, concise and professional communication and must be able to read and interpret data, information, and documents. 

Strong customer focus and commitment to customer satisfaction through prioritization, quality, efficiency and professionalism. 

Result driven-demonstrate ownership and accountability including the ability to complete assignments with attention to detail and with a high degree of accuracy. 

Proven ability to perform effectively in a demanding environment with changing workloads and deadlines. 

Work according to a strict set of procedures within the provided timelines, as well as identifying bottlenecks and driving improvements. 

Work independently or as part of a team and follow through on assignments with minimal supervision. 

Ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with manager, co-workers and customer. 

Mechanical aptitude and knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, semiconductor processes, and relevant software.

Demonstrate computer application experience, including data analysis tools, word processing, spreadsheet, and presentation software.

Flexibility to expand capability in multiple technical competencies related to system upgrades, installs, and relocations, including mechanical installs (MI) and system integration (SI) competencies.

 As part of Corporate Real Estate (CRE) team, the Hard service specialist will be responsible to manage the Hard services (Facility infrastructure specifically mechanical, cleanroom, gas, HVAC, and other technical building systems) across the CRE Korea region that delivers the Asset Management and Facility Maintenance outsourced services. Our team, ASML Finance Business Insight and Control, act as a coordinating hub to provide insights that ensure high quality decision making across our business. We do this by combining deep business knowledge with advanced analytics and financial control. Our Business Insights and Data & Analytics hub is organized around topics, such as margin analysis and product cost. Job Description

As a Upgrade Install and Relocation (UIR) engineer, you will be responsible for the end-to-end installations, upgrades and relocations adjustments, calibrations, qualification of ASML lithography tools, and customer communication. This role requires a multidisciplinary engineering background and hands-on experience with complex semiconductor equipment in cleanroom environments.

Key Responsibilities

Execute installation and qualification of ASML lithography systems including mechanical, electrical, and software integration.

Perform system troubleshooting, diagnostics, and root cause analysis to resolve installation issues.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams worldwide including project coordinators, system owners, technical support teams and customer representatives to ensure timely and successful system delivery.

Support continuous improvement initiatives for effective installation from preparation through execution to wrap-up including tooling.

Required Qualifications

English – Fluent or Native level

Japanese – Intermediate or above

Technical school, Bachelor’s degree or above in Mechanical, Electrical, Optical, or Software Engineering or equivalent technical discipline. However, we welcome applicants who completed other majors.

Trustworthiness

Respect and care on team members and stakeholders.

Strong communication and documentation abilities in both English and Japanese.

Proactive, professional behavior and curiosity to grow

Flexibility to travel and work in a dynamic, high-tech environment.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Remark

You will work at any customer site across Japan and possibly the world. Business trip to other sites can occur 50-90% of your life.

The Application Engineer supports customer node projects, new product introductions, and the evaluation of new functionalities. (50%)

Support engineering activities for node transition projects and act as the local project lead.

Drive workstreams, coordinate schedules, and manage reporting for both internal and external stakeholders.

New Product Introduction (NPI)

Conduct product evaluations and ensure successful adaptation in HVM environments.

General Responsibilities

Understand customer needs and develop clear problem descriptions aligned with customer use cases.

Study new products and functionalities, and support evaluation activities.

Take ownership and act proactively; respond promptly to issues as they arise.

Lead engineering work and coordinate with ASML experts (ABS, DE, GSC), serving as the engineering interface to the customer.

Collaborate closely with internal departments including Sales, Marketing, and Product Management.

Apply strong problem-solving skills to drive issue resolution.

Provide engineering support for DUV, YS, and VCP.

Execute project management tasks as the local project lead.

Education and Experience

More than 2 years of experience in the semiconductor industry.

More than 2 years of experience in project-related roles.

Skills

Strong capabilities in data analysis, reporting, problem solving, and driving workstreams for node transition projects.

Awareness of cost of ownership and the ability to maximize value delivered by ASML products.

Ability to create clear and user-friendly technical documentation using commonly understood terminology (avoiding ASML-specific jargon when possible).

Troubleshooting skills and proficiency in data analysis.

Software skills: Excel, PowerPoint, MATLAB.

English requirement: TOEIC 600+ with daily conversational ability.

Ability to deliver presentations and lead technical discussions in English both internally and externally.

Japanese requirement: JLPT N1 or native-level proficiency.

Project management skills, including preparation of internal and external management reports.

As a Field Service Engineer (FSE) of ASML Semiconductor equipment (Lithography), You will support the customer with operational equipment support, performance monitoring, mechanical/pneumatics/electrical/optical repairs/servicing, and maintenance. 
In case complicated issue happen, need escalate to upper line to get suitable help in proper timing to secure committed performance to customer.

Analyze applicability, accuracy, and adherence to design specifications.

Collaborate with co-workers and customers in isolating and solving problems.

Take lead to maintain the local SOP/SPS/BKM WOW in Fab Team

Can speak Mandarin or/and Japanese are welcome!

Initiative-taking and flexibility

Work according to a strict set of procedures within the provided timelines.

Strong customer focus and commitment to customer satisfaction through prioritization, quality, efficiency, and professionalism.

Working experience in tsmc Fab is welcome.

Introduction to the job

As a Finance business process expert, you help shape the next generation of ASML’s finance processes. You will contribute directly to ASML’s mission by designing scalable, automated and future-proof service accounting flows that support global growth. In this role, you will work on the foundation in SAP S/4HANA and the finance data model, ensuring our systems and processes keep pace with ASML’s fast-expanding business.

Role and responsibilities

As a Finance business process expert, you act as the hands-on specialist who defines, builds and improves finance processes with a strong focus on service accounting. You take ownership, lead decisions and collaborate closely with finance, IT and architecture teams to ensure successful transformation.

Your responsibilities include:

Design and build end-to-end finance processes for SAP S/4HANA, with a strong focus on service accounting.

Drive improvements in performance management using best practices in processes, data structures and technology.

Work with finance teams, business process owners and business and IT architects to translate business needs into system designs.

Lead and support adoption of new processes by explaining, testing and validating solutions with end users.

Embed internal controls in process designs and support automation initiatives.

Ensure alignment between finance processes, master data and the finance data model.

Contribute expert knowledge during ERP migration activities and help shape future standards.

Education and experience

You bring a strong background in finance operations, service accounting and SAP-based process design.

You have:

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field.

8–10 years of experience in finance process design, service accounting or financial operations.

Deep knowledge of SAP finance solutions (SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA).

Experience with complex business processes, preferably in the service order flows, contracts and billing domain.

Familiarity with automation tools such as RPA.

Experience with ERP migrations and finance transformation initiatives.

Knowledge of SAP revenue accounting (RAR) is a plus.

Skills

Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.

To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:

Communicate complex finance and -system topics in a clear and structured way.

Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across finance, IT and business teams.

Take ownership and lead decisions with confidence.

Show a proactive and curious mindset, always seeking process improvements.

Adapt quickly to change and guide others through transformation.

Apply strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Stay focused on delivering results in a dynamic environment.

Other information

You will join the Transformation & Digital Finance department and report to the Team Lead Business Process Experts. This position is based in Veldhoven and may require limited travel. Strategic Relationship Building:

Number of Net-New SIs Recruited/Onboarded.

Deep understanding of the ASEAN SI landscape, including major regional consulting firms, and mid-market specialists.

Exceptional relationship-building, influencing, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage confidently at the C-suite level.

Strong business acumen and the ability to construct a compelling financial and strategic value proposition for new partnerships.

Introduction

ASML is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of chipmaking equipment and the global technology and market leader in semiconductor lithography. By enabling the production of smaller, more powerful, and more efficient chips, we help drive the advancement and accessibility of semiconductor technology across a wide range of products and applications. ASML is widely recognized as a key force shaping the world’s digital transformation.

Headquartered in the Netherlands, ASML is a global company with more than 44,000 employees and is among the most valuable publicly listed companies in Europe by market capitalization. Our success is rooted in a distinctive culture reflected in our brand DNA: a relentless drive to innovate, combining deep customer insight, a passion for technology, and a can‑do attitude; a collaborative mindset built on integrating diverse perspectives; and a founder’s mentality defined by ownership, accountability, and a results‑driven approach.

Mission

Our global Communications team is committed to engaging our audiences and shaping ASML’s reputation among key stakeholders. In Taiwan and Southeast Asia, we focus on enabling the business and strengthening ASML’s position with employees, prospective talents, ecosystem partners, journalists, and other opinion leaders.

Description

As a senior member of ASML’s regional Communications team in Taiwan, you will lead integrated communications programs across Taiwan, Southeast Asia, and India to support our business growth. You will act as a strategic communications partner to key stakeholders in the region, understanding their needs while translating global Communications priorities into effective regional strategies spanning internal and external domains.

Geographical distance from headquarters creates both unique challenges and opportunities. This role requires high competence across all communications disciplines and a strong understanding of ASML’s business, culture, strategic priorities, and organizational dynamics. You must be able to set priorities, make sound decisions, and ensure excellence in execution. With rapid growth across Taiwan and Southeast Asia, the region requires strong strategic support in branding, reputation management, and internal strategic alignment.

Context of the position

You will serve as a trusted communications partner to key stakeholders across the region, helping shape and protect ASML’s reputation. You will report to the Head of ASML Asia Communications and may occasionally travel to other ASML sites, emerging markets within the region, and the global headquarters in Veldhoven, the Netherlands.

Role and responsibilities

You will be responsible for, but not limited to:

Serving an integrated communications strategist to strengthen ASML’s brand and reputation
With proven consulting, PR and integrated marketing communications (IMC) expertise, you will develop communications strategies that align with the business priorities of ASML’s organizational units across Taiwan and Southeast Asia, as well as global corporate directions. You will also oversee the country-level communications budget, ensuring effective investment and demonstrable impact. You are able to prioritize tasks and resources with minimal supervision while consistently delivering high‑quality results.
 

Crafting messages and telling the ASML’s story 
You excel at developing inspiring and engaging stories. You will identify compelling narratives within ASML and share them with external audiences to enhance the company’s reputation. With a strong understanding of the local media landscape, you know how to build and execute media strategies, pitch stories, and secure meaningful media coverage. You will collaborate closely with the Media Relations team at headquarters and support ASML spokespersons in the region as they communicate with media, government stakeholders, and local communities.
 

Acting as the gatekeeper of ASML’s branding in the region
You will ensure that all internal and external creative assets adhere to ASML’s brand guidelines and accurately reflect the company’s brand identity and tone of voice.
 

Leading project management and other assigned responsibilities
You will partner closely with colleagues across Sales, HR, Society & Community Engagement, ESG, and the broader Communications team to identify opportunities for ASML and to develop initiatives that enhance employee pride and strengthen ASML’s reputation among key stakeholders.
 

Job description subject to change

Education and experience

Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Communications, Journalism or Marketing

15 years proven experience in media relations and integrated marketing communications in a multinational company (preferably in high-tech industry). 

Skills

To succeed in this role, you should demonstrate the following:

Strategic, business, and technology acumen 
You are familiar with industry trends and the technologies that matter to our customers. You can clearly explain corporate strategy and articulate business impact, including financial considerations. You can explain the principles of lithography to a general audience, interpret complex technologies, grasp first‑principle concepts, and help elevate messaging with clarity and precision.
 

IMC (Integrated Marketing Communications) planning and measurement abilities
You possess a strong understanding of the marketing mix and can plan, organize, and prioritize projects effectively. You know how to apply analytical tools and measurement techniques, incorporate metrics into communications plans, and use best‑practice methodologies to assess impact. You proactively propose improvement indicators and data-driven enhancements.
 

Stakeholder management and consultation capabilities
You can manage multiple stakeholders across sectors, identify cross-functional opportunities, set priorities, and deliver outcomes. You can distill issues to their essence, navigate ambiguity, and find mutually agreeable solutions. You adapt your communication style to your audience and provide communications guidance and coaching to leaders.
 

Critical thinking and analytical skills
You translate business objectives into clear, compelling, and meaningful communication programs. You recognize complexity, actively seek understanding, and assess multiple variables and interdependencies. You identify root causes, anticipate opportunities and risks, explore what‑if scenarios, and propose well-reasoned solutions.
 

Goal orientation: assertiveness, tenacity, prioritization, and impact focus
You stay focused on achieving results that deliver clear, positive business impact. You work with confidence and guide others toward outcomes, applying agility to meet evolving objectives. You ensure strategic communications plans are aligned, targeted, and effective.
 

Strong cultural sensitivity
You adapt to cultural differences and ensure that plans, messages, and activities are appropriate for multicultural environments and aligned with ASML’s values.
 

Language proficiency

Local sited Customer Support branches perform these tasks for the customers within the specific region.

Regional Technical Support organization is responsible for providing higher level technical analysis and solution to the escalated issues from Local sited CS branches over the country.

As a regional tech support engineer for a DUV specific technical competences, provide support to internal and external customers by solving escalated problems and providing information to ensure the optimum machine performance criteria are well met in the field.

Role and responsibilities

Responsible to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to equipment and performance problems in various technical competencies.

Solving complex technical problems by remotely analyzing data, creating deterministic forward looking action plans, managing escalations, and delivering on-site support when requested at customer sites

Identify structural solutions to prevent issues from happening again in future, collaboration with the local team FSE or OTS to build up the knowledge and experience database for achieving the goal

Share knowledge, expertise and lessons learned within the organization 

During New Product Introduction (NPI), upskill on new features, and support local sites for the new platforms

Education and experience

Preferably with Master+ degree in any of the following fields (Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Control Engineering, Precision Instrument/Machine Engineering, or related discipline)

Skills

Strong communicator in English (both oral and written)

Strong analytic capability and a pro-active attitude

Flexible in working hours, travel and work environments

Independent personality and work under pressure

Team worker, good social skills, customer-oriented

Able to plan and set priorities.

Flexible attitude with respect to off hour support, travel and overtime.

岗位职责 / Responsibilities
负责客户现场光刻工艺的技术支持，包括工艺开发、优化、参数设定与问题诊断；Provide on-site technical support for lithography processes, including process development, optimization, parameter setup, and issue diagnosis.
深入理解客户产品与制程需求，提供定制化的光刻解决方案；Deeply understand customer products and process requirements to deliver customized lithography solutions.

协助客户进行新产品导入（NPI）过程中的光刻工艺验证与调试；Support customers in lithography process verification and tuning during new product introduction (NPI).
编写并维护技术文档，包括工艺流程、问题分析报告、技术交流材料等；Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including process flows, issue analysis reports, and technical communication materials.
与总部研发、产品、FAE团队协作，推动工艺技术的持续优化与创新；Collaborate with headquarters R&D, product, and FAE teams to drive continuous process improvement and innovation.
跟踪行业最新光刻技术发展趋势，参与内部技术培训与知识分享。Stay updated on the latest industry trends in lithography technology and participate in internal technical training and knowledge sharing.

任职要求 / Qualifications
物理、光学、化学工程、电子电气工程、材料科学或数学相关专业的硕士及以上学历。Master’s degree in Physics, Optical Science/Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or Mathematics.
具备半导体工艺知识。Solid understanding of semiconductor process knowledge
具备较强的演讲和沟通能力，能够与内部（BDM、项目负责人、管理层）及外部客户进行有效交流。Strong presentation and communication skills, capable of effectively interacting with internal stakeholders (BDM, project leaders, management) and external customers.
具备灵活的心态，能够在矩阵型组织中支持各种任务（问题升级、新产品导入、NTP项目等）。Flexible mindset to support various tasks in a matrix organization (issue escalation, NPI, NTP projects, etc.).
能够在压力下工作。能够灵活出差，支持中国境内的客户。Ability to work under pressure and travel flexibly to support customers across China.
出色的中英文双语沟通表达能力。Excellent bilingual communication skills in both Chinese and English.

Introduction to the job

As our Field Service Engineer, you will be an integral part of a team of engineers who assist our Customer Support (CS) organization install, repair and maintain ASML systems at customer sites. You will ensure that our chipmaking systems work as they should – and be part of the technology innovation that’s moving the world forward.

You will be a technical expert who will work with coworkers, customer & field support in isolating and solving problems to maintain and optimize equipment on a daily basis enhancing functionality and prevent problems. You will act as a resource for users on routine malfunctions and will be responsible for the necessary transfer of know-how to the customer.

This position reports to the Site Manager, but you will also be part of the larger Customer Solutions & Support sector – where the in-fab installation and optimization of ASML products happens .

Role and responsibilities

Install equipment at customer’s locations, including equipment with new features, unload components, inspect for damage, assemble, align and test.

Analyze applicability, accuracy and adherence to design specifications.

Evaluate and diagnose problems and make appropriate repairs, escalating when necessary.

Answer customer questions and assist customers in a professional manner.

Advise users of appropriate actions to correct malfunctions and may recommend changes in user procedures.

Perform administrative and coordination duties, including pass-downs, work orders, field service reports, system problem reports, and monthly reports. Prepare written technical reports on an independent basis.

Provide appropriate support and assistance to less experienced ASML personnel as necessary.

May require travel for cross-site support with Intel Chandler and/or other sites.

May require international travel for site support in Taiwan

Education and experience

To help us tackle the technical challenges we face, you’ll need experience working on high-tech products and with complex processes. As a Field Service engineer, you’ll need:

Job Grade 04 - 05:

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or the equivalent combination of education, skills and experience will be considered. 

An associates or technical degree with at least 2 years of technical experience will be accepted. 

At least 2 years of experience using computer applications, including data analysis tools, word processing, spreadsheet, and presentation software is preferred.

Job Grade 06:

A Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or the equivalent combination of education, skills and experience will be considered. 

An advanced degree (MS) with internship(s) experience will also be accepted. 

At least 3 years of experience in the installation, qualification, repair and maintenance of ASML systems at customer sites is preferred.

At least 3 years of experience using computer applications, including data analysis tools, word processing, spreadsheet, and presentation software is preferred.

Skills

Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.

To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:

Work according to a strict set of procedures within the provided timelines

Knowledge of Safety Procedures

Mechanical aptitude and knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, and semiconductor processes, and relevant software.

Can observe and respond to people and situations and interact with others encountered in the course of work.

Can learn and apply new information or skills.

Must be able to read and interpret data, information, and documents.

Strong customer focus and commitment to customer satisfaction through prioritization, quality, efficiency and professionalism.

Ability to complete assignments with attention to detail and high degree of accuracy.

Proven ability to perform effectively in a demanding environment with changing workloads and deadlines.

Result driven-demonstrate ownership and accountability.

Identifies bottlenecks and drives improvements.

Work independently or as part of a team and follow through on assignments with minimal supervision.

Demonstrate open, clear, concise and professional communication.

Ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with manager, co-workers and customer.

Other information

Position will require up to 100 % travel (mostly international) during the first year for training purposes. After training, travel will closer to 25%.

Position will require access to customer site locations.

Ability to work flexible shifts including nights, weekends and holidays.

Willingness to continue learning and growing in a professional environment is necessary. 

Work is conducted at a customer site and requires familiarization with customer rules and policies regarding worksite behavior and safety. 

Expect to spend more than 50% of the time inside the clean room working with electromechanical equipment. 

Position works under the direction of a Manager, Supervisor, or Sr. Engineer.

Physical Demand of the job:

Shift: compressed work week schedule, rotating day shift to night shift; night shift to day shift, every 8 weeks (12hr shifts, 7am/pm-7pm/am).

Routinely required to sit; walk; talk; hear; use hands to keyboard, finger, handle, and feel; stoop, kneel, crouch, twist, reach, and stretch. Occasionally required to move around the campus.

Occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

Your Responsibilities

As a Strategic Buyer NPR, you will:

Build and implement procurement organization structures – in close collaboration with internal stakeholders.

Develop and drive procurement strategy.

Establish and maintain supplier relationships – including the identification of preferred suppliers.

Negotiate and finalize contracts – framework agreements, NDAs, long-term supply agreements.

Shape the supplier landscape – considering technology and product roadmaps.

Conduct audits and assess risks – nationally and internationally.

Prepare management decisions and present at management level – for example, make-or-buy decisions and supplier selection.

You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, e.g., in Industrial Engineering.

You have demonstrated success in leading procurement activities.

You have SAP user knowledge (MM module) and strong MS Office skills.

You bring agile project management skills (advantageous).

You communicate confidently and fluently in both German and English, spoken and written.

You are willing to travel up to 20%.

Introduction to the job

Drive filed XLD (Extra Long Down) into tangible solution and engage CS Central & local team to deliver and implement XLD solution package on systems through XLD strategic analysis reporting and product roadmap
Role and responsibilities
1) Taiwan all XLD cases input data quality management via weekly call with local team and XLD intake improvement roposal IRM process development & solution management
2) XLD Top-X issue data management and report update to the customer and management bi-weekly, wrap up bi-weekly XLD intake post follow up action to drive close loop XLD improvement action, then connect with WS PL to drive solution plan with Central
3) Lead Golden Package introduction and track field implementation, makes plans in cooperation with the customer to actively implement solutions it terms of Patches, FCA, FCO,s etc in order to optimize the machine performance. Also, need to work with WS PL/TL to remove blockers
4) Machine performance related XLD issues are being addressed and coordinated until solved to ensure that the machine performance target(s) criteria are met.
5) Recommends return of investments proposals for applicable solutions to site/customer POCs and share solution updates and content.
 

Education and experience
• Bachelor or Master of Science/ Engineering
• 2+ years of experiences as a 2nd Line Engineer (for internal candidates) or Lithography equipment (for external candidates).
• Project Handling skill

Introduction

ASML is committed to sustainability, quality, and efficiency in its operations. Within ASML, reuse and quality initiatives play a key role in enabling circular economy goals while safeguarding system performance and value.

Reuse‑ and Quality‑driven projects rely heavily on clear KPIs to assess value, risks, and impact. Ensuring alignment, consistency, and transparency across these KPIs is essential to effective project and portfolio steering.

By joining these initiatives, as an intern you'll actively contribute to fact‑based decision making, improved reuse effectiveness, and stronger quality insights across multiple projects.

Your assignment

This internship focuses on supporting reuse‑ and quality‑related projects through KPI analytics and structured insight generation, with a strong emphasis on translating data into business‑relevant and decision‑ready insights. As an intern, you act as the analytics and insight backbone for multiple initiatives, ensuring that projects are data‑ready for steering discussions. The intern does not lead projects or make decisions, but enables the Project Leader to steer based on facts, value impact, and cross‑project patterns rather than spending time on data preparation.

As an intern, you will be responsible for:

1. KPI & Reporting Consistency

Gather and align KPI data from existing BI reports (e.g. Quality KPIs, Reuse KPIs).

Identify and flag inconsistencies in KPI definitions, timeframes, or scope.

Maintain a harmonized KPI dataset that can be reused across projects.

Perform basic data quality checks and trend validation.

2. Project Value Tracking (Reuse & Quality)

For each assigned project:

Track baseline versus post‑intervention KPI performance.

Support measurement of: Quality impact (e.g. DOA, CQN, defect trends) and reuse‑related differences (New versus Reuse).

Maintain standardized project value summaries.

3. Decision‑Ready Analysis Preparation

Prepare structured KPI overviews ahead of project reviews.

Highlight deviations, risks, and notable trends.

Support comparison of multiple scenarios or options (without proposing decisions).

4. Cross‑Project Insight & Pattern Detection

Analyze data across multiple projects to detect recurring patterns.

Identify repeating failure modes, KPI behavior, or reuse signals.

Summarize insights in periodic overviews for the Project Leader.

5. Communication & Material Support

Prepare clear figures and charts, one‑page summaries, and standardized slides for steering meetings.

Ensure consistent messaging and visuals across reuse and KPI topics.

Expected Deliverables

Unified dashboards

Harmonized KPI datasets

Project value one‑pagers

Decision‑ready dashboards or summaries

Cross‑project insight snapshots

Documented KPI assumptions and notes

This is a master internship for minimum 6 months, minimum 3-4 days per week. The start date of this internship is as of September 2026.
Project Leader: Gokhan Ergen.

Your profile

To be a match for this internship, you:

Are a master’s student with a background in Data Science, Business Analytics, Industrial Engineering, or a similar discipline, preferably with a strong business and analytical orientation.

Have strong analytical skills (Excel required; Power BI, Spotfire, or Azure analytics tools are a strong plus).

Are able to translate data and KPIs into clear business‑relevant insights.

Strategic Sourcing & Procurement (SS&P) sector is focus and strengthens collaboration with our suppliers, to secure suppliers meet ASML demand, both in times of ambiguity and in times of steep ramp-ups. Introduction

Do you have the charisma to lead, inspire, develop and empower a team of qualified leaders and professionals in a region where we see growth an many key projects in parallel? Would you like to drive the Supplier Operations department to entirely new levels of operational excellence by standardizing and growing our regional footprint? Are you enthusiastic about optimizing the added value of the teams by excelling operationally and balancing tactical activities while being a reliable and trustworthy leader? And do you have the communication and relation-buildings skills that can create powerful, end-to-end networks that will help you and your team to achieve high-reach targets?

Job Mission

You will be leading a team of ~5 managers, who in turn are leading a team of >60 talented supply chain professionals over 3 different regions (Linkou, Tainan, Korea) and multiple ERP systems (SAP and Oracle) during a time with high projected future growth in a matrix organization.

Driving for collaboration to capture synergies over the different functions and regions is vital. You are an integral part of the SS&P Northeast Asia staff and represent the operational performance of the suppliers. Additionally you are the sparring partner for the staff team in process improvement. Together with the Global Supplier Operations management team, you create, enrich and execute the vision to further optimize local operations in all locations and drive global standardization regardless of ERP system.

Your goal is to align the teams support to the stakeholders within the SS&P clusters, Supplier Collaboration and our regional teams. Additionally you are the bridge to the factory planning teams for material availability. Together with the clusters you drive material availability and supplier escalations and with the Group Sourcing manager you drive the cost down through Cost of Goods negotiations by your team, through driving efficiency in the supply chain and improved ordering processes.

You represent the voice of operations in the regional staff and secure the required support for the teams to be successful. Furthermore, you take ownership as SS&P NEA staff-member and drive results beyond the scope of your team.

Your team enables material availability from our suppliers at the right quality and cost for our factory and field customers. You will drive effectively, timely and compliant execution of the Requestion to Pay process and contribute to ASML’s supplier performance with direct influence on output growth by balancing the teams’ priorities with supplier management activities. Additionally, Supplier Operations Asia is responsible for managing the relationship and performance for >200 (smaller) supplier accounts.

You do this will keeping operational cost and efficiency targets in mind.

Creating a positive and productive work environment is key. Searching for solutions and assuring a certain level of flexibility also under pressure are required to make your job a success. You need to be able to balance between hands on problem solving and zooming out to connect to the long term strategy.

With the focus on development of the Operational Supplier Coordinators and Tactical Buyers in your team, and planning and supporting this development in close collaboration with the Clusters, we aim to be the talent pool for Sourcing and Procurement professionals. This includes actively engaging in the development of individuals by coaching conversations and orchestrate stretch assignments including the required development support.

You will facilitate optimal personal development of all team members and coach them in their short- and long term challenges and career steps. Alongside driving the activities of your team you will work closely together with the other managers of SO in the rest of the world to actively contribute and further develop our Global Supplier Operations department roadmap and participate in structural improvement projects further optimizing our processes and performance.

You are vital to create a safe environment where speak up is valued and appreciated, and where we constructively challenge each other on the content to drive growth in our performance and people, whilst caring for the well-being of our people and teams.

Context of the position

Supplier Operations, a department of Strategic Sourcing & Procurement, represents ASML’s operational logistics & commercial interface to its supply base and is responsible for material availability for ASML’s factories and field. In today’s complex multi-tier supply chains, this is only possible by creating full transparency in the chains and flexibility at suppliers. The department must handle the increased complexity of ASML’s systems while reducing cost of ownership for customers. To do this, SS&P professionals work with suppliers to continuously reduce cycle time for components, modules and assemblies, increasing supply chain flexibility and create customer value.

Other Information

Strategic Sourcing & Procurement is an industry-leading supply-chain management organization, responsible for ensuring material availability to ASML’s factories and customers in the field. Introduction

The Infra team within ASML’s Electronics Development department designs and validates the electrical infrastructure that powers ASML’s advanced lithography systems. As these systems grow in complexity, understanding how they interact with the electrical grid becomes increasingly important. This internship supports that goal by helping the team model and analyze grid impedance under real operating conditions. You will contribute to improving system stability and enabling more reliable performance. This is a hands-on role where your work directly supports future EUV system development.

Your assignment

During this internship, you will investigate how ASML’s EUV systems behave when connected to different grid conditions. You will create a detailed impedance model and validate it with real measurement data. You will also explore additional analyses to help the team better understand system behavior during transients. Your main responsibilities will be:

Perform on-site electrical measurements to capture voltages, currents, harmonics, and other key parameters.

Build an impedance model of the EUV system’s grid using industry‑standard simulation tools (ETAP).

Create simulations to compare measured data with modeled behavior.

Analyze system performance during transients, short‑circuits, and other dynamic conditions.

Investigate load flow, power quality, and harmonic behavior to improve model accuracy.

Summarize your methodology, results, and recommendations in a clear technical report.

Present your findings to the Infra team in a structured and accessible format.

This is a graduate bachelor/master internship for minimum 6 months, 4-5 days per week (3 days on‑site). The start date of this internship is as of September 2026. Earlier is possible in agreement.

Your profile

To be suitable for the internship, you:

Are currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering or a related discipline.

Have a strong interest in power systems, electrical infrastructure, and grid modeling.

Are analytical and enjoy turning complex data into clear insights.

Work in a structured and collaborative way within a technical team.

Are proactive and comfortable working with measurement equipment and simulation tools.

Introduction to the job

As our Field Service Engineer, you will be part of a team of engineers who help our Customer Support (CS) organization install, repair and maintain ASML systems at customer sites. You ensure that our chipmaking systems work as they should – and be part of the technology innovation that’s moving the world forward.

Role and responsibilities

You’ll be a technical expert who will work with coworkers, customer & field support in isolating and solving problems to maintain and optimize equipment on a daily basis enhancing functionality and prevent problems. You will act as a resource for users on routine malfunctions and will be responsible for the necessary transfer of know-how to the customer.

You’ll report to the Site Manager, but you’ll also be part of the larger Customer Solutions & Support sector – where the in-fab installation and optimization of ASML products happens.

As a Field Service Engineer, you’ll:

Install equipment at customer’s locations, including equipment with new features, unload components, inspect for damage, assemble, align and test.

Analyze applicability, accuracy and adherence to design specifications.

Evaluate and diagnose problems and make appropriate repairs, escalating when necessary.

Answer customer questions and assist customers in a professional manner.

Advise users of appropriate actions to correct malfunctions and may recommend changes in user procedures.

Perform administrative and coordination duties, including pass-downs, work orders, field service reports, system problem reports, and monthly reports. Prepare written technical reports on an independent basis.

Provide appropriate support and assistance to less experienced ASML personnel as necessary.

Education and experience

To help us tackle the technical challenges we face, you’ll need experience working on high-tech products and with complex processes. As a Field Service engineer, you’ll need:

Bachelor's degree in an Engineering field or equivalent combination of education, skills and experience.

Knowledge of semiconductor industry, vacuum system, or plasma is preferred.

To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:

Work according to a strict set of procedures within the provided timelines.

Knowledge of Safety Procedures

Mechanical aptitude and knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, and semiconductor processes, and relevant software.

Can observe and respond to people and situations and interact with others encountered in the course of work.

Must be able to read and interpret data, information, and documents.

Strong customer focus and commitment to customer satisfaction through prioritization, quality, efficiency and professionalism.

Ability to complete assignments with attention to detail and high degree of accuracy.

Proven ability to perform effectively in a demanding environment with changing workloads and deadlines.

Identify bottlenecks and drive improvements.

Ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with manager, co-workers and customer.

Introduction

ASML US, LP brings together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, and more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market, and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers—the world’s leading chipmakers—to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Wilton, CT, Chandler, AZ, San Jose, CA and San Diego, CA.

We are presenting you with a unique and exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and innovative source research team, focused on conceiving and demonstrating the technologies required for next generations of high-power extreme ultraviolet (EUV) light sources. Based on a laser produced plasma (LPP), our light source relies on a wide range of unique and challenging technologies, ranging from laser light amplification and high-power optical systems that generate the laser pulses needed for EUV generation to electro-optical signal detection and algorithm-based actuation for process control. You are invited to bring your passion, knowledge and expertise in areas of applied physics, plasmas, metrology, optics, controls, lasers, and experimental design to push the boundaries of these technologies forward.

A key ingredient in the EUV generation process is a stable source of molten tin droplets. These droplets provide the fuel for the laser-produced plasma and serve as the heartbeat for synchronizing the EUV source. The challenge is to reliably produce nearly perfect droplets of molten tin at a rate of tens of thousands of times per second with speeds of dozens of meters per second and position stability within a fraction of a droplet diameter. If these dimensions were scaled up to the game of golf, this would be equivalent to continuously scoring hole-in-ones in a hole that’s 25 km away through swirling gas flows and a plasma that’s hotter than the surface of the sun. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating in this diverse mix of physics, engineering, and materials science in order to define the droplet generator architecture for the next generation EUV source. The successful candidate will also have a passion for innovation, be driven by curiosity, and have deep technical understanding, all essential to excel in a Research environment operating at the fuzzy front end of product development. A strong experimental mindset is needed to measure complex phenomena and decipher the relevant physics, enabling our team to predictably control tin droplet behavior.

Your assignment

Identification of key scientific learning objectives and corresponding experimental design which will further the technological progress of the EUV generation process

Demonstration of system-wide performance targets to meet the future technology roadmap

Develop and execute system and subsystem performance tests, analyze test results and extract actionable knowledge from sub-module to full-system levels

Troubleshoot issues with tin delivery sub systems, ultra-high vacuum systems, and optical modules on our test benches in order to improve our understanding of the fundamentals of droplet generation

Document learning and communicate knowledge to engineering and product development teams to guide product improvement and release of new product nodes

Work independently and in teams to deliver on a stated objective, whether it be the pursuit of new knowledge, the demonstration of a new capability, or the characterization of existing performance

Performs other duties as assigned or required. 

Your profile

PhD [ongoing] or MS degree [ongoing] in Materials Science, Physics, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent field.

Coursework related to data analytics, acoustics, fluid flow, and high-strength materials is a plus.

Deep understanding of scientific methods that guides in designing and executing research experiments with limited oversight is highly desired.

Experience with designing a DOE, building experimental test setups, including setup layout, design, rapid prototyping, metrology selection, setup troubleshooting and respective upgrades is highly desired

Experience with microfluidics, liquid jet breakup and droplet coalescence in particular; piezoelectricity; and/or acoustics is highly desired;

Experience with high pressure applications such as water jet cutting, jet breakup, and nozzle design is a plus.

Experience in the field of ceramics, design and fabrication of ceramic components is a plus.

Experience with droplet formation, sprays, common-rail diesel, and/or injectors is a plus.

Experience with ultrasonic cleaning, chemical cleaning / etching is a plus

Experience with experimental data collection and analysis, as well as development of data analysis tools. Familiarity withMATLAB or Python and data acquisition systems such as NI LabVIEW is a plus.

The successful candidate will not only have excelled in their technical field, but will have demonstrated inter-personal and communications strengths

Ability to clearly and logically communicate ideas and knowledge to various audiences

Demonstrated ability to manage and lead a research project involving multiple stakeholders and constraints

Demonstrated ability to work effectively as a part of a team and lead investigation and research efforts

The Head of Planning collaborates closely with other planning leaders at the Wilton Factory and with the Planning & Development (P&D) departments at ASML headquarters in the Netherlands. In Wilton, the planning department functions as an objective entity, supporting and constructively challenging department managers (Assembly, Optics, Engineering, Logistics) while working in close partnership with the Finance department.

This is a senior leadership role within the Wilton Factory, managing a team of 10-30 employees.

Master Planning

Serve as the primary point of contact for planning cycles with business lines.

Lead the development and maintenance of WF baseline capability plans, ensuring rigorous change control.

Identify and manage planning constraints including facilities, cycle time, tools, and FTE.

Consolidate departmental inputs to maintain and communicate a feasible and aligned plan.

Prepare and present planning scenarios to support executive decision-making.

Production and Shift Planning

Oversee work center planning and proactively resolve bottlenecks for upcoming production starts.

Ensure demand integrity in MRP systems (e.g., system counts, starts, outputs).

Set priorities for order and material releases and dispositioning.

Coordinate with SS&P and Manufacturing Services teams (Material Planning, Supplier Management, Cleanroom Logistics) to ensure timely availability of complete kits at point of use.

Define and monitor inventory levels.

Lead inventory reduction initiatives in collaboration with cross-sector teams.

Develop and implement buffer strategies within the Wilton Factory.

Introduction

ASML US, including its affiliates and subsidiaries, bring together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics.

Cymer is an independently operated business within the ASML group that develops, manufactures and services deep-ultraviolet (DUV) light sources. The product portfolio includes excimer lasers using argon fluoride (ArF) or krypton fluoride (KrF) gases to generate light in the deep-ultraviolet spectrum. These lasers generate the light that photolithography scanners use to image patterns on silicon wafers. The research, development and manufacturing of DUV light sources is centered in San Diego.

The Discharge Chamber is one of the core modules for DUV light sources, where the discharge plasma is generated to provide DUV light (193nm or 248nm). The development goals include extending chamber lifetime, improving energy efficiency and stability, reducing cost, etc. Achieving these goals requires extensive collaboration among plasma physics, material science, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, flow dynamics, and more. If you have a passion for technology and innovation, please join us to develop this complex and challenging DUV discharge plasma chamber!

Role and responsibilities

Ensure all service actions are performed in a safe environment and drive towards a proactive culture of safety first.
