Enable both internal Adobe teams and external customers to deploy high-impact AEP use cases with speed, efficiency, and measurable results

• Follow Agile methodologies using industry leading CI/CD pipelines

• Participate in architecture, design & code reviews

Build and scale applications that augment Adobe Experience Platform’s native capabilities, improving usability, flexibility, and integration for internal teams.

Solid understanding of data pipelines, schemas, APIs, and workflow orchestration.

Strong experience in building knowledge databases for LLM agents.

Proven ability to translate technical complexity into user-centric product experiences.

Hands-on comfort with data analysis (SQL or equivalent) and performance metrics.

Excellent storytelling, communication, and product evangelization skills — can inspire adoption and drive cross-team collaboration.

Experience building lightweight prototypes (e.g., using Figma, Loveable, Cursor) to demonstrate ideas.

Adobe established a Global Payments function in 2020, building teams across four key areas:

1. Partnership Management

2. Payments Strategy

3. Risk Decisioning

4. Payment Operations

Each team is centralized in the United States with a global remit. To enhance the strategic potential of our Payments business, Adobe is seeking an experienced regional leader to complement these central teams.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in LATAM payment processing, particularly in card-not-present and subscription payment models, along with strategies to optimize payment approval rates.

In this role, you will partner directly with the heads of central payment functions and the LATAM regional sales team, while collaborating with Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Product teams. Responsibilities

Build and strengthen Adobe’s relationships with LATAM payment processors and major card networks (Visa, MasterCard, Amex, Carte Bancaires).

Develop strategic partnerships with alternative payment providers to enhance regional and country-specific customer experiences.

Establish relationships with top issuing banks in key LATAM markets, educate them on Adobe products, collaborate on payment optimization strategies, and complete co-marketing initiatives to drive demand.

Serve as the primary liaison between Adobe’s Payments organization and the LATAM sales team, ensuring alignment on strategies impacting payment approvals and declines.

Influence prioritization of payment initiatives on internal and partner roadmaps. Own trade-offs related to build time, feature functionality, and revenue return on investment. Post-launch, lead A/B testing, target measurement, and continuous improvement.

Create reporting and insights to track LATAM payment success trends and strategies driving revenue growth.

Stay ahead of LATAM payment industry trends and regulatory changes, identifying new opportunities and building business use cases for prioritization.

Foster a collaborative team culture focused on cross-functional alignment and data-driven decision-making.

Requirements

15+ years of payments experience, ideally in merchant processing—either with a payment processor, acquiring bank, or managing global e-commerce payments on the merchant side. Experience with issuing banks or global networks is a plus.

Proven ability to lead through influence and get results across LATAM Sales, Product, Treasury, Marketing, Finance, and Operations.

Deep understanding of the LATAM digital payment ecosystem, including trends, regulatory changes, and challenges in card-not-present recurring payments.

Highly self-motivated with the ability to deliver results independently.

Strong communication skills to simplify complex payment concepts and confidently engage senior leaders at banks, networks, and processors.

Ability to build accurate financial models and business usecases that support fast, fact-based decision-making.

BA/BS or equivalent experience required; MBA preferred.

System Design & Architecture

Design, build, and maintain scalable, highly available infrastructure and services for Adobe Pass platform.

Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure new products and features are designed with reliability and scalability in mind.

Create resilient architectures that prevent downtime and enhance service reliability through redundancy, failover strategies, and automated recovery mechanisms.

Automation & Tooling

Develop automation frameworks for continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and operational tasks.

Build tools to monitor system performance, reliability, and capacity, reducing manual interventions and operational overhead.

Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Director in Product Data Science to build, lead, and scale a high-impact data science team that supports executive-level, data-driven product decision-making across Slack.

In this role, you will manage and develop a team of senior and principal Product Data Scientists, setting direction for how data science shapes product strategy, measurement, and execution. You will partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering (PDE), and Data Engineering leadership to ensure data science is deeply embedded in product development—guiding what we build, how we define success, and how we iterate and improve at scale.

At Slack, we foster a positive, diverse, and supportive culture. We look for leaders who are curious, bold, and committed to developing people and raising the bar every day. Our team values being smart, humble, hardworking, and above all, collaborative.

What you will be doing

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Product Data Scientists, supporting career development, performance management, and technical excellence.
 

Set clear priorities and expectations for the team, aligning data science work with product strategy and business outcomes.
 

Partner with Product, Design, Engineering, and Data Engineering leaders to embed data science into product planning, development, and iteration.
 

Apply advanced data science techniques to understand product usage patterns, identify opportunities, and evaluate impact.

Lead and deliver evidence-based ds deliverables and data products to identify key drivers of product growth, engagement, and long-term success.

Define, standardize, and operationalize key product success metrics, and communicate data based insights to Slack and Salesforce executive leadership.

Synthesize insights across multiple product areas and business outcomes, ensuring consistency in methodology, metrics, and storytelling.
 

Serve as a technical and methodological leader for product data science, setting best practices for experimentation, measurement, and causal analysis.
 

Champion data-informed decision-making by making insights accessible, scalable, and actionable for stakeholders at all levels.
 

Collaborate closely with Data Engineering and data platform teams to ensure scalable, reliable data pipelines, instrumentation, and analytics infrastructure.

 

What you should have

7+ years of experience in data science or quantitative analysis, with experience leading or managing senior technical contributors in technology product development or enterprise software environments.
 

Advanced degree (MS, PhD) in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Physics, Quantitative Psychology, Engineering, etc.) is a strong plus.
 

Strong fluency in at least one data science programming language (e.g., Python, R), with the ability to guide, review, and set technical standards for team output.
 

Experience working with large-scale data technologies and AI tools; familiarity with Apache Airflow or similar orchestration tools is a strong plus.
 

Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for senior and executive stakeholders.
 

Proven cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills, with a track record of impacting decisions at both strategic and executional levels in a large, matrixed organization.
 

Experience guiding the design and evolution of scalable data pipelines, schemas, and instrumentation in partnership with Data Engineering teams.
 

Deep understanding of statistical and machine learning methodologies, with the ability to evaluate, coach, and review descriptive and predictive modeling approaches.
 

Expertise in product data science measurement and experimentation methodologies, with the ability to translate technical analysis into meaningful takeaways for non-technical audiences.

Role Summary

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer’s workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations. The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems.

 

Key Responsibilities

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.

Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle

Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.

Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.

Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.

Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.

Drive adoption of Tableau features with business users and analysts.

Conduct enablement sessions on dashboard creation and data exploration

Track usage metrics (active users, workbook views, data source adoption).

Share best practices for visualization design and dashboard performance.

Escalate complex data modeling or server configuration questions to technical resources.

 

Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management

Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.

Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer’s business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.

Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.

Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.

Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.

 

Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management

 AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring. 

Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans. 

AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention. 

Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.

Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask ** effective diagnosis questions**, and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.

Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.

Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.

Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.

Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making. 

 

Minimum Requirements

Experience: Experienced business professional, preferably with 3-4 years of relevant industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platform use, or related fields. 

Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.

Domain Expertise: Possess industry-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer’s business.

Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.

Learning & Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development

Working knowledge of Tableau Desktop, Tableau Cloud/Server, and Tableau Prep

Understanding of data visualization best practices and dashboard design

Familiarity with common data sources (databases, spreadsheets, cloud apps)

Ability to demonstrate Tableau features and navigate workbooks/dashboards

Knowledge of basic analytics use cases (sales dashboards, operational reporting, KPI tracking)

English proficiency is required for all candidates to ensure global alignment.

 

Cloud Specific Experience Preferred:

Tableau Desktop Specialist or Data Analyst certification
Experience with Tableau governance basics (permissions, projects, data sources)

Understanding of how Tableau connects to Salesforce data

Job Description:

This entry level position ensures compliance with applicable U.S. export and import control laws, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”), International Traffic in Arms Regulation (“ITAR"), and the Office of Foreign Asset and Control (“OFAC”) sanctions, and regional and local regulations concerning the movement of goods and services across borders. Using their engineering knowledge, skills and abilities, a Trade Compliance Engineer and Analyst to review part specification sheets, related product documentation, and the Export Administration Regulations to determine Export Classification Code Numbers (“ECCN”) and or local country export classifications for items sold.

Review and action red flag related exception reports.

When necessary, conduct and document further due diligence for partners and or transactions to resolve potential red flags. 

Prepare and submit low- and high-complexity government license applications when required for select export and import transactions. Process government licenses following local regulations (including reporting for import/export licenses, General Licenses, record keeping, etc.).

Working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite specifically Excel and Access.

Build a more connected world by bringing innovative products and services to life for millions of customers. As part of our Product Management team, you’ll drive the vision, development, and success of solutions that shape how people and businesses stay connected, informed, and empowered.

Job overview

You’re the champion who turns market opportunities into real-world solutions. As Lead Product Management and Development, you’ll guide products from initial concept to launch—and beyond—ensuring every detail aligns with customer needs and AT&T’s business objectives. You’ll manage the full product lifecycle, own the business case, and partner across teams to deliver high-quality, high-impact offerings. Your strategic insight and leadership will fuel growth, innovation, and customer value.

You will have the opportunity to be part of critical transformation in our consumer broadband space. You will lead the product planning for broadband transformation initiatives & operational program execution. You will work closely with our Network, Technology, and Marketing organizations to define targeted transformation plans and then execute on those plans.

What you’ll do

Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation through development, launch, and retirement—ensuring seamless transitions and continuous product performance.

Translate customer and technical requirements into actionable product designs, business cases, and detailed documentation including user stories and acceptance criteria.

Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis to uncover trends, customer segments, and opportunities for new products or enhancements.

Develop and maintain detailed product roadmaps, service guides, and project plans, driving initiatives that grow revenue and margin.

Collaborate closely with business, technology, UX, and 3rd party partners to design or modify products, ensuring exceptional user experiences and cross-functional alignment.

Negotiate with vendors to optimize product cost, features, and support, and work with internal teams to develop effective pricing strategies.

What you’ll need

Expertise in full product lifecycle management, including budgeting, business case development, and P&L ownership.

Knowledge of following technologies & concepts: RAN technologies, deep understanding of cellular networks performance, especially with fixed wireless, Mobility and Broadband product lines, measuring the customer experience across products.

Requires skills to identify, monitor and analyze internal (e.g. financials, customer movement) and external (e.g., wireless technology, competitive) performance parameters and take actions based on those insights.

Advanced skills in market research, competitive analysis, and translating insights into actionable strategies.

Proficiency in crafting technical and customer requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

Proven ability to develop and maintain complex product roadmaps and project plans.

Strong collaboration skills with experience working across technology, UX, business, and vendor teams.

Negotiation skills with a track record of improving cost structure and product support.

What you’ll bring

5+ years of experience in product management, development, or related fields (required).

Recognized as an expert in managing complex products and leading strategic initiatives.

Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

Wireless and Wireline working technical knowledge of Network & Care systems & tool

Experience mentoring less experienced staff and influencing executive decisions.

Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) desired.

Certification in product management or a related area required in some roles.

As a B2B Sales Account Executive – Fiber, you will proactively sell AT&T’s mobility solutions and fiber-based broadband network to small and mid-market businesses. By uncovering client needs, you’ll deliver customized, value-added solutions that address their business priorities. Success in this role depends on your ability to generate leads independently via external networks, cold calling, and door knocking, while maintaining a self-starter mindset and driving sales growth.

Join our expanding AT&T Fiber Territory sales team and unlock exceptional earning potential! Our compensation package features a competitive base salary plus a performance-based commission structure. Sales employees will concentrate on acquiring new business and conducting customer visits in the field. When not in the field, they are expected to collaborate with their team from their assigned office location, if available.

Client Engagement: Understand the communication and technology needs of small and mid-sized business customers. Present tailored growth opportunities and efficiencies to both current and potential clients.

Account Development: Develop new accounts and expand existing ones by establishing and nurturing long-term relationships with customers.

Consultative Selling: Utilize consultative selling skills to overcome objections, identify key trends, uncover customer needs, and leverage industry knowledge to find and close sales opportunities.

Proposal Development: Craft responses for Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and present products and services that can benefit customers.

Strategic Initiatives: Design and implement strategic initiatives to grow and retain the revenue stream of assigned complex accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. 

What you’ll need:

Hunter Mindset: A relentless drive to seek out leads and close deals, coupled with resiliency and perseverance.

Networking and Negotiation Skills: Strong ability to network and negotiate effectively.

Valid Driver’s License: Must have a valid driver’s license with a satisfactory driving record, current auto insurance, and a reliable vehicle to meet the transportation needs of the market.

Sales Targets: Demonstrated ability to meet and/or exceed assigned sales targets.

What you’ll bring:

Sales Experience: 2-5 years of outside sales and/or B2B sales experience, with a preference for outside telecommunications sales.

Technical Knowledge: Experience and knowledge in fiber broadband technology and mobility products and services.

Sales Funnel Management: Proficiency in managing sales funnels and previous experience with CRM systems.

Customer Solution Architect- Robotics & Drones

We are Aptiv - a global technology company with 200,000 specialists in 48 countries. We develop innovative software and build the hardware to bring autonomous driving cars, advanced driver-assistance systems, connected vehicles and smart cities to life in a way that only we can. We work in partnership with almost all car manufacturers. Our sensors, systems and software can already be found in almost all passenger cars today.

We are building a new Robotics business at Aptiv, focused on Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) and Drones for warehouse, industrial, and adjacent markets. We’re looking for a Customer Solution Architect who will be the primary technical interface to our customers and partners. You’ll help AMR/drone OEMs and integrators evaluate, integrate, and debug Aptiv’s sensors, perception software, and robotics platform – from first PoC through pilot and production.

In addition to hands-on engineering, you will play a key role in pre-sales activities: shaping technical solutions, contributing to business case development, and partnering with Business Development and Finance to support proposals and deals.

Key Responsibilities:

Customer-Facing Engineering

Act as the primary technical contact for selected AMR/drone OEMs, integrators, and partners.

Lead technical discovery and solution definition: organize and prepare for customer facing technical workshops, understand customer use cases, constraints, and success criteria and map them to Aptiv’s offerings.

Support PoC and pilot deployments, including sensor installation, software bring-up, and troubleshooting on customer platforms.

Pre-Sales & Business Case Support

Partner with Head of Business Development, Product Management, and Finance to shape customer-specific solutions and proposals.

Contribute to business case development by quantifying technical impact into benefits (throughput, safety, uptime, TCO, etc.).

Provide technical inputs to pricing and deal structures (configuration choices, BOM assembly, pre-production engineering effort, deployment complexity).

Primary coordinator for RFI & RFP response across respective teams, including drafting technical content, solution diagrams, effort estimates, validated BOM cost estimations, & initial price guidance.

Join customer pre-sales meetings and workshops to represent the technical solution and address detailed engineering questions.

Feedback & Product Input

Capture field feedback (gaps, UX issues, performance pain points) and feed it into Product Management and Architecture.

Contribute to application notes, reference designs, and best-practice guides for common robot platforms and use cases.

Help shape evaluation kits and demo setups that make it easier for new customers to get started.

Enablement & Documentation

Deliver technical trainings, workshops, and demos for customer engineering teams and internal stakeholders.

Create and maintain integration guides, FAQs, and troubleshooting playbooks.

Support trade shows, conferences, and customer demo days as the hands-on technical expert.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

10+ years of experience in a field application / solutions engineering / robotics integration role or similar customer-facing technical position.

Hands-on experience with real robots (AMRs, AGVs, drones, industrial robots) or embedded systems in production or pilot environments.

Solid skills in Linux and at least one programming/scripting language (C++ and/or Python).

Practical experience with ROS / ROS 2 (building, running, and debugging nodes, topics, launch files, etc.).

Working knowledge of one or more robotics sensors: lidar, radar, cameras, IMUs, encoders, safety sensors.

Demonstrated experience in pre-sales or solutions engineering, supporting technical proposals, PoCs, or business case discussions with customers.

Comfortable discussing basic ROI/TCO concepts and translating technical features into customer value.

Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex technical topics to mixed technical/non-technical audiences.

Strong financial acumen to support business case assembly.

Proven ability to drive the coordination of multiple stakeholders towards a common mission.

Willingness to travel to customer sites, test facilities, and field trials (typically ~25–40%, with some flexibility).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with warehouse / industrial automation and safety-relevant applications.

Familiarity with heterogeneous compute SoCs, hardware acceleration, and deployment of perception/ML workloads.

Exposure to functional safety or industrial safety standards (e.g., ISO 13849, ISO 3691-4, IEC 61508, or ISO 26262).

Experience with simulation tools (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, Webots, or similar) for regression and scenario testing.

Prior work in a robotics platform company supporting OEMs and integrators.

The Opportunity 

The Global Sales Strategy and Operations team is responsible for helping define and execute the strategy to support our outstanding enterprise sales team at Adobe. Reporting into the Head of Global Central Sales Strategy and Operations; you will conduct analyses and lead initiatives focused on go-to-market strategy, analytics, and operations that impact the entire Experience Cloud business.

A successful member of the team is able think analytically and leverage data and insights into actionable impact. You will be a trusted business advisor that serves as a critical member of our field organizations, driving operational rigor, go-to-market planning, and complex data analysis to uncover root causes. The ideal candidate will have exceptional problem solving and critical thinking skills while being able to effectively communicate with executive leaders to inspire change.

What you’ll do

Leverage structured problem-solving techniques to drive operational rigor and improve processes across Adobe’s sales organization

Develop and implement frameworks to measure the health of the business

Analyze raw data to find actionable insights, detect risks and opportunities, and suggest solutions for how to bolster the performance of our sales teams and products

Work cross-functionally across Finance, Sales, GTM, and other key partners to effectively implement pivotal initiatives

Be part of a high performing team with rich opportunities to develop as a leader

Help scale the Central Operations team by improving our methodologies, mentoring others, and leading engagements end-to-end

Learn the Digital Experience Cloud business and develop your network as you collaborate with leaders across Adobe, including Sales and Operations

What you need to succeed

Advanced knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint with familiarity building models and exec-facing presentations

3-6 years of exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, including conducting research, analyzing data, developing hypotheses, and synthesizing recommendations

Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work effectively with people at all levels

Ability to work through ambiguity and create structure around abstract problems

Ability to see the “Big Picture” while also being able to drill down into the specifics of any problem and understand how to position and prioritize issues objectively 

Ability to clearly communicate complex ideas both verbally & in writing

Attention to detail and pride in delivering your best work

Curiosity, initiative, and the desire to experiment

Demonstrated passion for digital experiences and/or cloud technology

Desirable but not essential

Work experience at a leading technology company, strategy or economic consulting organization

MBA or equivalent advanced degree program

Experience creating GTM strategies/Sales Operations along with a practical understanding of the technologies and tactics necessary for execution

Deep knowledge of the technology industry including direct-to-consumer and/or business-to-business models

Senior Program Manager, Sales Transformation

We are seeking an outcome-focused Senior Program Manager to join our Sales Transformation Office and support high-impact, cross-functional initiatives aligned to Adobe’s strategic priorities. In this role, you will drive program execution against clearly defined business outcomes, help teams stay focused on delivering measurable impact, and support the realization of strategic objectives through disciplined, scalable delivery.

This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, contributes as a change agent, and brings an agile, adaptable approach to planning and execution. You will apply strong program management fundamentals (structure, governance, and operational rigor) while enabling effective cross-functional collaboration and decision-making in a fast-moving environment. You have a proven ability to translate strategy into execution and turn complex initiatives into actionable, well-managed programs.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and support cross-functional sales transformation programs, ensuring alignment to defined business priorities, timelines, and success metrics.

Partner with senior leaders and teams across sales, marketing, operations, finance, and technology to translate strategic objectives into clear program plans, milestones, and deliverables.

Help drive change by bringing clarity to ambiguous problems, aligning stakeholders, and supporting adoption of new processes, operating models, and tools.

Apply an agile, outcomes-driven approach to program planning and execution, adjusting plans as priorities and business needs evolve.

Support program governance by maintaining frameworks, cadences, and reporting mechanisms that promote accountability, transparency, and progress tracking.

Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and decision-making by identifying risks, dependencies, and trade-offs, and escalating issues as appropriate.

Develop and maintain program roadmaps, timelines, and resource plans that balance structure with flexibility.

Proactively identify risks and interdependencies; contribute to mitigation and contingency planning in partnership with program stakeholders.

Track and report on program performance using KPIs and qualitative insights to inform leadership and drive continuous improvement.

Contribute to a culture of collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence within the Sales Transformation Office.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Business, Management, or a related field.

7+ years of program or project management experience, including experience leading cross-functional initiatives.

Demonstrated ability to deliver complex programs in matrixed organizations.

Strong grounding in program management principles, with experience applying governance, planning, and execution best practices.

Ability to balance structure with adaptability in fast-changing environments.

Working knowledge of sales processes, go-to-market motions, and supporting technologies (e.g., CRM, analytics platforms).

Experience supporting change management initiatives, process improvements, or operating model evolution.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

Experience working in agile, iterative, or lean delivery environments.

Bonus: Experience in SaaS environments, sales transformation initiatives, or prior consulting exposure.

The Opportunity

Join Adobe’s mission to transform the future of creativity by building SDKs and platform libraries that power data-driven insights and AI-enabled experiences across Creative Cloud. We are seeking a software engineer with development and computer science fundamentals and experience designing, building, and evolving high-performance, cross-platform SDKs.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working close to the system: designing stable APIs, managing complexity in large native codebases, and enabling product teams through reliable, well-designed shared components. You will work on core SDKs where correctness, performance, binary compatibility, and long term maintainability are critical, and where architectural decisions have lasting, cross product impact.

Adobe values leaders who act with integrity, foster inclusive environments, and set the standard for engineering excellence across the organization.

What You’ll Do
- Implement and evolve foundational SDKs and libraries across Adobe products, defining data standards that enable high quality analytics, consistent telemetry, and AI powered services
- Apply computer science principles including algorithms, data structures, concurrency, memory management, and system architecture
- Drive quality through automated testing, validation strategies, and performance analysis across platforms and toolchains
- Develop reference implementations and documentation that establish and guide teams toward consistent adoption

What You Need to Succeed
- Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 5+ years of professional experience building production quality native software systems
- Strong proficiency in one of the following: C/C++ preferred; or mobile development, iOS or Android or both; nice-to-have Java, JavaScript, node.js
- Hands on experience across two or more platforms, such as Windows, MacOS, iOS, Android, or cloud services
- Experience working in large, long lived codebases where stability, performance, and thoughtful evolution are essential
- Debugging and problem solving skills in complex native and multi language environments
- Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguous problem spaces, making sound architectural tradeoffs with incomplete information
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical direction and platform adoption
- Proven ability to thrive in a small, highly collaborative, high impact team

The Opportunity 

Adobe is joining forces with creative organizations to reshape the future of creative work in the era of AI. As we accelerate innovation across our creativity portfolio of products, we have an amazing opportunity to unlock end-to-end workflow solutions that transform how creative teams deliver and drive a new level of business impact.

As a Principal Creativity Portfolio Manager, you’ll play a highly strategic yet hands‑on role at the intersection of product innovation, customer needs, and market storytelling. You’ll partner closely with product marketing teams across the creativity portfolio to craft compelling narratives that clearly articulate how multi-product solutions deliver value to our customers. You’ll also work closely with our Solutions Enablement team to ensure that our sellers are equipped to effectively position and demonstrate value of solutions across the portfolio.

If you're motivated by the opportunity to influence Adobe’s vision for creativity, sharpen our portfolio solution positioning, and empower sales teams to articulate value with clarity and confidence - join our Enterprise Portfolio & Solutions Enablement team in a role that puts you at the forefront of Adobe’s next wave of innovation!

What You'll Do 

Craft Compelling Portfolio Narratives: Partner with product marketing teams across the creativity portfolio to ensure that we have clear narratives and messaging for multi-product solutions, rooted in real workflows and measurable business value delivered to customers.

The Opportunity

The CSC Technical Consultant is responsible for converting business requirements into scalable and technically sound solution builds across Adobe’s Content Supply Chain technology stack. In this role you will work closely with the CSC Business Consultant but focus on solution design, configuration, integrations, and data structure. You will be the technical expert across Workfront, Fusion. AEM Assets and connected CSC tools inside and outside the Adobe tech stack – and ensure the implementation aligns with established guidelines. You will take charge of implementing stable, scalable solutions that meet business requirements, accelerate customer adoption, and ensure value realization. Success means customers are self-sufficient post-go-live, timelines and achievements are consistently reached, and documentation is detailed and supports all collaborators.

What You’ll Do
 

Translate business requirements into technical specifications, architecture, and solution documentation 

Use AI-powered technologies to optimize code quality and development lifecycles 

Configure Workfront, AEM Assets, and other CSC platform components 

Work with integrations (Fusion or APIs) to connect systems across the content lifecycle. 

Implement defined taxonomy, metadata, and folder structure 

Build and test configurations, prototypes, and workflows 

Support customers during User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles 

Participate and collaborate in Architecture Review Boards to ensure proper code quality and scalability 

Partner with customer IT teams on authentication, access, SSO, and data security 

Solve and resolve technical issues, ensuring high system performance 

Support Sales organization during business development cycles, scoping activities, and through thought leadership 

Collaborate with Business Consultant to ensure solutions align with business requirements and defined processes 

Guide customers on platform standard methodologies, scalability, and governance 

Provide knowledge transfer and solution documentation after launch 
 

What You’ll Need To Succeed
 

8+ years technical implementation experience in SaaS platforms 

4+ years’ experience with Workfront, AEM Assets, Frame.io, or similar enterprise platforms 

Experience implementing solutions for enterprise systems of record (e.g., ERP, HCM/HRIS, SFA/CRM, etc.) 

Experience working with 3rd party software integrations (e.g. Fusion, Shopify, Box.com, Widen, Jira, Salesforce, etc.) 

Proficient with APIs, integrations, Fusion, JSON structures, and system-to-system data flows 

Proficient with Dell Boomi or equivalent Integration Platform as a Service (IPaaS) provider is desired 

Foundational mastery of scripting and/or software code languages (e.g. Java, PHP, Python; JavaScript, HTML, and CSS) 

Intermediate experience with relational databases and SQL 

Ability to design and articulate technical architecture to both technical and non-technical audiences

About the Role 

We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Software Engineer to join the new Project Graph team at Adobe. 

 

Project Graph is a new creative system that lets you combine first and third-party AI models, Adobe tools, and custom interactive components inside a visual, designer-friendly node graph editor. Connect a library of tactile, interactive components that bring creative control of AI back to your fingertips. Transform ideas into powerful workflows and modular tools that run anywhere, from the web to Adobe apps like Photoshop. And if you’d rather focus on creating than building, you can tap into a growing ecosystem of community-built tools without ever opening the editor. 

 

In this position, you will play a key role in designing and delivering developer-focused features of the Project Graph platform. 

 

What You'll Do 

Technical Ownership: Design, implement, and maintain core components of Project Graph, with a focus on web components and developer experience 

Innovation & Impact: Collaborate with engineering leadership to shape and rapidly deliver on a technical vision to address the complex needs of the platform, 

Engineering Excellence: Champion software engineering standards, including code quality, testing, and continuous integration/deployment. 

Design and Operate at Scale: Lead in the architecture and operation of large-scale, globally distributed systems. Ensure high availability and low latency in enterprise environments. 

Mentorship & Collaboration: Mentor junior engineers, lead design reviews, and foster a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning across the team. 

Customer Focus: Work closely with product managers and customer-facing teams to understand user needs and translate them into robust technical solutions. 

 

What You Need To Succeed 

Education: BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field. 

Experience: 10+ years of experience building, testing and operating complex web applications, focused on the backend. Experience with node-based systems and enterprise software development is a strong plus. 

Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of modern software development practices. Web components experience a must-have. Experience building developer tooling a strong plus. 

Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and a data-driven attitude. Ability to break down complex problems and deliver elegant, maintainable solutions. 

Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical partners. 

Customer Empathy: A strong sense of ownership and a passion for building products that delight users.

Job Description – Site Reliability Engineer (P20)

Our Company

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to craft beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and to transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to building exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has equal opportunity. We know that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and the next big idea could be yours!

Platform Reliability & System Engineering

Design, build, and operate reliable, scalable, and highly available distributed systems for the Adobe Pass platform.

Implement reliability best practices to ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and performance across multi-region cloud environments.

Identify reliability risks, troubleshoot system bottlenecks, and implement mitigation and remediation strategies.

Partner with software engineering and infrastructure teams to improve system resilience, scalability, and operational efficiency.

Automation & Observability

Develop and maintain automation for deployment, monitoring, recovery, and operational workflows to reduce manual intervention.

Build and enhance observability solutions using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing to ensure production visibility.

Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, and operational readiness across services.

Contribute to automation frameworks that improve operational efficiency and reliability.

Incident Management & Operational Excellence

Participate in on-call rotations and actively troubleshoot and resolve production incidents.

Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions.

Contribute to incident response, service restoration, and continuous reliability improvements.

Support production readiness reviews and ensure operational best practices are followed.

Performance & Scalability

Analyse system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement tuning and optimisation improvements.

Assist in capacity planning and scaling efforts to support growing platform demand.

Optimise infrastructure utilisation while maintaining service reliability and performance.

Collaboration & Engineering Excellence

Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, and operations teams to improve platform reliability and operational maturity.

Contribute to reliability best practices, automation standards, and operational processes.

Participate in system design discussions with a focus on scalability, reliability, and operational supportability.

Share knowledge and contribute to improving overall team capabilities.

Qualifications

Bachelor's in computer science, Engineering, or related field.

4–7 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, or distributed systems operations.

Strong experience operating cloud-native systems in AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.

Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Go, Java, or Bash.

Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and microservices-based architectures.

Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry.

Understanding of distributed systems, networking, storage, and databases.

Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting high-availability, large-scale production systems.

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automation tooling.

Experience working with distributed data systems such as Kafka or similar technologies.

Knowledge of reliability engineering principles such as SLOs, SLIs, and incident management.

Cloud or Kubernetes certifications (AWS, GCP, Azure, CKA, CKAD) are a plus.

About the Role

Looking for an adaptable Sr Network Engineer (L3) with extensive knowledge in F5 Load Balancers and Data Center LAN Fabric. The role involves deploying and supporting high-availability, scalable, and secure network solutions for enterprise, private cloud, and data center environments.

Key Responsibilities

F5 Load Balancer (Mandatory)

Develop, deploy, and maintain F5 BIG-IP solutions (Local Traffic Manager, Global Traffic Manager/Domain Name System, Application Security Manager, Application Performance Management).

Optimize application delivery, performance, and reliability.

Integrate F5 with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises infrastructure.

Troubleshoot and resolve complex load balancing and application delivery issues.

Manage documentation for F5 configurations and operational guidelines.

Guarantee conformity with change control and security policies.

Engage in on-call rotation and assist with maintenance tasks outside of regular working hours.
 

Data Center LAN Fabric (Highly Desirable)

Implement and coordinate contemporary network frameworks like EVPN, VxLAN, and SDN or equivalent experience in data centers and cloud environments.

Operate switches, routers, and fabric controllers (Cisco, Arista, Juniper, Versa, NSX).

Optimize network performance, reliability, and scalability.

Monitor and troubleshoot fabric health using tools (NetFlow, Grafana, SolarWinds).

Document network designs, configurations, and operational procedures.

Ensure compliance with change management and security standards.

Support maintenance and participate in on-call rotation.
 

DNS (Nice-to-Have)

Understand DNS, DHCP, and IPAM solutions (Infoblox, F5 GTM/DNS).

Grasp DNS reliability, security, and performance across hybrid environments.

Understand DNS resolution mechanics to differentiate and diagnose DNS vs VIP impairments.

Implement DNS security best practices (DNSSEC, RPZ, threat mitigation).

Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve DNS-related issues as needed.

Maintain documentation for DNS operational procedures.

Adhere to change control and compliance standards.

Participate in on-call rotation and support maintenance during off-peak hours.

Qualifications & Skills

6+ years of experience in enterprise-grade network engineering.

Deep expertise in F5 modules (LTM, GTM/DNS, ASM, APM) and iRules scripting.

Expert in network fabrics (EVPN, VxLAN, SDN), data center LAN switching, and automation (Python, Ansible).

Strong understanding of TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, HTTP/S, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, QoS, ACLs, DHCP, DNSSEC.

Experience with F5, Cisco, Arista.

Certifications: F5 Certified Administrator/Expert, CCNP

Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.

The ideal candidate possesses exceptional program management skills, partner management, and motivational change leadership. You are able to turn complex problems into prioritized, well-executed solutions that drive impact. Lead Strategic HR Initiatives: Partner with HR leadership and collaborate across COE partners to drive key strategic HR programs and processes. AI Fluency: Continuously experiment, innovate, and incorporate AI tools to drive efficiencies, optimization and innovation.

Demonstrated ability to build relationships and partnerships at all levels of the organization, identify and align diverse perspectives, and advise and influence senior partners 

Ability to use critical thinking skills to breakdown sizable problems into meaningful pieces, and leverage data to derive insights 

Superb judgment and integrity, including excellent decision-making skills

Excellent communication, written, and verbal skills, and solid attention to detail

Comfort with ambiguity, a can-do attitude, and the ability to learn, grow, and take on expanded duties as business needs evolve

Familiarity with project management tools and methodologies, as well as basic technical understanding to effectively communicate with technical teams

At Adobe, we start empowerment internally by providing teams with fast, reliable, and scalable digital infrastructure. This infrastructure transforms large data sets into clear, actionable insights. We seek an experienced Backend Engineer to develop and scale the server-side base of our advanced benchmark and analytics platform. This platform delivers real-time metrics, complex aggregations, customizable dashboards, and dependable data pipelines. It helps all parts of Adobe make faster, more informed decisions and unlock new levels of creativity and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Build and implement scalable REST/GraphQL APIs and internal services using Node.js and Fastify. These will serve benchmark data, aggregations, filters, and real-time updates to the Vue.js front-end.

Integrate and optimize queries with ClickHouse using the official @clickhouse/client library for high-throughput analytical workloads.

Implement caching strategies with Redis to reduce latency on frequent reads, store session data, handle rate limiting, and support real-time features such as pub/sub for live benchmark updates.

Build and maintain robust data ingestion pipelines, background jobs, and ETL-like processes to feed analytics data into ClickHouse reliably.

Manage and operate containerized Node.js/Fastify services on Azure Container Apps, including setting up environments, updates, scaling policies, ingress/traffic splitting, secrets, and environment variables.

Collaborate with front-end engineers, data analysts, and DevOps to define API contracts, resolve integration issues, and iterate on platform capabilities.

Participate in code reviews, contribute to architecture decisions, and write comprehensive unit/integration tests to maintain code quality.

Keep up to date with the Fastify ecosystem, Node.js progress, ClickHouse protocols, Redis strategies for analytics scenarios, Azure Container Apps developments, pertinent Kubernetes ideas, and changing AI-assisted development processes.

Required Qualifications

Over 4 years of professional experience in backend development, including a minimum of 3 years dedicated to working with Node.js in live production settings.

Production experience building and maintaining APIs with Fastify in real-world, high-performance applications.

Practical experience managing and deploying containerized applications on Azure Container Apps, including environment setup, revision management, scaling configuration, traffic routing, and monitoring in production.

Solid expertise in contemporary JavaScript/TypeScript, asynchronous patterns, error management, and REST/GraphQL API creation in the Fastify environment.

Hands-on experience in production settings involving ClickHouse and Node.js applications, covering schema optimization, improving query performance, bulk data ingestion, and handling analytical workloads at scale.

Practical, direct experience working with Redis in Node.js for caching, rate limiting, session stores, queues, and pub/sub patterns.

Build reusable Vue components, composables, and compose system elements that ensure consistency across dashboards, charts, filters, drill-down views, and reporting interfaces.

Implement interactive data visualizations (using libraries such as Chart.js, D3.js, Vue Chartjs, or similar) while optimizing for large datasets and real-time updates.

Ensure outstanding user experience through thoughtful information architecture, interaction composition, accessibility (WCAG standards), and usability testing/iteration.

Optimize front-end performance, including bundle size, rendering efficiency, lazy loading, and smooth handling of complex state in data-intensive applications.

Participate in code reviews, contribute to front-end architecture decisions, and help maintain high code quality through testing (unit, component, E2E).

Leverage AI coding assistants daily to boost productivity—generating boilerplate, refactoring components, exploring implementations, and iterating on complex logic—while critically reviewing and refining AI-generated output.

Stay updated on advancements in the Vue.js ecosystem, modern CSS guidelines (Tailwind, CSS modules, etc.), emerging UI/UX procedures for analytics tools, and evolving AI-assisted development workflows.

Required Qualifications

4+ years of professional experience in front-end development, with at least 2–3 years passionate about Vue.js (Vue 3 preferred).

Consistent experience applying AI-powered coding aids like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude (Claude Code / Claude.dev) to boost coding, debugging, refactoring, and learning during real-world projects.

Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3 (including responsive build, flexbox/grid, animations/transitions).

Solid understanding of UI/UX principles and experience turning designer-provided assets (Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, etc.) into production-ready code.

Experience building data-rich applications, dashboards, or analytics tools (e.g., benchmark tracking, metrics visualization, filtering/sorting, export features).

Familiarity with state management solutions (Pinia, Vuex) and Vue Router.

Knowledge of front-end build tools (Vite, Vue CLI), testing frameworks (Vitest, Cypress, Jest), and version control (Git).

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail are required when working with complex user flows and large-scale data presentation. You must also be able to evaluate and improve AI-suggested code for correctness, performance, and maintainability.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with data visualization libraries (Chart.js, ApexCharts, D3.js, etc.) and handling real-time or near-real-time data updates.

Understanding of REST/GraphQL APIs and WebSocket integration for live benchmark feeds.

Familiarity with accessibility auditing tools and inclusive building practices.

Previous work on internal enterprise tools or B2E (business-to-employee) platforms.

Exposure to building systems or component libraries (Vuetify, Element Plus, PrimeVue, or custom).

Proficiency with multiple AI coding tools is required. For example, combining Cursor for multi-file edits with Claude for deep reasoning or Copilot for inline completions. You should also know how to integrate these tools into team workflows.

Translate customer needs into technical solutions based on a balance of architecture standards and plans, total cost of ownership and feasibility. 

Collaborate with Adobe’s sales and internal teams to grow accounts, ideate solutions and address evolving customer needs.

The Sales Transformation Portfolio Manager plays a critical role in orchestrating how sales transformation initiatives are evaluated, prioritized, governed, and communicated across the organization. This role ensures initiative intake is structured, data is accurate, progress is visible, and leadership has the insights needed to make informed decisions. The Portfolio Manager helps establish the operating rhythm, frameworks, and standards that enable the Sales Transformation Office to run effectively and scale as the portfolio grows.

This individual acts as the connective tissue across strategic programs, business leaders, and cross functional partners. They own the portfolio operating model, ensure data-driven decision-making, and provide transparency into initiative performance, value delivery, and risk areas. This role is ideal for someone who brings strong analytical, operational, and organizational experience with the ability to create clarity, structure, and insight in fast-moving environments.

Key Responsibilities:

Portfolio Intake, Prioritization, and Planning

Manage the intake process for new sales transformation initiatives, ensuring clear scope, business case, and alignment to strategic objectives.

Develop and manage prioritization frameworks to determine sequencing, dependencies, and resource considerations across the portfolio.

Maintain an accurate, up-to-date source of truth portfolio view, capturing progress, risks, interdependencies, and value delivery.

Partner with leaders across sales, marketing, finance, operations, and product to ensure initiatives are properly defined and positioned for success.

Data Management and Insights

Own initiative data quality across systems, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and completeness.

Create standard data structures, definitions, and reporting guidelines for use across the Transformation Office.

Define and maintain portfolio-level KPIs, value realization measures, and reporting logic.

Executive Dashboarding and Visibility

Develop and maintain executive dashboards that provide a clear view into progress, risks, trends, value delivery, and overall portfolio health.

Translate complex program data into meaningful insights for executive audiences.

Provide timely reporting to leadership, enabling informed decisions and proactive interventions.

Governance and Operating Rhythm

Establish and manage the governance framework used to monitor progress, escalate risks, and ensure accountability across initiatives.

Lead cross portfolio forums, including leadership reviews, operating cadences, and decision-making sessions.

Maintain consistent operating rhythms, guiding the organization through structured, predictable, and transparent review cycles.

Frameworks, Standards, and Tooling

Own the Transformation Office’s portfolio and program delivery standards, frameworks, templates, and methodologies.

Define and enforce consistent practices across initiative planning, reporting, and status management.

Evaluate, implement, and manage tooling to support portfolio management, reporting, and collaboration.

Partner with program leaders to ensure adoption and consistent application of standards and tools.

Cross Functional Partnership and Enablement

Partner closely with program managers and business leaders to maintain high-quality plans, data, and reporting.

Support initiative teams in following the Transformation Office framework and best practices.

Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, and operational excellence across the transformation ecosystem.

Qualifications:

Required

8–12+ years of experience in portfolio management, PMO operations, transformation support, or strategic program management.

Proven experience managing cross-functional portfolios and creating prioritization or governance models.

Strong analytical skills with experience designing dashboards and communicating insights to executive audiences.

Ability to design and operationalize frameworks, standards, and scalable processes.

Demonstrated success bringing structure, clarity, and organization to complex, ambiguous environments.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to simplify complex information.

Preferred

Experience within a Transformation Office, Enterprise PMO, or Strategy/Operations team.

Background supporting sales, go-to-market, or revenue-driving initiatives.

Familiarity with portfolio management or BI tools such as Smartsheet, Workfront, Tableau, or Power BI.

Experience in SaaS, technology, or consulting environments.

Key Competencies

Portfolio management and prioritization

Governance and operating model design

Data quality, metrics, and dashboarding

Executive reporting and storytelling

Cross-functional coordination

Process design and standardization

Analytical problem solving

Organizational clarity and structure

Why This Role Matters

This role is foundational to the effectiveness of the Sales Transformation Office. By owning intake, prioritization, governance, and portfolio visibility, the Portfolio Lead/Manager ensures the organization invests in the right initiatives and delivers measurable outcomes. This role provides the insights, structure, and operational discipline that empower leadership to make high-quality decisions and accelerate transformation across the business.

About the Role

Adobe is seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer to join our Doc Cloud Product & Business Analytics organization. This role focuses on building and operating large-scale analytical data pipelines and analytics-ready data tables that power product adoption, usage metrics, experimentation (A/B testing), and executive dashboards across a massive monthly active user base.

You will work primarily on Azure Databricks, playing a key role in setting up and evolving our Databricks-based analytics data warehouse, including curated tables, metric foundations, and scalable data models. This role is ideal for a hands-on data engineer with deep expertise in SQL, Python, Spark, and Delta Lake, and a strong understanding of analytics-driven data warehousing and product analytics.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain large-scale, production-grade data pipelines on Azure Databricks using Apache Spark and Python

Write and optimize complex, high-performance SQL for data transformation, aggregation, and analytics workloads at scale

Develop and maintain analytics-ready data models (fact tables, dimensions, rollups, metric layers, and gold layer tables) used for dashboards and reporting

Optimize Databricks workloads for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency, including tuning Spark jobs and Delta Lake tables

Establish and apply Delta Lake best practices, including incremental and idempotent processing, MERGE patterns, partitioning, and table optimization.

Partner closely with product analysts, business analysts, data scientists, and product managers to enable reliable, self-serve analytics, supporting product-led growth use cases.

Implement data quality checks, validation frameworks, and monitoring to ensure accurate and trusted analytics metrics

Apply strong Data engineering best practices, including version control and documentation

Contribute to solutions that integrate structured and unstructured data, including selective use of GenAI / LLM-based capabilities where relevant

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

Experience

6–12 years of professional experience in Data Engineering 

Proven experience building and supporting production-grade analytical data pipelines at scale

Technical Expertise (Must-Have)

Expert-level SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, performance tuning, and large-scale aggregations

Advanced Python proficiency for data processing, pipeline development, and automation

Deep hands-on experience with Azure Databricks and Apache Spark

Strong understanding of Delta Lake and optimization techniques (partitioning, Z-ordering, compaction)

Experience designing data models optimized for analytics and BI consumption

Cloud & Platform

Strong experience with Microsoft Azure, including data lake storage and access controls

Familiarity with lakehouse architectures and enterprise data governance concepts

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with streaming or near–real-time data pipelines on Databricks

Prior experience supporting product analytics, feature adoption, or MAU-based metrics

Exposure to MLOps, LLM deployment, or GenAI-enabled data applications

Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI and their performance considerations

Experience mentoring analysts or junior data engineers

The Opportunity
We’re looking for a Creative Director for Social who is equal parts writer, satirist, cultural observer, and comedic architect. This isn’t a “social copywriter” job. This is for someone who understands the craft of writing for the internet at a professional level: short-form scripts, comedic beats, fast-pivot ideation, that can translate across TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and emerging formats.

If you’ve written for broadcast comedy institutions or satire-heavy social platforms—or a portfolio that demonstrates similar rigor, timing, and imagination—you’ll feel at home here.

This role will shape the voice of Adobe’s social ecosystem through original ideas and comedic story instincts, while collaborating with creators, editors, strategists, and production partners to bring the work to life.
 

What You’ll Do

Develop scripts, sketches, formats, and recurring characters that can anchor new social programming.

Elevate Adobe’s brand presence by applying comedic timing, social literacy, and cultural fluency to campaign moments and always-on content.

Translate insights and trends into ideas that feel original, sharp, and shareable.

Partner with Creative, Influencer, and Production teams to shape ideas that resonate with key Adobe social audiences.

Maintain a strong bar for creative excellence and writing quality across all social channels.

What You’ll Bring

A proven portfolio of comedic writing across short-form video, sketch, and satire

Professional experience writing for platforms like The Onion, SNL, late-night shows, digital satire studios, or equivalent environments.

Strong understanding of social platforms, social pacing, and writing for visual comedic timing.

Ability to write scripts that are concise, funny, unexpected, and deeply internet-native.

Experience developing franchises, pilots, and characters.

Ability to collaborate with creators and performers, guide tone, and iterate quickly.

Comfort working in a fast environment with changing inputs and high creative expectations.

A passion for culture, comedy, and storytelling with a sharp editorial point of view.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in both writer’s-room and social-native environments.

Strong grasp of Adobe tools and generative workflows is a plus.

A point of view on where internet humor is going and how brands should adapt.

Job Description
We are looking for an outstanding Lead Solution Engineer to join our Commercial Industries Solution Engineering team, focused on our General Business customer segment supporting our Health & Life Sciences and Built Environment Customers.

What is a Solution Engineer?
Also known as a ‘Pre-sales Consultant’, ‘Sales Consultant’, or ‘Sales Engineer’, the Solution Engineer is responsible for owning the solutions throughout the sales cycle and delivering thought leadership to companies to transform their customer’s experience. Solution Engineers are part of the UKI Sales team and are experts who work alongside their colleagues, participate in building our team culture and support their aligned sales team to create AI, Data, and CRM solutions for new prospects and customers. To accomplish this, you should have a strong desire to set the vision translating business objectives into enticing and practical recommendations. The Solution Engineer acts as a trusted advisor to our customers while aiding the customer’s transformational journey. In addition to working on sales opportunities and supporting marketing events, you will also get a chance to work on exciting critical initiatives to drive continuous improvement within the Solution Engineering team and to grow your personal profile within Salesforce. We are seeking a candidate who embodies Salesforce’s core values: Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, and Equality.

Your Responsibilities:

To develop and deliver innovative custom solutions, including solution concepts to key decision makers to address their business issues and needs showing business value

Coordinate and lead the entire solution cycle through close collaboration with other high-performing teams.

Industry experience, incorporating and developing a point of view based on Salesforce’s solutions.

To fully understand and clearly articulate the benefits of Salesforce to customers at every level, examples include; Administration/IT Staff, managers and "C" level executives.

Present compelling Salesforce & partner solutions while supporting relationships with customers and partners.

Display initiative, self motivation and deliver high quality results along with meeting all expectations

Personal Attributes/Experience:

Understanding the unique business requirements of customers primarily within the health & life sciences industry with need to flexible in supporting customer in other industries as required

Experience translating/presenting business needs into a compelling vision and roadmap for our customers.

Track record of solution engineering, consultancy, delivery or training success for a software solution organisation.

We are open to a variety of backgrounds for the role.

Solid oral, written, presentation and interpersonal communication and relationship skills.

Proven time management skills in a dynamic team environment.

Ability to work as part of a team to solve problems in dynamic, energising environments.

Inquisitive, practical and passionate about technology and sharing knowledge.

Likes to be the first to know something and to understand why and how things happen.

Good at searching out information and experimenting, loves to concentrate on a particular topic and to solve puzzles.

Good at explaining ideas and finding ways to keep people’s attention.

Willing and able to travel occasionally

Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Job Description
This job is responsible for investigating and analyzing complex, multi-discipline coverage and claims that have been referred to the special investigation unit (SIU) for potential fraud. This role typically handles a combination of complex attorney represented and unrepresented claims and moderate to complex losses, in which suspicious activity has been identified. The individual performs a thorough investigation including; (1) conducting background searches, scene investigations, and clinic inspections; (2) taking recorded statements; (3) reviewing and analyzing medical notes, bills, and property damage; and (4) conducting witness interviews and social media searches. The individual conducts surveillance on property and/or creates scene reconstructions on some investigations and reviews whether fraud can be substantiated and supports a lawsuit. The individual provides work guidance and direction to less senior employees and provides mentoring and coaching to the team.

We’re looking to add an SIU Field Investigator to our team in the Chattanooga, TN area! This is a remote role with field work throughout the Chattanooga, TN territory. If you bring prior SIU insurance carrier experience or a background in insurance investigations, we’d love to connect with you. Apply today and join our team! 

Key Responsibilities

Enters SIU claim data information into multiple SIU systems

Reviews investigations with fraud outcomes to validate whether denial is appropriate

Updates files with investigation outcome, and when no fraud or insufficient evidence is found, returns file to MCO for further handling and settlement

Conducts complex online data application searches, research, and evaluation

Conducts complex site inspections, including body shops, medical clinics, loss locations etc.

Conducts thorough investigations of complex that are potentially fraudulent to determine if payment is warranted, including scene investigations and surveillance as needed

Validates that the information provided and obtained through investigation is true and accurate and follows up on all possible leads

Summarizes documents and enters into claim system notes, documenting a claim file with notes, evaluations and decision-making process

Utilizes analytic tools or SIU field intelligence to identify complex claims for investigation and/or for support in the evidence of the fraud and damages

Researches and responds to complex customer communications, concerns, conflicts or issues

Experience

2 or more years of experience (Preferred)

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.
