About the RFx Team and Proposal Manager Role

About the role

The RFx Proposal & Solution Architecture Manager will lead end‑to‑end proposal strategy, solution design, and demo orchestration for qualified opportunities, acting as a trusted advisor to sales leaders and customers. This role combines deep MarTech architecture expertise with strong narrative, writing, and presentation skills to craft persuasive responses spanning RFx documents, vision micro demos, and executive presentations that clearly articulate business value and technical feasibility.

What your will be responsible for

Lead RFx responses for strategic opportunities, working on qualified deals to interpret customer requirements, define win themes, and build contextualized, high‑quality proposals.

· Partner with Sales and Solution Consultants to assess customer environments, identify Experience Cloud fit, and design end‑to‑end architectures that address customer journeys, integrations, and scalability.

· Own the proposal plan from initiation to submission, driving cadence, managing work‑streams, and ensuring on‑time, compliant, and differentiated deliverables across technical and business tracks.

· Act as Solution Architect and Subject Matter Expert, defining reference architectures, integration patterns, and deployment approaches for Adobe DX solutions (e.g., content, data, marketing automation, commerce).

· Create and orchestrate vision demos, micro‑demos, and prototype experiences that bring the proposed architecture and value story to life for both technical and executive stakeholders.

· Build reusable customer‑facing assets (architecture blueprints, demo scripts, POV outlines, playbooks) that raise proposal quality and accelerate response velocity across the RFx team.

· Coordinate inputs from cross‑functional stakeholders (sales, product, marketing, finance, legal, delivery) and synthesize them into a single, coherent narrative and solution design.

· Mentor and coach the RFx and presales team on solutioning best practices, demo storytelling, and architecture patterns, including running knowledge‑sharing sessions and internal enablement.

What you’ll do

Establish yourself as an influential leader in proposal management, solution architecture, and RFx strategy for Adobe Digital Experience.

· Shape deal strategy by aligning customer business drivers with Adobe’s architecture vision, challenging assumptions, and identifying gaps in customer journeys and technical readiness.

· Lead “win rooms” and workshops to define solution options, risks, and trade‑offs, building consensus across internal teams and customer stakeholders.

· Translate complex architectural concepts (data flows, integrations, security, scalability) into clear, business‑friendly narratives and visuals suitable for CXO audiences.

· Deliver high‑impact demos and presentations that connect technical capabilities to measurable outcomes such as revenue growth, personalization, operational efficiency, and customer lifetime value.

· Represent the team in conferences, customer events, blogs, and internal forums to showcase best practices, reusable demo assets, and thought leadership around presales architecture and RFx excellence

What you need to succeed

B.Tech or MBA (or equivalent) with 12–15 years of experience in presales, solution consulting, or cloud‑based digital experience implementations.

Strong understanding of enterprise and MarTech architecture, including at least one core area such as Customer Data Platforms, marketing automation, content management/experience (AEM‑like platforms), or commerce.

Hands‑on experience designing end‑to‑end architectures across data, content, activation, and analytics layers, including APIs, integrations, identity, and security considerations.

Proven RFx and proposal management experience, including leading complex RFP/RFI responses, orchestrating cross‑functional contributions, and driving technical win outcomes.

Demonstrated demo excellence: skilled at using demo tools and pre‑built libraries, building custom scenarios, and adapting demos for different personas while maintaining strong storytelling and engagement.

Strong project management capabilities with a track record of delivering high‑quality proposals and solutions on time in fast‑paced environments.

Exceptional communication, writing, and presentation skills, with the ability to craft CXO‑level narratives and visually compelling decks and diagrams.

Proficiency with productivity and design tools (Office Suite, collaboration platforms, basic design/prototyping tools) and comfort learning Adobe’s own experience and design tools quickly.

High ownership, creativity, and growth mindset, with a passion for staying current on digital experience, architecture, and AI‑driven MarTech trends.

About the Role

Adobe Japan is looking for a Head of Social Japan to lead and scale our social media strategy across channels, audiences, and the full customer lifecycle. Reporting into senior marketing leadership, this role owns the strategic direction and execution of social as a core marketing and customer engagement function in Japan.

As a Head of Social Japan, you will manage a high-impact team and agency partners to deliver comprehensive social strategies that drive brand relevance, customer success, and business growth. This role spans proprietary social platforms, influencer communities, customer support on social, social listening, and newsroom-style operations. The scope is not limited to specific products, but supports Adobe’s broader portfolio and ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

Define and implement a complete social strategy across all owned social channels, aligned with business goals and the end-to-end customer journey

Own the strategy, planning, and optimization of in-house social media platforms, with deep expertise in YouTube as a flagship channel for storytelling, education, and community engagement

Lead social initiatives across awareness, adoption, retention, and customer support use cases

Establish frameworks for social listening and translate insights into marketing, communications, and product strategy

Oversee customer support on social channels in close partnership with Customer Support and PR teams

Build and scale influencer and creator communities to drive advocacy and long-term value

Build and operate a social newsroom model, enabling timely, insight-driven engagement

Lead, coach, and develop team members; manage agencies and external partners

Collaborate cross-functionally with PR, Product Marketing, Brand, Customer marketing, Analytics, and Global teams
 

What You Need to Succeed

Proven experience leading owned social channels end-to-end, including strategy, operations, and performance optimization

Strong hands-on experience managing YouTube as part of a broader owned social ecosystem

Experience designing social strategies grounded in customer journey and lifecycle thinking

Demonstrated expertise in social listening, insights generation, and newsroom-style operations

Experience delivering customer support via social channels

Proven success in influencer and community building

People management experience with the ability to mentor and grow talent

Strong communication skills in both English and Japanese (business-level proficiency in both required)

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled, strategic, and collaborative Lead Analyst to elevate our marketing measurement and analytics capabilities. In this role, you will serve as a critical thought partner across the organization—helping teams understand performance, uncover growth opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

As a senior member of the analytics team, you will define how success is measured. You will work closely with leaders from different areas to build strategy. You will bring clarity to complex business questions through rigorous analysis. Your insights will influence marketing investment, guide channel optimization, and inform planning, forecasting, and leadership decision-making.

What you'll Do

Drive Analytics Strategy & Insights

Partner with Media, Finance, Product Marketing (PMM), GTM, and Data Science teams to identify high-impact business questions and build analytics initiatives.

Translate business objectives into clear analytical frameworks that align insights with strategic goals.

Apply advanced analytics techniques to large, complex datasets to uncover trends, performance drivers, and growth opportunities.

Analytics & Measurement

Evolve and operationalize measurement frameworks across the full marketing funnel.

Interpret experiments such as A/B tests, incrementality studies, and cohort analyses.

Evaluate performance across channels and help build investment and optimization strategies.

Storytelling & Decision Support

Translate analytical findings into clear, compelling narratives tailored to audiences ranging from working teams to senior leadership.

Deliver actionable insights that inform strategy, planning, and decision-making.

Provide data-driven recommendations for media planning, budget allocation, and performance optimization.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Build alignment and momentum across a highly matrixed, cross-functional organization.

Act as a trusted analytics partner, influencing collaborators through strong communication, credibility, and collaboration.

Enable teams to apply insights effectively to drive measurable business impact.

What you need to succeed

Experience & Expertise

5+ years of experience in marketing, growth, or performance analytics, ideally supporting full-funnel programs.

Experience in media or agency environments strongly preferred (paid media, performance marketing, or cross-channel measurement).

Strong analytical foundation, including trend analysis, opportunity sizing, and experimental development and interpretation.

Technical & Analytical Skills

Proficiency with SQL and business intelligence tools.

Ability to work with large datasets and translate analysis into practical, actionable recommendations.

Communication & Collaboration

Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex data for diverse audiences.

Proven experience collaborating across regions, functions, and levels of seniority.

Comfortable operating in a matrixed organization and aligning multiple partners.

Approach & Ways of Working

Strategic problem solver who integrates data, customer insights, and business context.

Positive relationship builder who works collaboratively toward shared goals.

Adaptable and resilient in fast-changing environments, confident navigating ambiguity and evolving priorities.

We’re looking for a Cloud Security Manager to help enhance our development processes and build innovative security tools to improve and scale Adobe’s cloud infrastructure and ensure our security posture. 

The role will provide the opportunity to work on a diverse set of projects and will also include development of prototypes and proof-of-concepts. You’ll be working to build and assess tools to cover the newest features from the major cloud service providers. 

What you'll Do: 

Secure our cloud environments in software, process, and infrastructure through operating and building security tools. 

Develop strategy to resolve security issues through commercial and custom-built tooling. 

Assist security engineers with operational and software development standard processes. 

Lead efforts to analyze and harden Adobe’s cloud architecture. Conduct thorough reviews of each cloud environment, including architectures across AWS, Azure, and GCP, focusing on identity and access management (IAM), implementations, network segmentation, data protection controls, and the secure configuration of core services to prevent common and advanced attack vectors. 

Improve cloud-native threat detection. 

Minimize harmful actions by using native cloud security tools and relevant frameworks. 

Assess modern cloud workloads. Perform deep-dive security assessments of critical cloud workloads, including Kubernetes clusters (EKS, AKS, GKE), CI/CD pipelines, and serverless applications. 

Collaborate with teams across the organization to build complex software that interact with multiple systems, processes, and standards. 

Help improve the availability, performance, scalability, and security of Adobe's security tools. 

Transition Adobe’s security tooling into an infrastructure-as-code model to scale our cloud security. 

Develop custom cloud security automation. Build custom tools and scripts to automate the continuous discovery of cloud misconfigurations and security gaps. 

Improve our development workflow by assisting in establishing standards and implementing automation 

Improve our development pipelines so that we can achieve faster and more reliable deploys 

Focus on DevSecOps tooling and strategy 

Secure our cloud environments in software, process, and infrastructure through building security tools. 

Improve our tools and processes for continuous integration, continuous deployment, automated testing, and release management. 

 

 

What you need to succeed 

Solid understanding of both tooling operations and security protocols

ROLE OVERVIEW

Adobe is seeking a strategic and outcome-focused leader to serve as the Principal Product Manager for Adobe’s Configuration Management Database (CMDB). This role drives the vision, strategy, governance, and product innovation of this enterprise-wide platform. This hybrid role combines strategic leadership with hands-on product management to ensure our CMDB delivers accurate, actionable configuration data that enables IT Service Management, cloud operations, security, compliance, automation, and operational excellence at scale. Come join us at Adobe!

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead strategically

Define and own the CMDB vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned to business goals.

Own measurable business outcomes enabled by the CMDB, such as improved change success rate, reduced MTTR, audit readiness, operational risk reduction, etc.

Establish governance frameworks, data quality standards, and compliance processes balancing rigor with data quality and usability

Provide executive-level reporting on CMDB health, critical metrics, and business impact.

PRODUCT OWNERSHIP

Lead the CMDB as a product, building positive partnerships with the customers, and establishing continuous feedback loops informed by market trends and competitive insights.

Act as the business owner for the CMDB platform, managing backlog, prioritization, and delivery.

Gather and translate requirements from cross‑functional partners—including Product, IT, Security, HR, Legal, and Sales Ops—to drive continuous improvement across CMDB capabilities, integrations, and user experience.

Ensure the platform supports modern, dynamic environments including public & private clouds, SaaS, containers, and ephemeral infrastructure.

OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

The chosen applicant will ensure the CMDB aligns with ITIL standards and fully supports core ITSM processes—including Incident, Problem, Change, and Asset Management—while coordinating integrations with discovery tools, monitoring systems, and cloud platforms. In addition, the candidate will lead automation initiatives sought at improving efficiency, strengthening data quality, and reducing operational risk.

COLLABORATION & LEADERSHIP

This role partners closely with infrastructure, application, and security teams to ensure the accuracy and reliability of configuration data, and collaborates with the ServiceNow vendor to maintain alignment with and influence the evolving roadmap for CMDB tools and related technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS

10+ years in IT Service Management, IT Operations, or related fields, with at least 5 years in CMDB leadership.

Proven experience in product management or ownership of enterprise IT platforms.

Deep knowledge of ITIL framework and CMDB protocols.

Hands-on experience with ServiceNow CMDB or similar platforms.

Solid understanding of cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid infrastructure.

Exceptional relationship management, communication, and leadership skills.

PREFERRED SKILLS:

Experience using CMDB or configuration data to drive operational analytics, risk scoring, and decision support.

Experience driving automation and orchestration initiatives.

Familiarity with Agile methodologies and product lifecycle management.

Ability to influence at all levels and lead organizational change.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

This role is critical to Adobe’s ability to operate reliably, securely, and at scale. By transforming configuration and service data into a trusted platform, the selected candidate will enable faster delivery, safer change, stronger compliance, and better experiences for both internal teams and customers.

Role Description
We are seeking a highly experienced Lead DevOps Specialist with a strong security attitude to develop, build, and operate scalable, secure, and reliable cloud and hybrid infrastructure. This role demands deep Kubernetes expertise, mature CI/CD practices, and the ability to collaborate across engineering, security, and platform teams.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on technical depth, automation-first thinking, and excellent communication skills to influence architecture and delivery at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Design, implement, and operate cloud and hybrid infrastructure with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and security.

Architect, manage, and optimize Kubernetes platforms (cluster lifecycle, networking, security, observability).

Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitOps principles.

Implement GitOps workflows using tools like Argo CD for declarative deployments.

Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform for consistent, auditable infrastructure provisioning.

Automate configuration management and orchestration using SaltStack and scripting.

Partner closely with Security teams to embed security controls into CI/CD pipelines (DevSecOps).

Enforce guidelines for secrets management, access control, image signing, and supply-chain security.

Solve complex system issues across environments and lead root cause analysis.

Communicate effectively with interested parties across engineering, product, and security teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Skills

8+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps / Platform Engineering.

Strong experience with Cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP) and Hybrid architectures.

Expert-level Kubernetes knowledge (must-have).

Proven experience with Jenkins, CI/CD pipeline design, and automation.

Hands-on experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD.

Strong proficiency in at least one programming language — Java preferred.

Solid experience with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code.

Experience with SaltStack or similar configuration management tools.

Strong automation and scripting skills (Shell, Python, etc.).

Security & DevSecOps

Strong security-first attitude across infrastructure and pipelines.

Experience implementing security controls in CI/CD pipelines.

Familiarity with container security, image scanning, secrets management, and access policies.

Understanding of compliance, auditability, and secure SDLC practices is a plus.

Soft Skills

Excellent communication skills — written and verbal.

Ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical participants.

Strong ownership attitude and ability to work independently.

Proven collaboration skills across multi-functional teams.

You’ll focus on program management for large-scale, cross-functional initiatives that modernize how we deliver HR and Workplace services, improve how employees receive support, and help EWX drive measurable outcomes for the business.

This is a high-visibility opportunity to learn, grow, and make an impact—working closely with leaders and project teams while building strong program muscles across planning, execution, team alignment, and change enablement.

Cross-functional Coordination: Partner with global and regional Employee Experience teams, IT, Legal, Finance, and other collaborators to align on goals, timelines, and deliverables—ensuring smooth execution across geographies.

Portfolio Support: Contribute to portfolio visibility by supporting intake, prioritization discussions, resourcing conversations, and ongoing progress tracking for the transformation roadmap.

Change & Enablement Support: Help build and coordinate change, communication, and training plans that enable adoption of new services, processes, and tools. Support learning strategies that build new capabilities and ways of working (including AI fluency).

Continuous Improvement & Insights: Collect feedback, synthesize insights, and help teams translate data into actions—improving program delivery, stakeholder experience, and measurable outcomes.

Program Storytelling: Create crisp, executive-ready updates that simplify complexity, communicate progress, and highlight key decisions needed to keep initiatives on track.

What you need to succeed

5+ years of experience in program management, business operations, consulting, or related roles in a global, matrixed organization.

Demonstrated ability to manage large, cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and timelines.

Strong fundamentals in program/project management, including planning, documentation, RAID management, executive status reporting, and facilitation.

Confidence working with ambiguity—able to break down complex problems into structured plans and drive next steps.

Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills; able to tailor messaging for different audiences.

Interest in transformation work across employee experience, HR services, operations, and process improvement; familiarity with agile ways of working is a plus.

Experience with tools such as Workday, ServiceNow, Power BI, or similar platforms is a plus.

Adobe Firefly is transforming how creators ideate, create, and express themselves through generative AI. As Firefly continues to scale, data-driven growth and high-quality experimentation are core to how we learn, prioritize, and deliver value to millions of users.

In this role, you will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and Marketing to design experiments, measure impact, and uncover opportunities to improve user acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention across Firefly surfaces.

This is a highly visible role with significant ownership, technical depth, and influence over product direction.

What you’ll do:

· Define and evolve core growth, engagement, and experimentation metrics for Firefly.

· Translate ambiguous product and growth questions into structured analytical approaches.

· Identify user behavior patterns, friction points, and growth opportunities across the Firefly funnel (acquisition, activation, engagement, retention).

· Provide thought leadership on experiment design, tradeoffs, and prioritization.

· Develop, complete, and analyze experiments (A/B, multivariate, quasi-experimental) to answer critical product and growth questions.

· Partner with product teams to define experiment success metrics and guardrails aligned with user value and business goals.

· Communicate / present concise and actionable insights through engaging data storytelling to product and business partners.

· Define and scale self-serve analytics and dashboards that drives an improved understanding of product usage & end to end customer lifecycle

· Partner with data engineering to improve data quality, logging, and experimentation infrastructure.

· Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, UX Researchers, and Designers to guide product strategy with data.

What you’ll need to succeed:

· 4+ years of experience in data science, applied statistics, or analytics, preferably in product, growth, or experimentation-focused roles.

· Deep understanding of experimental design, statistical inference, causal reasoning, and common pitfalls in experimentation.

· Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python or R for analysis and modeling.

· Experience using modern data science workflows on the cloud (e.g., Git, Databricks, Python, AWS, Azure or equivalent).

· Experience working with large-scale product datasets and behavioral event data.

· Proven experience influencing product or growth decisions through data.

· Strong intuition for user behavior and ability to connect metrics to real-world user experiences.

· Ability to clearly communicate complex analyses and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

· Experience partnering with senior product and engineering leaders.

· Experience with Adobe Analytics or similar web/product analytics tool.

· BS, MS, or PhD in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering) or equivalent practical experience.

The Opportunity

Join Adobe’s Employee Experience (EX) team as a Talent Development Partner for the EMEA region. This is a unique opportunity to shape the talent agenda, develop and deliver transformative experiences, and build a culture of learning and leadership across a diverse landscape.

As a key partner for employee and leadership development, you will design and execute initiatives that address organisational challenges, drive leadership and team effectiveness, and create measurable impact. You’ll work closely with business leaders, HR Business Partners, and global Talent Development teams to deliver high-quality, high-impact solutions.

What You'll Do

Speak “business”, not “HR”. Deeply understand the business and region to serve as a trusted advisor on organisational change, team effectiveness, and leadership development across EMEA.

Be a trusted partner. Partner with HR Business Partners to support the execution of regional talent strategies.

Engage globally. Cultivate positive relationships with global Talent Development, Business Partners, and business leaders by understanding business issues and translating them into people strategies with concrete, measurable impact.

Be hands-on AND operate strategically. Craft and deliver development initiatives that incorporate a deep understanding of behavioural change and scalable solutions.

Build and deliver innovative solutions. Using thought leadership, innovation, and influence, you will develop targeted solutions that align with Adobe’s values and delivery methods, including e-learning, virtual, and live experiences.

Drive global processes in the region. Support and contribute to the development and execution of global talent development processes, programs, and offerings.

Be adaptable. Facilitate virtual, live, or blended enterprise programs to core audiences (managers, directors, individuals). Design and facilitate workshops, offsites, and planning sessions for regional business teams.

What You Need to Succeed

Lead the way. Strong command of learning and development models, frameworks, tools, and solutions to increase leadership effectiveness, including behavioural change, talent management, change leadership, and team effectiveness.

Experience matters. Ideally, you’ll have a minimum of 10 to 15 years of experience and a minimum 8 years of relevant talent development experience; consulting experience will be highly regarded.

Demonstrable track record. Impactful talent management and learning and development solutions from strategy to implementation in a large, global, matrix environment.

Depth and breadth. Human capital or leadership development advisory experience with a variety of organisations, teams, or leaders.

Build relationships. Ability to establish relationships and partnerships across all levels of a global matrix, exhibiting strong leadership and influencing skills.

Exemplify Adobe’s values.

Commercial savvy. Great at grasping how a business operates, to inform decision making.

Versatility working across cultures. Confidence collaborating with teams across EMEA, India, Asia Pacific, and the USA.

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to help lead a next-generation Android mobile app that will enable our customers to explore their creativity through video. This is an outstanding opportunity for you to join a very early team that is innovating, evolving and growing our video tools to meet the needs of storytellers!

As a member of our team, you'll work closely with our Product and Design teams to build new features and experiences.

Come work with us!
What you'll do

Lead a team of quality engineers and developers building a brand-new Android app.

You will work closely with product management, designers and users to define and refine the product roadmap, user experience, priorities, and schedule.

Drive an iterative software process that focuses on high quality releases.

Play a pivotal role in attracting, hiring, onboarding, and retaining exceptional engineers through mentorship, and grow them professionally and personally.

BS or MS in or equivalent experience in Computer Science.

6+ years of experience in software engineering. This experience should demonstrate a deep understanding of software development principles, practices, and methodologies.

3+ years leading software engineering teams.

Drive consensus on requirements, ensure timely decision-making, provide guidance, prioritize tasks, and optimize scope and time.

Passion for learning, sharing of new ideas and creative thinking to provide innovative solutions to challenges.

Thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment.

The opportunity

Adobe Experience Cloud powers the world’s leading enterprise marketing organizations. We help people and organizations design, deliver, and optimize exceptional customer experiences. Our B2B Design team is shaping the next generation of cross product workflows that help customers onboard, activate, and grow value across the platform. We’re looking for a Staff Designer who brings exceptional craft, systems thinking, and strategic clarity — someone who can simplify complexity, influence teams, and elevate the experience across Adobe’s B2B ecosystem.

This is a role for a designer who sweats the details, designs with intent at every level, and thrives on partnership with engineering and product to create elegant, scalable enterprise experiences.

What you’ll do

Lead Experience Strategy & Vison Across B2B Journeys

Shape end-to-end workflows that connect products across Experience Cloud ensuring a coherent ecosystem.

Define models, frameworks, and journeys that bring clarity to multi-surface enterprise experiences.

Partner closely with product, engineering, research, and platform teams to align around clear outcomes.

Raise the Bar for Craft and Systems Quality

Produce high fidelity UI, interaction patterns, and system level designs with exceptional attention to detail.

Produce visionary concepts and system frameworks that set a high bar for the organization.

Extend Adobe’s design systems by evolving patterns and introducing new components where necessary.

Elevate visual and interaction quality across surfaces and teams.

Explore, Prototype, and Validate

Use prototypes at multiple fidelities to explore and validate design decisions.

Ground your work in user insights, research, and data.

Transform complex enterprise workflows into intuitive, efficient experiences that scale.

Lead Through Influence, Mentorship, and Collaboration

Act as a trusted partner to engineering and product, clarifying direction and accelerating decision making.

Mentor designers, strengthening craft, narrative skill, and confidence across the team.

Create alignment across partners and guide shared ownership of journey level experiences.

Shape the Foundations of Enterprise Experience

Contribute to cross org experience standards and governance.

Champion accessible, inclusive, globally scalable design practices.

Support Adobe wide initiatives that advance our multi product ecosystem.

Operational & Organizational Impact

Influence and evolve Adobe’s design processes, tools, and operational frameworks.

Champion design culture, collaboration, and standards across international and cross-functional teams.

Actively contribute to org-wide initiatives, design reviews, and design excellence programs.

 
What you need to succeed

Must-haves:

10+ years designing complex, multi surface or enterprise products, with the ability to define and champion quality across teams.

A proven ability to drive cross product experience strategy and connect user value to business impact.

Mastery of interaction design, visual design, information architecture, and prototyping — with an eye for precision, hierarchy, and pixel level detail.

Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to craft clear narratives for partners, leadership, and cross functional teams. 

Demonstrated critical thinking and structured reasoning, bringing clarity to ambiguity and guiding teams through complex decision spaces.

A growth mindset and adaptability to new tools, emerging design technologies, and evolving workflows.

Deep experience with Figma, MIRO, and familiarity with other UX design tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud, and comfort working within and evolving design systems.

A portfolio showing enterprise level impact, systems thinking, and exceptional craft.

Nice-to-haves:

Experience with emerging AI powered tools such as Cursor, Figma Make, Lovable, or Replit.

Background in enterprise digital marketing or B2B marketing environments.

Insight into the competitive landscape for digital marketing and customer experience platforms.

Experience designing agentic or AI enhanced enterprise workflows.

Strong grounding in accessibility and inclusive design standards.

Experience designing accessible and inclusive interfaces for people with disabilities.

Understanding of applying WCAG conformance criteria in design, specifically testing comps, wireframes, and prototypes for accessibility standards.

Accessibility certifications CPACC, WAS, CPWA, or ADS from the IAAP preferred.

The Team: You will be joining the newly formed Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) team within Adobe’s Digital Experience organization. As part of a key innovation initiative, our mandate is to bridge the gap between product engineering and real-world implementation. We are a team of world-class engineers dedicated to solving the most complex challenges for the world's largest companies, ensuring they extract maximum value from the Adobe ecosystem. 

The Opportunity: This is an opportunity to serve as a Strategic Technical Authority and architect the future of Adobe’s product capabilities from the front lines. You will not just integrate existing software; you will architect and build new, production-grade product features that solve the most complex challenges for global industry leaders. As a Forward Deployment Architect, you will treat customer environments as the ultimate proving ground, identifying gaps in high-scale scenarios and engineering solutions that push the boundaries of what our platform can do. You will act as the vital link between real-world requirements and Core Engineering, ensuring that the innovations you build today become the foundational standards of the Adobe ecosystem tomorrow. 

What You'll Do: 

Architect and Define Solutions: Own the end-to-end technical vision for complex implementation projects, translating ambiguous customer requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performance system architectures. 

Drive Technical Governance: Establish and enforce design patterns, API specifications, and coding standards to ensure that solutions are not only functional but also maintainable and compliant with enterprise security policies. 

Lead Strategic Integration: Design robust integration strategies between Adobe Experience Cloud and diverse client technology stacks (legacy systems, cloud-native apps, and third-party data platforms), ensuring seamless data flow and interoperability. 

Champion Operational Excellence: Define the strategy for system observability, reliability, and high availability (HA/DR), guiding engineering teams to build "self-healing" and resilient production environments. 

Executive Technical Advisory: Lead high-stakes architectural workshops with client stakeholders (up to C-level) to align technical roadmaps with business objectives and drive consensus on implementation strategies. 

Elevate Engineering Culture: Serve as a technical authority and mentor for the wider FDE team, conducting design reviews and fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and best practices. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner deeply with Product Management and Core Engineering to feedback field insights into the product roadmap, influencing the future design of Adobe’s platform capabilities. 

Hands-on Prototyping: While focused on architecture, maintain deep technical acuity by building proof-of-concepts (POCs) for novel use cases to de-risk complex technical decisions before wider implementation. 

What You Bring: 

12+ years of technical experience, with at least 5 years in a Solution or Systems Architecture role, preferably designing large-scale SaaS or enterprise software solutions. 

Mastery of the Java/JVM ecosystem and modern application frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot), with the ability to evaluate and select technology stacks based on long-term maintainability and performance trade-offs. 

Deep expertise in Distributed System Design, including microservices, Event-Driven Architectures (EDA), and complex API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, gRPC). 

Advanced proficiency in Data Architecture, capable of designing high-throughput persistence layers and defining data models across Relational, NoSQL, and Search platforms (e.g., Elasticsearch). 

Strong command of Cloud-Native principles and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) within major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 

Executive presence and communication skills: The ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value for C-level executives and non-technical stakeholders. 

A strategic mindset for Security and Compliance, ensuring architectures adhere to SOC2, GDPR, and enterprise-grade security standards from day one. 

Comfortable with 10%-25% travel to build relationships with customers 

Desired Extras: 

Technical Thought Leadership: A history of public technical communication, including speaking at major industry conferences, publishing technical white papers, or maintaining a widely-read engineering blog. 

Experience with the Adobe Ecosystem: Prior experience architecting solutions involving Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Analytics, or Adobe Experience Platform (AEP).

Build and Ship Fast: Rapidly design and implement features and integrations based on immediate customer requirements, moving quickly from "whiteboard sketch" to working code. 

AI-Driven Prototyping: Experiment with Generative AI and agentic workflows to create novel demos and automation tools that showcase the future of the Adobe ecosystem. 

Production-Grade Engineering: Write clean, efficient, and testable Java/Scala code for high-availability systems and RESTful APIs. 

Solve the Puzzle: Troubleshoot complex integration issues in real-time, performing root cause analysis when services don't behave as expected. 

Collaborate & Learn: Partner with senior architects to understand the "why" behind the build, while providing feedback to product teams on how customers are actually using our APIs and AI features. 

What You Bring 

3+ years of software engineering experience with strong fundamentals in Java or Scala.

Solid understanding of REST API concepts and how to consume/build web services. 

Practical experience with SQL/NoSQL databases (you know how to write a query and design a basic schema).

Agentic Frameworks: Experience playing with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGPT concepts to build autonomous agents.

Full-Stack Curiosity: Familiarity with frontend frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue) to build complete end-to-end demos. 

Side Projects & Hackathons: A GitHub profile showing personal projects—especially those involving AI wrappers, chatbots, or automation tools. 

Cloud Playground: Experience deploying your own apps to AWS, Azure, or GCP (e.g., deploying a Python AI bot on Lambda). 

Data Tinkering: Basic exposure to data streaming (Kafka) or big data tools; you aren't afraid of large datasets.

Job Description 

Adobe is driving digital transformation across industries, and Western is one of our fastest-growing and most exciting markets in EMEA. We are seeking an experienced second-line sales leader to take on the role of Senior Leader for our Creativity & Productivity Enterprise Business in Western. This, is a unique opportunity to lead a high-performing sales organisation, expand our presence, and build on the strong momentum we’ve already established. 

As the Enterprise Sales (Second Line Manager) you will report to the Regional VP Western Europe and be responsible for driving growth across Western by leading and scaling our enterprise sales team. You will inspire and develop managers and account executives, engage with C-suite stakeholders within our most influential companies, and ensure predictable, sustainable growth across key industries. 

 

What you'll Do 

Responsible for Adobe’s Creativity & Productivity Enterprise Sales performance and strategy across Western

Lead and develop front-line managers (FLMs) and their teams of Account Executives, driving accountability, performance, and professional growth. 

Align with the executive leadership team, and key partners, to define differentiated offerings and go-to-market strategies 

Drive predictable and sustainable revenue growth, consistently delivering against targets. 

Identify, grow and accelerate revenue opportunities within key accounts 

Optimise day-to-day sales activities and drive engagement that optimise revenue conversion 

Bring together cross functional teams to enhance commercial opportunities and identify areas of improvement 

Partner cross-functionally with Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Marketing, and Global teams to optimise execution. 

Maintain a culture of transparency, collaboration, and performance, ensuring engagement and retention of top talent. 

Contribute to regional and global strategy by providing insight on Western market trends, opportunities, and customer needs. 

 

What you need to succeed 

Strong second line sales management experience with success managing managers of enterprise sales teams. 

Strong direct software sales experience (not consulting, indirect sales, or professional services). 

Outstanding influencing, negotiation and commercial skills 

Strong C-level negotiation and influencing skills, with experience closing transformational deals. 

Consistent track record in leading through others within a matrixed organization. 

Demonstrated ability to build and scale high-performing, engaged sales teams. 

Evidence of success bringing in new business and ability to optimise and scale existing opportunities. 

Excellent people leadership skills; ability to influence and drive accountability and ownership at all levels 

Data-driven decision-maker with a strategic attitude and operational excellence. 

Hold diversity, equity, and inclusion at the heart of all you decide, do, and personify. 

A growth mindset with resilience to lead through change and transformation.

About ALM

Adobe Learning Manager (ALM) is Adobe’s AI-powered, cloud-based learning platform used by global enterprises to deliver personalized, skills-based learning to employees, customers, and partners at scale.

The platform operates at enterprise scale, serving millions of learners with high availability, security, and performance. ALM uses modern cloud architecture, data platforms, and GenAI-driven experiences to move beyond traditional LMS systems and enable continuous upskilling.

As part of the team, you’ll work on high-impact, mission critical systems that shape the future of workforce learning.

Engineering Director
 

What you’ll do

Lead teams across multiple execution horizons—from AI-first, fail-fast innovation to sustained evolution of a critically important core platform.

Operate in a hands-on leadership model, diving deep where needed to unblock teams and raise the technical bar.

Design and evolve high-scale, low-latency systems that can grow on demand.

Drive R&D-led rethinking of existing architectures, leveraging modern cloud, data, and GenAI technologies.

Define and continuously refine a multi-horizon engineering strategy, grounded in best-in-class software practices and emerging industry shifts.

Partner closely with Product Management to bring AI-powered assistive experiences to life, influencing roadmaps by articulating what is possible now and what’s next.

Foster strong collaboration across engineering teams to maximize reuse, efficiency, and shared ownership.

Hire, develop, and lead high-performing, diverse engineering teams, owning end-to-end delivery and execution.

Build a culture rooted in rigorous engineering practices, customer empathy, and data-driven decision-making.

Manage scope, dependencies, and risk using analytics, judgment, and creative problem solving.

What you need to succeed

Strong technology depth paired with business acumen.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to bring clarity in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

Clear, concise communication skills and the ability to partner effectively with globally distributed teams.

Proven ability to attract, hire, mentor, and retain top engineering talent.

Deep understanding of Data structures, Algorithms, Distributed systems, Concurrency, and Data Lakehouse architectures.

Hands-on experience with GenAI technologies and AI-driven product development.

A self-starter mindset with a strong bias toward collaboration and ownership across functions.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

16+ years of experience, including 10+ years building and scaling large, web-based systems.

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related engineering discipline.

Proven experience delivering enterprise-grade SaaS platforms.

Track record of building high-scale transactional systems, data platforms, and GenAI-powered products from the ground up.

Comfortable operating in ambiguity, adapting to evolving priorities, and leading with autonomy and accountability.

Demonstrated ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Strategic thinker who can set direction across quarters, years, and longer-term horizons.

Deep commitment to exceptional customer experiences and continuous product improvement.

The Opportunity

As Director, Global ACS Sales Excellence, you will lead a new team focused on developing a modern sales enablement approach that helps our ACS Sales group sell more effectively and provide customer value. This role will establish success metrics, develop measurable frameworks, and introduce agile processes to rapidly and sustainably close performance gaps.

Using real-time deal and sales data, you will establish a dynamic feedback loop that informs targeted training, mentoring, and resources for sellers, managers, and leaders. Through active collaboration with partners and innovative programs, you will champion value-based, customer-focused selling and drive lasting impact on seller performance and career growth across global teams.

What You’ll Do

Build and complete a global sales enablement and performance strategy that drives seller efficiency and accelerates revenue growth.

Develop agile, data-driven programs by bringing to bear real-time deal insights and performance metrics to identify gaps and deliver targeted interventions quickly.

Build and implement success frameworks and important metrics to measure seller efficiency, pipeline health, and program impact—informing leadership decisions.

Build scalable learning and mentoring solutions that address skill gaps and reinforce behaviors tied to performance outcomes.

Partner with sales leadership and operations to align enablement initiatives with forecasting, territory planning, and business priorities.

Lead a high-performing team of enablement and performance professionals, encouraging a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

Drive change management and collaborate with participants to ensure adoption of new tools, processes, and performance methodologies across global teams.

Establish governance and inspection rhythms that provide transparency into seller performance, enablement return on investment, and organizational health.

What You Need to Succeed:

8+ years in sales enablement or performance leadership, with measurable impact on seller efficiency and revenue growth.

Deep knowledge of enterprise sales methodologies (value-based, consultative) and experience applying them at scale.

Expertise in building performance frameworks, important metrics, and governance models for global sales organizations.

Strong analytical skills to translate pipeline and deal data into actionable enablement strategies.

Proven success influencing senior collaborators and aligning cross-functional teams to strategic priorities.

Experience managing global teams and encouraging a culture of accountability and innovation.

Comfortable leading change management and encouraging adoption of new tools, processes, and operating rhythms.

Ability to balance strategic vision with operational execution, delivering scalable programs that adapt to evolving business needs.

The Opportunity 

We are seeking a strategic, people-centric leader to build and lead our Americas Manager Success Partner team—a group dedicated to empowering managers to lead effectively, strengthen team performance, and foster a healthy, equitable, high-trust culture! This role functions with a specialized focus on manager capability, coaching, and support. 

As the leader, you will develop the vision, strategy, and operational framework for how we enable managers across the Americas region! You will partner closely with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), Talent Development, Employee Relations, and Business Leaders to deliver scalable solutions and human-centered guidance that elevates manager effectiveness at every level. 

This role requires a skilled people-leader with deep experience in HR partnership, manager coaching, organizational effectiveness, and change leadership. 

What You’ll Do 

Leadership & Strategy 

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team across the Americas, setting a clear vision, operating model, and success measures. 

Co-create and refine the strategy for manager enablement in close partnership with Talent Development, including proactive engagement models, consultation frameworks, and differentiated support for new vs. experienced managers. 

Serve as a senior advisor to People Leaders and cross-functional partners, representing the voice and needs of managers. 

Ensure alignment with global HR strategies, Talent Management, Talent Development, and Employee Experience programs. 

Manager Coaching & Advisory 

Provide expert-level coaching to front line and senior managers (up to Director) on engagement, performance, team dynamics, change management, and complex interpersonal situations. 

Guide managers through organizational processes including performance management, career development, workforce planning, and team transitions. 

Support managers in building inclusive, equitable leadership practices and high-trust team environments. 

Use data, insights, and diagnostics to identify manager capability gaps and recommend targeted interventions. 

Program & Operational Excellence 

Develop scalable programs, toolkits, playbooks, and frameworks that strengthen manager skills and consistency across the region. 

Partner with Talent Development to enhance manager learning paths, onboarding for new managers, and leadership development offerings. 

Establish feedback loops and reporting mechanisms to identify systemic issues, trends, and opportunities for improvement. 

Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence in how the function operates. 

Change & Organizational Effectiveness 

Partner with HR Business Partners to support organizational redesigns, strategic shifts, and transformation initiatives with a people-centered approach. 

Lead or support initiatives that improve manager readiness during times of change—ensuring clarity, communication, and employee impact assessment. 

Collaborate closely with Employee Relations on sensitive or complex manager scenarios, ensuring consistent, ethically sound guidance. 

 

What You Need to Succeed 

Required 

10+ years of experience in HR Business Partnering, People Consulting, Talent Development, Organizational Development, or a related leadership role. 

Progressive leadership experience, including leading managers or multi-disciplinary HR teams. 

Demonstrated ability to coach managers and senior leaders on complex situations with sound judgment, emotional intelligence, and discretion. 

Solid understanding of organizational behavior, leadership development, performance management, and change management. 

Ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and build solid relationships across levels and functions. 

Experience working across a matrixed, global, or enterprise-scale environment. 

Preferred 

Experience building a new team or function from the ground up. 

Coaching certifications (ICF or similar) or advanced training in leadership development. 

Expertise in organizational design, manager capability programs, or employee experience strategy. 

Familiarity with data-driven insights, diagnostics, and people analytics

This is a chance to join a "startup within a giant." As a Forward Deployment Engineer, you will be the hands-on builder bridging the gap between Adobe’s core products and real-world customer needs. Build and Ship Fast: Rapidly design and implement features and integrations based on immediate customer requirements, moving quickly from "whiteboard sketch" to working code.

The Team: You will be joining the newly formed Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) team within Adobe’s Digital Experience organization. As part of a key innovation initiative, our mandate is to bridge the gap between product engineering and real-world implementation. We are a team of world-class AI and traditional engineers dedicated to solving the most complex challenges for the world's largest companies, ensuring they extract maximum value from the Adobe ecosystem.

The Opportunity: This is an opportunity to be a technical ambassador for Adobe. You will split your time between deep technical work and on-site collaboration with the engineering teams of global industry leaders. If you are passionate about customer empathy and technical excellence, this role offers the best of both worlds: the excitement of a startup-style environment with the resources and scale of Adobe. Come help us build the future of digital experiences, one customer success story at a time.

What You'll Do: 

Implement A2A integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, event streams, connectors) so customers can plug our AI capabilities into their existing applications and workflows.

Create reusable SDKs, templates, and reference implementations that reduce friction for customers adopting our AI features.

Act like a data analyst for model behavior:

Query logs and metrics (SQL, notebooks, dashboards) to understand how models and prompts are performing in production.

Investigate failure modes, edge cases, and drift (e.g., low-quality responses, latency spikes, low adoption).

Segment metrics by customer, cohort, use case, or configuration to find patterns and opportunities.

This role is eligible for bonus and equity

Design and maintain evaluation pipelines for AI features:

Define success metrics and guardrails.

Set up offline and online evaluation (test sets, acceptance thresholds, user rating flows, A/B tests).

Instrument AI features with strong observability and testing:

Logging of inputs/outputs with privacy in mind.

Traces/timelines of model calls, retrieval steps, and downstream effects.

Dashboards and alerts for quality, performance, and usage.

Design and implement AI-backed services and APIs in Python using PyTorch or similar frameworks.

Work with customer-facing teams (Customer Success, Solutions, Forward Deployed) to:

Turn customer feedback and production data into prioritized improvements.

Provide clear, data-backed insights on what’s working, what’s not, and why.

Join customer calls and workshops to:

Understand their systems, integration constraints, and success criteria.

Guide them on how best to use our APIs, SDKs, and observability tools.

Act as a bridge between customer needs and internal product/engineering, ensuring what we build is usable, measurable, and scalable across many customers.

What You Bring: 

8+ years of software engineering experience with 2+ years working with ML/AI or LLM-based applications.

An inventive mind that is looking for the best solutions to the most interesting problems. This involves a build-first mentality that seeks answers in the practical application.

A strong sense of mentorship and team building to grow everyone’s roles.

Current understanding of the state of AI and are aggressively keeping up on the latest developments. You should be able to articulate the benefits of different architectural options.

Expertise in Python, including hands-on work with PyTorch or similar frameworks (TensorFlow, JAX, etc.).

Familiarity with A2A (application-to-application) integration patterns:

REST/gRPC APIs, webhooks, queues, or event-driven systems.

Authentication, rate limits, and basic reliability patterns.

Comfortable with data-analyst-style work:

Writing SQL and working with analytics tools/notebooks.

Building or interpreting dashboards (e.g., metrics for model quality, latency, usage).

Turning data into clear, actionable recommendations.

Be willing to dive into implementation with a customer to make sure they are maximizing their use of AI.

Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS / GCP / Azure) and standard dev tooling (Git, CI/CD, Docker).

Exposure to LLM applications (RAG, agents, prompt pipelines) and their evaluation.

Experience with logging/observability stacks (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog, etc.).

Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps concepts: evaluation harnesses, prompt/version management, feature flags, or canary rollouts.

Proficiency in Java/Scala, along with associated frameworks.

Proven track record of shipping production features and iterating based on real-world feedback.

Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical details and data insights to customers and non-ML stakeholders.

Comfortable with 10%-25% travel to build relationships with customers

Desired Extras: 

Published technical writing or other communication

A background in SaaS software

Prior work in customer-facing technical roles or close collaboration with Customer Success / Solutions / Forward Deployed Engineering teams.

Marketing or CRM domain knowledge

The Opportunity 

Join Adobe as a skilled and proactive Machine Learning Ops Engineer to drive the operational reliability, scalability, and performance of our AI systems! This role is foundational in ensuring our AI systems operate seamlessly across environments while meeting the needs of both developers and end users. You will lead efforts to automate and optimize the full machine learning lifecycle—from data pipelines and model deployment to monitoring, governance, and incident response.

What you'll Do 

Model Lifecycle Management

Manage model versioning, deployment strategies, rollback mechanisms, and A/B testing frameworks for LLM agents and RAG systems.

Coordinate model registries, artifacts, and promotion workflows in collaboration with ML Engineers

Monitoring & Observability

Implement real-time monitoring of model performance (accuracy, latency, drift, degradation).

Track conversation quality metrics and user feedback loops for production agents.

CI/CD for AI

Develop automated pipelines for timely/agent testing, validation, and deployment.

Integrate unit/integration tests into model and workflow updates for safe rollouts.

Infrastructure Automation

Provision and manage scalable infrastructure (Kubernetes, Terraform, serverless stacks).

Enable auto-scaling, resource optimization, and load balancing for AI workloads.

Data Pipeline Management

Craft and maintain data ingestion pipelines for both structured and unstructured sources.

Ensure reliable feature extraction, transformation, and data validation workflows.

Performance Optimization

Monitor and optimize AI stack performance (model latency, API efficiency, GPU/compute utilization).

Drive cost-aware engineering across inference, retrieval, and orchestration layers.

Incident Response & Reliability

Build alerting and triage systems to identify and resolve production issues.

Maintain SLAs and develop rollback/recovery strategies for AI services.

Compliance & Governance

Enforce model governance, audit trails, and explainability standards.

Support documentation and regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, internal policy alignment).

What you need to succeed 

3–5+ years in MLOps, DevOps, or ML platform engineering.

Strong experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), container orchestration (Kubernetes), and IaC tools (Terraform, Helm).

Familiarity with ML model serving tools (e.g., MLflow, Seldon, TorchServe, BentoML).

Proficiency in Python and CI/CD automation (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo Workflows).

Experience with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK, Arize AI, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting LLM applications, RAG pipelines, or AI agent orchestration.

Understanding of vector databases, embedding workflows, and model retraining triggers.

Exposure to privacy, safety, and responsible AI principles in operational contexts.

Bachelor's or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

About the Opportunity and Team

Social Media, Creators, and Communities are transforming how brands build relevance and long-term customer relationships. These channels generate rich, fast-moving signals across culture, conversation, sentiment, and performance—introducing new challenges around measurement, attribution, and sustained impact across the entire customer journey.

Within the Growth Marketing & Insights organization, our team develops actionable Category & Customer Insights and measures Marketing Effectiveness as our dual purpose. We are a multidisciplinary team of change agents—data scientists, strategists, and analysts—who thrive in ambiguity, move fast with rigor, and tackle complex, evolving challenges. We enable decisions at the E-Team level and help the business move from insights to execution to growth. We partner closely with Marketers, Product, GTM, and Finance to bring clarity to emerging problem spaces.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Manager, Social & Influencer Measurement to lead how we define, measure, and optimize success across Social, Influencer, and Community marketing. It drives full-stack measurement and strategic impact for Adobe’s Social Marketing in Organic, Paid, and Earned channels.

You will be a builder of teams, systems, and standards, not only keeping pace with a fast-moving field, but leading innovation within it. You’ll manage and develop analytics and data science talent, own end-to-end measurement frameworks, and serve as a trusted thought partner to senior marketing leaders.

What You’ll Do

Shape how Social and Influencer impact is measured and quantified, how insights are produced at scale, and how those insights translate into confident decisions, actions, and meaningful business outcomes.

Lead and grow a team of analysts and data scientists, setting clear direction, prioritizing the right work, coaching for impact, and building durable systems that scale team effectiveness.

Measure and evaluate end-to-end social-first initiatives (campaigns, announcements, launches, events), establishing reporting and optimization metrics across the funnel.

Translate ambiguous and multi-dimensional signals into structured analysis, developing proxies and heuristics to connect upper-funnel outcomes (reach, attention, engagement, sentiment, influence) to business results (e.g., MAU, LTV, ARR).

Set quarterly goals and establish operating rhythms. Monitor weekly and sometimes daily performance. Use data to guide investment and budget decisions across content creation and paid media. Balance customer acquisition cost, return on investment, and long-term brand impact.

Build and scale analysis pipelines and data foundations, partnering with Data Engineering to ensure data quality, metric integrity, and reliable insights at scale; work with large, complex datasets, including text and social conversation data.

Adopt and champion AI-first workflows (e.g., assisted analysis, synthesis, and reporting) to improve team productivity, speed to insight, and analytical leverage—while maintaining strong judgment, rigor, and accountability.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

Leadership & Management

Over 3 years managing people, demonstrating success in building, leading, and developing high-performing analytics or advanced data analysis teams.

Demonstrated ability to set priorities and expectations, manage tradeoffs, and drive execution in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

A leadership style that is curious, results-focused, and grounded in ownership, continuous learning, and pushing the standard higher.

Analytics & Systems Thinking

8–10+ years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, product analytics, or data science, with exposure to social, influencer/creator, or community measurement.

Proven judgment solving problems without clear playbooks or ground truth, including non-routine analytical challenges requiring advanced analytical, statistical, or experimental methods.

Strong analytical reasoning and comfort working with imperfect, fragmented, or non-attributable data.

Communication & Influence

Ability to understand complex systems and explain them simply to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Proven experience influencing senior and executive partners through clarity, structure, and data-driven storytelling.

Trusted partner attitude with strong cross-functional instincts in large, matrixed organizations.

Nice to Have

Experience with influencer/creator platforms, social listening tools, or content analytics

Background in brand measurement, sentiment analysis, or community health metrics

Experience scaling analytics practices for emerging or rapidly evolving marketing channels

This position requires deep, hands‑on experience in marketing operations, with a strong understanding of systems, workflows, data, and channels. The individual will create structure, streamline processes, and ensure Japan Marketing delivers on its priorities while clearly representing Japan’s needs to Corporate and International teams.

The ideal candidate is collaborative, low ego, and focused on driving what is best for the business. At the same time, they bring the confidence to guide senior leaders, influence decisions through clear narratives, and simplify complexity. Thriving in dynamic environments, they anticipate challenges before they arise, connect teams effectively, and build scalable marketing operations that enable the organization to adapt and succeed.

Key Responsibilities 

Drive cross-functional alignment and execution 

Design and maintain unified operating structures that help Japan Marketing work seamlessly with global and local stakeholders. 

Lead major cross-functional initiatives end-to-end (e.g., long-term regional strategy, GTM alignment). 

Build frameworks, planning cadences, dashboards, and governance models that keep teams focused and accountable. 

Serve as the coordination hub for Corporate / International 

Act as the primary liaison between Japan Marketing and Corporate/International strategy, operations, and planning teams. 

Clearly represent Japan’s needs, challenges, and priorities in global forums. 

Adapt global strategies and operating models to Japan’s market context. 

Lead budget management and planning 

Own the full budgeting cycle, including annual planning, QBRs, forecasting, and ongoing oversight. 

Partner closely with Finance, International Ops, and Japan Marketing functions. 

Build transparent budget tracking and scenario planning models rooted in marketing operations realities. 

Strengthen organizational effectiveness 

Establish and refine the operating rhythm of Japan Marketing (weekly reviews, dashboards, strategy reviews). 

Lead annual planning, OKRs, performance tracking, and cross-team communication. 

Improve collaboration across marketing functions by enhancing workflows and reducing operational friction. 

Executive communications and strategic advisory 

Prepare executive-level materials for Corporate and Japan leadership (business reviews, performance insights, funnel and pipeline analysis). 

Synthesize market trends, customer insights and performance data into clear, persuasive narratives that influence decision-making in partnership with Product Marketing and Customer Marketing. 

Act as a thought partner to the Head of Japan Marketing—anticipating risks, surfacing insights, and shaping strategic decisions.

The Team:

You will be joining the newly formed Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) team within Adobe’s Digital Experience organization. As part of a key innovation initiative, our mandate is to bridge the gap between product engineering and real-world implementation. We are a team of world-class AI and traditional engineers dedicated to solving the most complex challenges for the world's largest companies, ensuring they extract maximum value from the Adobe ecosystem.

The Opportunity:

This is an opportunity to be a technical ambassador for Adobe. You will split your time between deep technical work and on-site collaboration with the engineering teams of global industry leaders. If you are passionate about customer empathy and technical excellence, this role offers the best of both worlds: the excitement of a startup-style environment with the resources and scale of Adobe. Come help us build the future of digital experiences, one customer success story at a time.

What You'll Do: 

Implement A2A integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, event streams, connectors) so customers can plug our AI capabilities into their existing applications and workflows.

Create reusable SDKs, templates, and reference implementations that reduce friction for customers adopting our AI features.

Act like a data analyst for model behavior:

Query logs and metrics (SQL, notebooks, dashboards) to understand how models and prompts are performing in production.

Investigate failure modes, edge cases, and drift (e.g., low-quality responses, latency spikes, low adoption).

Segment metrics by customer, cohort, use case, or configuration to find patterns and opportunities.

Design and maintain evaluation pipelines for AI features:

Define success metrics and guardrails.

Set up offline and online evaluation (test sets, acceptance thresholds, user rating flows, A/B tests).

Instrument AI features with strong observability and testing:

Logging of inputs/outputs with privacy in mind.

Traces/timelines of model calls, retrieval steps, and downstream effects.

Dashboards and alerts for quality, performance, and usage.

Design and implement AI-backed services and APIs in Python using PyTorch or similar frameworks.

Work with customer-facing teams (Customer Success, Solutions, Forward Deployed) to:

Turn customer feedback and production data into prioritized improvements.

Provide clear, data-backed insights on what’s working, what’s not, and why.

Join customer calls and workshops to:

Understand their systems, integration constraints, and success criteria.

Guide them on how best to use our APIs, SDKs, and observability tools.

Act as a bridge between customer needs and internal product/engineering, ensuring what we build is usable, measurable, and scalable across many customers.

What You Bring: 

5+ years of software engineering experience with 1+ years working with ML/AI or LLM-based applications.

An inventive mind that is looking for the best solutions to the most interesting problems. This involves a build-first mentality that seeks answers in the practical application.

Current understanding of the state of AI and are aggressively keeping up on the latest developments. You should be able to articulate the benefits of different architectural options.

Strong programming skills in Python, including hands-on work with PyTorch or similar frameworks (TensorFlow, JAX, etc.).

Familiarity with A2A (application-to-application) integration patterns:

REST/gRPC APIs, webhooks, queues, or event-driven systems.

Authentication, rate limits, and basic reliability patterns.

Comfortable with data-analyst-style work:

Writing SQL and working with analytics tools/notebooks.

Building or interpreting dashboards (e.g., metrics for model quality, latency, usage).

Turning data into clear, actionable recommendations.

Be willing to dive into implementation with a customer to make sure they are maximizing their use of AI.

Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS / GCP / Azure) and standard dev tooling (Git, CI/CD, Docker).

Proven track record of shipping production features and iterating based on real-world feedback.

Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical details and data insights to customers and non-ML stakeholders.

Comfortable with 10%-25% travel to build relationships with customers

Desired Extras: 

Exposure to LLM applications (RAG, agents, prompt pipelines) and their evaluation.

Experience with logging/observability stacks (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog, etc.).

Prior work in customer-facing technical roles or close collaboration with Customer Success / Solutions / Forward Deployed Engineering teams.

Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps concepts: evaluation harnesses, prompt/version management, feature flags, or canary rollouts.

Proficiency in Java/Scala along with associated frameworks

This role is eligible for bonus and equity

Implement A2A integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, event streams, connectors) so customers can plug our AI capabilities into their existing applications and workflows.

Create reusable SDKs, templates, and reference implementations that reduce friction for customers adopting our AI features.

Act like a data analyst for model behavior:

Query logs and metrics (SQL, notebooks, dashboards) to understand how models and prompts are performing in production.

Investigate failure modes, edge cases, and drift (e.g., low-quality responses, latency spikes, low adoption).

Segment metrics by customer, cohort, use case, or configuration to find patterns and opportunities.

Design and maintain evaluation pipelines for AI features:

Define success metrics and guardrails.

Set up offline and online evaluation (test sets, acceptance thresholds, user rating flows, A/B tests).

Instrument AI features with strong observability and testing:

Logging of inputs/outputs with privacy in mind.

Traces/timelines of model calls, retrieval steps, and downstream effects.

Dashboards and alerts for quality, performance, and usage.

Design and implement AI-backed services and APIs in Python using PyTorch or similar frameworks.

Work with customer-facing teams (Customer Success, Solutions, Forward Deployed) to:

Turn customer feedback and production data into prioritized improvements.

Provide clear, data-backed insights on what’s working, what’s not, and why.

Join customer calls and workshops to:

Understand their systems, integration constraints, and success criteria.

Guide them on how best to use our APIs, SDKs, and observability tools.

Act as a bridge between customer needs and internal product/engineering, ensuring what we build is usable, measurable, and scalable across many customers.

8+ years of software engineering experience with 2+ years working with ML/AI or LLM-based applications.

An inventive mind that is looking for the best solutions to the most interesting problems. This involves a build-first mentality that seeks answers in the practical application.

A strong sense of mentorship and team building to grow everyone’s roles.

Current understanding of the state of AI and are aggressively keeping up on the latest developments. You should be able to articulate the benefits of different architectural options.

Expertise in Python, including hands-on work with PyTorch or similar frameworks (TensorFlow, JAX, etc.).

REST/gRPC APIs, webhooks, queues, or event-driven systems.

Authentication, rate limits, and basic reliability patterns.

Writing SQL and working with analytics tools/notebooks.

Turning data into clear, actionable recommendations.

Be willing to dive into implementation with a customer to make sure they are maximizing their use of AI.
